jobs.title: Maintenance Worker I - Grounds
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

The purpose of the class is to perform routine manual work.  This class is responsible for service work such as digging trenches, cleaning ditches; assists with installation of fixtures such as pipes, valves, fittings, and manholes; landscape, road, sidewalk, driveway restoration and other outdoor work.  Completes logs or routine records.  The class works according to set procedures under direct supervision.   

Essential Job Functions

  • Operates vehicles such as trucks to transport people or material to job sites.
  • Loads and unloads materials such as gravel, dirt, timber, chemicals, or other materials, tools, and equipment.
  • Maintains outdoor areas by cutting grass, pruning trees and bushes, raking leaves and debris, installing landscape material, and other maintenance tasks.
  • Performs utility service work such as digging trenches, cleaning ditches; assists with installation of fixtures such as pipes, manholes, and sewer lines.
  • Performs maintenance functions such as repairing irrigation, greasing pumps, motors, and shafts, and replacing valves; performs light repairs and installations as directed.
  • Maintains indoor areas such as cleaning facilities and indoor areas, performing light maintenance such as painting and minor repairs.
  • Assists the public by answering questions and providing routine information.
  • Performs clerical tasks such as completing work orders or maintaining logs.
  • Compares or inspects items against a standard.
  • Follows oral and written directions; communication effectively in both oral and written form of supervisor
  • Makes a few decisions, affecting only the individual.
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with those contacted in the course of work, including City and other government officials, community groups, and the general public; and applying safe work practices.

Minimum Requirements

Previous experience working in a ground’s maintenance position preferred, but not required. Employee will receive on the job training.


General knowledge of computer usage preferred.


Requires a valid State of Florida driver license and satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment. 


May be required to acquire and maintain a specific applicators license.

Marginal Job Functions

  • Attends unit meetings, in-service training, workshops, etc. for the purpose of gathering information required to perform job functions.  
  • Performs other related duties as assigned for ensuring the efficient and effective functioning of the work unit.

jobs.title: Fleet Manager
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

Performs administrative and managerial work directing the City’s centralized fleet division. Work involves responsibility for planning and directing the fleet management program, contractors and city employees; to include the maintenance, servicing, modification and repair of municipal vehicles. Responsible also for replacement and disposal of a wide variety of automotive, vehicular, emergency and heavy construction equipment. Develops and submits bid specifications for vehicle and equipment purchases.  The class works within broad policy and organizational guidelines; independently plans and implements projects; reports progress of major activities through periodic conferences and meetings.

Essential Job Functions

  • Supervises staff including selecting or recommending selection, training, assigning and evaluating work, counseling, discipline, and recommending termination.
  • Coordinates operations with all City departments and the public; analyzes preventive maintenance and repair procedures, establishes and organizes repair priorities; evaluates replacement and expanding equipment needs for the City; declares equipment excess to City needs.
  • Develops policies and procedures for safety and daily operations in accordance with requirements and guidelines, promulgates, and evaluates to ensure compliance.
  • Operates and maintains vehicle and equipment fueling and cleaning stations.
  • Inspects or diagnoses vehicles or equipment with complex problems; advises and assists subordinates, or performs especially difficult or complex maintenance tasks.
  • Prepares and administers annual budget; establishes and or reviews and approves program goals and objectives; monitors and ensures adherence to include maintenance and repair cost on vehicles.
  • Attends or conducts staff meetings to exchange information; attends, and schedules others to attend, in-service training and technical classes, seminars, or conferences to improve skills.  
  • Develop and implement specific computer systems and software relative to operations of the Fleet Division of Public Works. Review of periodic analytical reports on performance; ensure attainment of desired goals and level of Service.
  • Formulates operating policies and procedures and establishes work standards and performance metrics; develops fiscal year work calendar relative to the maintenance management program.

Minimum Requirements

  • Degree in Automotive Engineering, Automotive Technology, Business Management or related discipline preferred. Eight or more years of experience in an automotive fleet environment with a minimum of four (4) years as a supervisor or manager in a fleet environment. Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.

  • Performs supervisory work involving policy and guidelines, solving both people and work related problems.

  • Uses basic algebra involving variables and formulas, basic geometry involving plane and solid figures such as circumferences, areas, or volumes; may compute ratios, rates, or percents.

  • Read technical instructions, procedures manuals, and charts to solve practical problems; composes routine and specialized reports, forms, and letters; speaks compound sentences using normal grammar and word form.

  • Performs specialized technical and administrative work requiring general understanding of operating policies and procedures and their application to problems not previously encountered; applies specialized technical or professional principles and practices in the solution of problems; requires normal attention with short periods of concentration for accurate results and occasional exposure to unusual pressure.

  • Requires a valid State of Florida Class B CDL and satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment.  
     
    Must obtain a valid State of Florida Class “A” Commercial Driver’s License within six (6) months of hire date. 

  • Special skills or equipment certification may be required.

 Performs specialized technical and administrative work requiring general understanding of operating policies and procedures and their application to problems not previously encountered; applies specialized technical or professional principles and practices in the solution of problems; requires normal attention with short periods of concentration for accurate results and occasional exposure to unusual pressure. 
 Requires a valid State of Florida Class B CDL and satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment. 
 Must obtain a valid State of Florida Class “A” Commercial Driver’s License within six (6) months of hire date . 
 Special skills or equipment certification may be required.

jobs.title: Senior ER Technician
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

The purpose of the class is to maintain City motorized vehicles and equipment.  The class is responsible for preventive maintenance, major and minor repairs, vehicle modifications, maintenance documentation, and parts inventories.   The class works within a general outline of work to be performed, develops work methods and sequences under general supervision.

Essential Job Functions

  • Inspects vehicles and equipment and performs preventive maintenance.
  • Performs highly specialized diagnostic and repair to fire pumps, governor systems, control valves and plumbing on fire apparatus to include aerial and ARRF.
  • Installs and repairs emergency vehicle equipment for police and fire vehicles.
  • Inspects, sets-up, and otherwise prepares new vehicles and equipment to be placed in service.
  • Performs routine minor maintenance such as tire change, timing, adjusting, and lubricating.
  • Performs major repairs such as engine overhaul or transmission repair or replacement.
  • May perform vehicle modification such as installing or removing special equipment, or other modifications.
  • May perform State safety inspections as required.
  • Must have knowledge of NFPA standards.
  • May train or advise less experienced personnel.
  • Performs shop or area maintenance such as general clean up.
  • Prepares documentation for maintenance activities such as repairs, parts used, cost, and other information.
  • Provides advice and assistance to vehicle or equipment operators as necessary.

Minimum Requirements

  • Requires a high school diploma or GED. 

  • Requires a minimum of five (5) years of experience in fire apparatus, police vehicles, automobiles, heavy equipment maintenance and repairs. Must have experience with diagnostics scanning tools or a closely related field.

  • Performs skilled work involving rules/systems but solves problems almost constantly.

  • Performs addition and subtraction, multiplication and division and/or calculates ratios, rates and percents.

  • Reads technical instructions, procedures manuals, and charts to solve practical problems; composes routine and specialized reports and forms; speaks compound sentences using normal grammar and word form.

  • Performs manual and technical tasks requiring a wide range of procedures and requiring intensive understanding of a restricted field or complete familiarity with the functions of a unit or small division of an operating agency; requires normal attention with short periods of concentration for accurate results or occasional exposure to unusual pressure.

  • Requires a valid State of Florida driver license and a satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment. Must have a State of Florida Class A CDL within six (6) months of employment.   

  • Must have and maintain a minimum of five (5) EVT certifications in fire apparatus within eighteen (18) months of employment.  

  • Special skills or equipment certification may be required.

Job Summary
 Skilled CAD/CAM Designer. The ideal candidate will have experience in a manufacturing environment and proficiency in CAM programing and Alpha CAM is a plus.
In this role, your responsibilities will include completing CAD drawings and programs for CNC. Ordering CNC bits. Working with CNC operators to maintain bits, perform daily machine maintenance, ensure CNC systems produce according to CAD programs.
-Train CNC operators
-Troubleshoot errors from CNC machines.
-Make drawings/prints for use on the shop floor.
-Create basic work instructions for CNC operators.
-Generate programs for twin-spindle twin-table CNC routers.
-Manage tooling and inventory.
-Basic to mid-level understanding of G and M codes
-Basic understanding of work coordinates and work offsets
-Develop, test, and improve workflows on both the office side, and on the shop floor

-Looking to expand the capabilities of the shop by taking on new projects and developing new processes(pre-hang, assembled doors)
-Basic knowledge of coding in any language, but VBA a big plus
-Use of/experience with right angle or fourth axis tooling
-Working with team on cosmetic designs and feasibility for manufacturing

  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance
Schedule:
  • 8 hour shift

jobs.title: Houseman/Housekeeping
jobs.description_html:
Job description:

Housekeeper / Houseman
Location: Venus, FL
Pay Rate: $18 per hour

We’re looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Housekeeper/Houseman to support daily operations at a luxury property. This role plays an important part in creating a clean, organized, and welcoming environment for guests. A strong eye for detail, pride in your work, and a genuine commitment to hospitality are key to being successful in this position.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and set up designated areas, ensuring all spaces are clean, organized, and guest-ready.
  • Clean and maintain offices, breakrooms, hallways, restrooms, and select outdoor areas.
  • Dust, mop, vacuum, and disinfect surfaces; restock supplies in restrooms and common areas.
  • Conduct routine inspections of assigned spaces and address cleanliness or maintenance needs promptly.
  • Work with management and maintenance teams on special requests and general inquiries.
  • Report safety concerns or maintenance issues to the appropriate team members.
  • Maintain a flexible schedule, including weekends and holidays when needed.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in housekeeping, hospitality, private clubs, or luxury resort settings is preferred.
  • Familiarity with cleaning tools, equipment, and supplies is helpful.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work well within a team.
  • Must be able to stand for long periods and safely lift, carry, push, and pull up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to work in a range of temperatures, including high heat and cold conditions.
  • Comfortable reading, writing, and speaking English.
  • Clean background

Background check and drug screen is required.

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate
jobs.description_html:
Role Overview:

The Warehouse Associate is responsible for maintaining all stock inventory and pulling orders for manufacturing according to designated work orders by performing the following duties. These duties may vary to include some or all of the following job responsibilities.


Duties/Responsibilities:

· Determines work assignments and material or equipment needs based on written work orders or oral instructions.

· Responsible for order-fulfillment including packaging and banding orders, labeling product, and stacking finished orders on skids.

· May be required to maintain all stock inventories for warehouse daily.

· Maneuvers heavy materials with the use of forklift, pallet and hand truck as required.

· Responsible for unskilled production work on assembly line.

· Loads and Unloads shipping trucks as required.

· Maintains and ensures all machines and equipment are functioning according to established work standards and follows all safety guidelines and regulations.

· Assists shipping area with package procedures, including label printing, as requested.

· Monitors products for quality and uniformity; reports any identified problems to Supervisor/Manager in timely manner.

· May be asked to stand in as a backup for Line Leads as needed.

· Complies with company policies and procedures giving special attention to safety regulations.

· Promotes self-improvement in assigned tasks and always maintains a clean and safe work environment by sweeping, cleaning, and removing trash.

· Performs other related duties as assigned.


Required Skills/Abilities:

· Ability to follow directions and work well in a team.

· Ability to handle materials and equipment in a responsible manner.

· Ability to work in a variety of roles

· Basic understanding of or ability to quickly learn company products and terminology.

· Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

· Excellent customer service and time management skills.

· Ability to perform repetitive tasks.


Physical Requirements and Work Environment:

· Must be able to continuously lift and move up to 75 pounds.

· Must be able to perform physical activities that require considerable use of arms and legs and moving the entire body. This will include climbing, lifting, balancing, walking, carrying, bending, twisting, and stooping.

· Regularly exposed to fumes, allergens, or airborne particles, and outdoor weather conditions.

· May occasionally be exposed to mild chemicals.

· Occasionally exposed to electric powered equipment, conveyor belt and compressed air.

· The noise level in the work environment is moderate to high.

jobs.title: Driver
jobs.description_html:
Box Truck Driver

Job description

Overview
We are seeking a reliable and dedicated Truck Driver to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for transporting goods safely and efficiently to various locations while ensuring excellent customer service. This role requires a strong commitment to safety, adherence to traffic regulations, and the ability to handle heavy lifting and moving tasks.

Duties

  • Operate box trucks, vans, or other delivery vehicles to transport goods to designated locations.
  • Load and unload cargo using pallet jacks and other equipment as necessary.
  • Ensure that all deliveries are made in a timely manner while maintaining high standards of customer service.
  • Conduct pre-trip and post-trip inspections of the vehicle to ensure safety and compliance with regulations.
  • Maintain accurate delivery logs and documentation as required.
  • Communicate effectively with warehouse staff and customers regarding delivery schedules and any potential issues.
  • Assist in moving goods within the warehouse as needed, ensuring efficient organization of inventory.

Requirements

  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record.
  • Experience operating box trucks or vans preferred; experience as a courier or delivery driver is a plus.
  • Ability to perform heavy lifting and moving tasks (up to 50 pounds).
  • Strong customer service skills with the ability to interact positively with clients.
  • Familiarity with warehouse operations and logistics is advantageous.
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Flexibility in working hours, including potential overtime or weekend shifts when necessary.

Join our team today and contribute to our mission of delivering exceptional service while ensuring the safe transportation of goods!

  • Day shift

  • Orlando, FL 32819 (Required)

jobs.title: Senior Workday Integration Developer (Workday Studio, EIB, REST/SOAP, HCM & Finance)
jobs.description_html:
Seeking a highly skilled Workday Integration Developer (official NJM job title) to design, develop, enhance, and support integrations between Workday and enterprise applications.


This role is responsible for delivering scalable, secure, and reliable integration solutions using Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, PECI, Workday Web Services (REST/SOAP), and Report-as-a-Service (RaaS). The ideal candidate possesses deep technical expertise within the Workday ecosystem, a strong understanding of Workday security and tenant management, and a proven track record of implementing enterprise-grade integrations in complex environments.


The successful candidate will partner closely with IT, vendors, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions while ensuring integration performance, data integrity, compliance, and operational stability. This role also serves as a subject matter expert, providing guidance on integration architecture, development standards, testing strategies, and Workday best practices.


Job Responsibilities:


Integration Design & Development

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support Workday integrations utilizing:
    • Workday Studio
    • Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB)
    • Core Connectors
    • Cloud Connect
    • PECI
    • Workday Web Services (REST and SOAP APIs)
  • Develop inbound and outbound integrations between Workday and external systems, including payroll providers, benefits vendors, financial systems, and other enterprise applications.
  • Create and maintain XSLT transformations, XML schemas, and integration mappings to support complex business requirements.
  • Design scalable integration architectures that follow Workday and enterprise integration best practices.
  • Develop and maintain reusable integration components and standards to improve supportability and efficiency.

Workday Configuration & Security

  • Configure and maintain Integration System Users (ISUs), Integration System Security Groups (ISSGs), domain security policies, and related security configurations.
  • Build and maintain custom reports, calculated fields, and Report-as-a-Service (RaaS) solutions supporting integration and reporting requirements.
  • Partner with functional teams to align business process configurations, approvals, and event triggers with integration requirements.

Production Support & Operational Excellence

  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve integration issues across production and non-production environments.
  • Develop robust error handling, auditing, alerting, and recovery processes to ensure reliable operations.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable solutions to recurring issues.
  • Support Workday tenant refreshes, migrations, and release activities, including impact assessments and regression testing.
  • Ensure integration solutions meet organizational standards for security, compliance, performance, and data governance.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Collaborate with HCM, Finance, IT, and external vendors to define requirements and deliver effective integration solutions.
  • Participate in technical design reviews and provide recommendations for improving integration of architecture and operational processes.
  • Mentor junior team members and promote Workday integration development best practices.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, including design specifications, support procedures, configuration details, and data flow diagrams.
  • Stay current with Workday releases, emerging technologies, and integration capabilities to drive continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of Workday Integration development experience.
  • Advanced experience developing integrations using:
    • Workday Studio
    • EIB
    • Core Connectors
    • Workday Web Services (REST/SOAP)
       
  • Strong expertise with XSLT, XML, XPath, and integration design patterns.
  • Deep understanding of Workday HCM, Financial Management, and security architecture.
  • Experience configuring and supporting ISUs, ISSGs, and Workday security frameworks.
  • Experience building calculated fields, custom reports, and RaaS integrations.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience supporting Workday production environments and release management activities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Workday Pro Integrations Certification.
  • Experience with PECI, or other payroll-focused integrations.
  • Experience with Workday Orchestrate.
  • Experience integrating Workday with payroll providers, benefits vendors, financial systems, and other enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with middleware and integration platforms.
  • Experience supporting Workday deployments.
  • Knowledge of enterprise security, compliance, and data privacy requirements related to HCM and Finance systems.

Key Competencies:

  • Workday Integration Architecture
  • Workday Studio Development
  • EIB and Core Connector Configuration
  • REST and SOAP API Development
  • XSLT/XML Transformation Design
  • Workday Security Administration
  • Report Writing and Calculated Fields
  • Troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Technical Documentation
  • Release and Tenant Management
  • Continuous Improvement and Best Practices

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $104,686-$121,638

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Technology Leader, Facility Operations
jobs.description_html:
There’s never been a better time to join NJM!  With a nationally ranked reputation for outstanding customer service and a history that spans more than a century, NJM is a leading provider of worker’s compensation, automobile and homeowners’ insurance in New Jersey. 


Become a member of our team and you’ll be part of company who operates for the sole benefit of its policyholders and is committed to maintaining the highest levels of service.  Team members are offered a competitive compensation.


NJM's Facility Operations Team is seeking a Technology Leader (the official NJM title is Technology Leader, Facility Operations, Senior)  is responsible for the administration, support, integration, and continuous improvement of technology systems that support facility operations, building infrastructure, and maintenance management. This position serves as the primary technical resource for Facility Operations technology platforms, including Building Automation Systems (BAS), Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), access control systems, video surveillance systems, building network infrastructure, industrial communication protocols, and operational software environments.


The Technology Leader works closely with Facility Operations staff, Corporate Information Technology, Security, contractors, and vendors to ensure the reliability, security, and efficiency of facility technology systems. This role combines facility operations knowledge with information technology expertise to support mission-critical building systems and drive operational excellence.


This role does not have any direct reports.   This position is in the West Trenton office 5 days per week with occasional travel to the Hammonton and Parsippany Locations.


 Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.


Operations and Systems Support

·         Serve as the primary lead for Facility Operations technology systems and software platforms.

·         Manage system configurations, user accounts, permissions, and operational settings across supported applications.

·         Coordinate software updates, patches, upgrades, and system migrations with vendors and IT personnel.

·         Monitor facility performance metrics and identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.

·         Administer and maintain computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS), facility management software, and related platforms.

·         Manage FO SharePoint site to update information and provide development enhancements

·         Manage contracts for all software and support / licensing and renewals / negotiations / vendor management

·         Work with vendor management to represent FO on vendor management solutions.

·         Work with HR in support of Workday solutions and integrity of existing data and reporting.

·         Total Solution development / deployment / management

·         Establish and monitor electronic file directory storage and adherence to retention policies.

·         Support of Computer-Aided Facilities Management (CAFM)/Integrated Workplace Management Systems application software implementation, customization, and upgrades.  Process workflow analysis, data migration and cleanup, project management, software configuration, and customization.

o    Provide CAFM design and expert configuration of FM:Systems and AutoCad

o    Implement the software with best practices and develop advanced solutions ensuring quality testing, debugging, and deployment with an eye toward automation.

o    Gather software requirements, and oversee documentation and maintenance of design specifications, architectural diagrams, and process diagrams.

o    Work with vendors to support, troubleshoot and develop new initiatives.

o    Study existing solutions and services and suggest additional areas of service opportunities.

o    Responsible for estimating accurate time for project work and keeping tasks within scope and budget.

·         Work with team members to help support Building Automation Systems, access control systems, video management systems, energy management systems, AV control systems, and related applications to include:

o    Configure, troubleshoot, and optimize building controls, schedules, alarms, trends, and system graphics.

o    Support integration of HVAC, electrical, metering, lighting, and other facility systems into enterprise building platforms.

o    Analyze building performance data and recommend operational improvements.

o    Assist in commissioning, testing, and validation of new building control systems.


Process Improvement

·         Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend process improvements.

·         Collaborate with facility leadership to streamline workflows and enhance service delivery.

·         Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and operational excellence programs.

·         Document business requirements and support implementation of process changes.


Compliance & Documentation

·         Maintain facility records, asset inventories, and technical documentation.

·         Assist with regulatory, environmental, safety, and audit reporting requirements.

·         Support data collection and reporting for sustainability and energy initiatives.

·         Ensure compliance with company policies and facility standards.

·         Ensure disaster recovery and backup procedures are documented and maintained.


Stakeholder Support

·         Serve as a technical resource for facility managers, maintenance teams, and business partners.

·         Coordinate with vendors and contractors regarding system integrations and reporting requirements.

·         Provide user training and support for facility-related software applications.


Data Analytics and Reporting

·         Develop meaningful operational reports and dashboards for management and facility personnel.

·         Analyze system trends, alarms, energy usage, maintenance performance, and equipment data.

·         Collaborate with stakeholders to identify actionable insights and process improvements. 


Project Management and Technology Implementation

·         Participate in facility construction, renovation, and technology deployment projects.

·         Review system designs, specifications, submittals, and control sequences. Coordinate implementation of new technology solutions and system upgrades.

·         Support acceptance testing, commissioning activities, and turnover documentation.

·         Ensure technology projects align with business, operational, and cybersecurity requirements. 


Training and Technology Leadership

·         Provide technical guidance and training to Facility Operations staff.

·         Stay current with emerging facility technologies, smart building platforms, and industry trends.

·         Recommend solutions that improve reliability, efficiency, and operational effectiveness.

·         Serve as a technology advisor to Facility Operations leadership. 

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.


Education & Experience:

·         Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Engineering Technology, Computer Science, Facilities Management, or related discipline.

·         Minimum 5 years of experience supporting technology systems in facilities, building automation, industrial controls, systems integration, or related environments.

·         Experience administering enterprise software applications and technical systems.

·         Experience supporting mission-critical operational environments.

·         3-5 years of relevant experience in financial, administrative, or operational support.

·         Experience supporting smart buildings or critical facility environments.

·         Experience integrating BAS, security, and CMMS platforms.

·         Experience with cloud-based facility management systems.

·         Experience working with contractors, controls vendors, and system integrators. 


Skills and Competencies:

·         Strong attention to detail with a high degree of accuracy

·         Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel (including Pivot Tables)

·         Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills

·         Effective verbal and written communication skills

·         Strong written and verbal communication skills.

·         Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

·         Strong customer service and relationship management abilities.

·         Excellent organizational and documentation skills.

·         Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences 


Preferred Technical Knowledge:

·         Working knowledge of Building Automation Systems (BAS).

·         Understanding of HVAC controls and building systems operation.

·         Knowledge of building control protocols including:

o    Siemens Desigo

o    Microsoft SharePoint

o    Acuity Brands nLight Sensor View

o    C-Cure Access Management System

o    Autodesk AutoCAD 


Leadership Expectations:

·         Act as the technical subject matter expert for Facility Operations technology platforms.

·         Champion continuous improvement and innovation within facility systems.

·         Build effective partnerships with Information Technology, Security, Engineering, and Operations teams.

·         Promote standardized, secure, and reliable technology practices.

·         Drive the adoption of data-driven facility management strategies.

NJM reserves the right at any time to amend, add or delete any aspect of the job description for this position based on business needs.

Pay Range: $100,402-$116,574

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

jobs.description_html:
The Functional Analyst, Senior is responsible for gathering, analyzing, and documenting business or system processes and requirements for NJM’s applications. This role will work closely with all Project, Business team members and Solution Owners throughout the project lifecycle.


This role may be required to lead other team members and coordinate work efforts, assist in problem and solution scoping, effectively communicate requirements, and may get involved in quality assurance.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:


Strategy Analysis: Consistently support the alignment of business strategy with system implementations by assisting in the

support of the FA team.


Business Analysis/Elicitation Skills : Consistently ensure that the business need is understood and articulated clearly by

performing, and assist in supporting the FA team members.


Requirements Life Cycle Management: Consistently achieving deliveries that reflect business outcomes by collaborating with

the portfolio manager and delivery team by performing and assisting in supporting the FA team members.


Leadership and Core Competencies: Consistently demonstrates strong commitment to continuous development, and the

ability to assist in supporting the FA Team within and outside the project context and demonstrates the core competencies.


Required Qualifications:


• Good knowledge and experience of different requirements gathering tools and techniques (use cases, diagramming, process

modeling, interviews, workshops, etc.).

• Good knowledge and experience working in Agile delivery methodology (SAFE etc.).

• Experience working with Insurance policy platform – Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco

• Experience in Personal Lines or Commercial Insurance domain and/or ISO admitted lines.

• Experience using JIRA and Confluence tools to document user stories.

• Some experience leading and coordinating teamwork efforts.

jobs.title: PL Product Development Portfolio Lead
jobs.description_html:
General Summary: 
The PL Product Development Portfolio Lead is responsible for effectively leading the PL Product Development portfolio.  This Lead will drive Product Development execution from ideation to design. The role partners with Product Development leadership, senior business leaders, Actuarial, State Management, Underwriting, Claims, Marketing, Finance and to transform the business by driving strategic priorities that support profitable growth across the portfolio.

 

Leadership

·         Actively contributes to execution of Product Development initiatives through collaborative leadership, conflict resolution, resource prioritization and roadmap planning.

·         Lead discussions with business owners and senior stakeholders to define priorities, clarify goals, and support strategic decision making.

·         Promote collaboration, alignment and change management across stakeholder groups through transparent communication of roadmaps, status, issues and risks.

·         Serve as a change leader and role model through influence, credibility and continuous improvement.

 

Portfolio Management

·         Serve as a trusted partner to Product Development leadership by aligning priorities, scope and resources with strategic objectives.

·         Develop and maintain product roadmaps, dashboards and portfolio views that reflect strategic priorities and implementation timelines.

·         Act as the central point of contact for Product Development initiatives, ensuring stakeholders remain informed regarding status, dependencies, priorities, and upcoming changes.

·         Lead creation, evaluation and recommendation of new products and enhancements for assigned lines of business.

 

Communication

·         Present product strategies, recommendations, roadmaps and implementation status to leadership and stakeholder groups, including executive audiences.

·         Build and maintain strong relationships across Actuarial, Underwriting, Claims, Contact Center, Finance, Marketing and Business Process teams.

·         Facilitate discussions to resolve concerns, gain consensus and communicate product changes to policyholders and internal staff.

 


 

Process Improvement and Risk/Issue Management

·         Identify, assess and manage risks across product initiatives and implementation efforts.

·         Conduct competitor and market research to identify opportunities and address consumer pain points.

·         Drive continuous improvement by recommending process enhancements, prioritization changes and innovative solutions that support strategic objectives.

 

Required Qualifications

·         Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Actuarial Science, Data Analytics, Economics, Finance or related quantitative business discipline preferred.

·         Minimum five years of experience in actuarial, insurance product analytics, product management or a related role with increasing responsibility.

·         One to two years of successful experience in a Product Development role within the property and casualty insurance industry.

·         Strong analytical, critical thinking, project leadership and problem-solving skills.

·         Advanced Excel and database skills; proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

·         Excellent written, verbal and presentation communication skills.

 

Preferred Qualifications

·         Demonstrated success leading insurance product enhancements from concept through implementation.

·         Experience presenting recommendations to senior leadership and executive-level stakeholders.

·         Knowledge of Personal Lines products, regulatory environments and market trends.

Do you have a passion for customer service? Are you looking for a company that offers you more? Come talk to NJM Insurance Group, a 6-time recipient of the Forbes Best Employers in New Jersey about joining our Contact Center!

Join a best-in-class team that has been certified by J.D. Power for providing personal lines customers with an exceptional Auto Claims Experience - 8 years in a row!

Our Contact Center team enjoy:

  • Salary: $51,120.55

  • Company paid training and professional state licensure.

  • Potential annual bonus incentive worth up to 7.5% of your first year’s base salary

  • Hybrid work schedule once training is completed

  • An outstanding benefits package (outlined below), including a 401k with a dollar for dollar match up to 8%

The Opportunity

NJM is seeking talented, friendly customer service orientated professionals to become Licensed Account Representatives in our nationally recognized contact center. As part of your NJM experience, you will receive top-quality paid training to prepare you for this position in personal lines insurance. On our team, you will play an important role in continuing to build upon the long-standing reputation of delivering award winning service to NJM policyholders by assisting them with setting up new policies, and completing policy transactions, as well as general coverage and billing questions.

Available Shift(s):

Day Shift

  • Monday-Friday (9:45AM - 6PM) and every Saturday (8:30AM- 4:45PM)

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Strong computer and navigation skills including proficiency in Microsoft Outlook and Word

  • Accurate keyboarding skills

  • Superior listening skills

  • Strong multi-tasking ability

  • Prior customer service or contact center experience

jobs.title: Quality Engineer
jobs.description_html:
As a Quality Engineer, you'll be responsible for functional and automation testing of NJM’s business applications. We are looking for an innovative Software Quality Engineer who can leverage Generative AI technologies to enhance testing effectiveness, efficiency, and coverage while maintaining human oversight and accountability.


In this role, you will design, build, and maintain automated test suites across different applications, working closely with Developers, Functional Analysts, Product Owners, and Project Managers to ensure reliable, high-quality releases.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Work in an agile, small team environment with a focus on speed and quality
  • Review business and technical requirements to develop comprehensive test strategies, test plans, and test cases
  • Design, develop, and maintain reusable test automation scripts to enable faster regression/delivery cycles
  • Perform manual and automated testing to ensure alignment with software requirements, risk assessments, and quality standards
  • Perform backend validation, webservices, and API testing using appropriate tools
  • Utilize Generative AI tools to optimize test coverage, prioritize regression testing, enhance defect detection, and accelerate root-cause analysis
  • Leverage AI-powered coding assistants to design, develop, maintain, and optimize automated test scripts, frameworks, and supporting utilities
  • Apply AI-assisted analysis to improve test coverage, regression scope and accelerate defect root-cause analysis.
  • Maintain and improve quality engineering, functional, technical and professional skills through continuous learning based on latest tools and technologies.

Required Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience in software delivery, including 2+ years in Quality Engineering, QA, software testing, or test automation.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent.
  • Experience in software engineering with hand-on coding proficiency in any language such as Java, Python, C# or JavaScript.
  • Practical experience using Generative AI tools to support testing activities
  • Demonstrated automation-first mindset with experience in working with scalable automated testing solutions.
  • Hands‑on experience with test automation frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar tools.
  • Expertise in SQL, API testing, and backend/system validation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in P&C Insurance Domain
  • Experience using Agentic AI–based testing tools to support automated test script generation, execution, and maintenance
  • Experience with test automation tools like Selenium and Playwright

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $83,741-$97,178

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Commercial Lines Distribution Rep/Sr. Distribution Rep - Maryland/Delaware Territory
jobs.description_html:
Formal NJM Title: Commercial Lines Distribution Representative / Sr. Distribution Representative - Maryland / Delaware Territory

Department Name:  Commercial Lines Sales

Position Reports To:  Administrator, CL Sales
Job Location: Maryland market


General Summary: 

Do you have a strong network with property and casualty insurance brokers in the greater Maryland / Delaware area? Do you have prior experience in Commercial Lines Sales, Commercial Lines Production Underwriting, or as a Broker Relationship Manager in Commercial Lines? If so, this is the perfect opportunity for you! This position offers a generous base of $90,000 to $135,000 (commensurate with relevant experience) with a quarterly and annual incentive opportunity that has the potential to add a significant amount to your total compensation annually. You are also eligible for our incredible benefits package, which includes a 401k with a dollar for dollar match up to 8% with immediate vesting and an additional employer contribution after the first year that grows to an additional 6% over 15 years of service!

NJM Insurance Group, a leading mid-Atlantic property casualty carrier, seeks to expand distribution partner relationships, new business, and products in Maryland and Delaware. As part of that expansion, we are seeking an experienced Distribution Representative in Commercial Lines. This Distribution Representative will be based in the greater Maryland market (southern Delaware or Maryland strongly preferred), so that they can work closely with existing and new distribution partners to secure new business for the organization.


Distribution Representatives meet regularly with agency/brokerage distribution partners in pursuit of additional business in the small, mid and large-size markets. The right candidate would already possess key commercial agency/brokerage relationships, presence and credibility in the Maryland / Delaware territory. These relationships will specifically be utilized to appoint and grow our distribution partner network in the region consistent with NJM’s exclusive distribution model.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 

  • Match existing Maryland / Delaware agent relationships and books of business opportunities with those of NJM
  • Based on this analysis recommend for appointment new commercial lines distribution partners in the territory. Ultimately through the review process sign up all appropriate agents based on the strength of these current relationships
  • Pursue, upsell, cross-sell, recapture opportunities with agencies/brokers
  • Coordinate New Business Proposal Meetings on key accounts to agencies and brokers; present NJM optional plans
  • Key account pre-renewal discussion with agencies
  • Review competitor plans with NJM underwriting to ensure best pricing offered
  • Lead annual planning process. Implement and monitor throughout year
  • Review underwriting appetite and services with agencies and brokers
  • Attend POS (Point of Sale) when possible with agencies/brokers
  • Assist with contracting new agencies/brokers
  • Assist with onboarding and terminating agencies/brokers as required
  • Maintain agency/broker profiles
  • Attend corporate functions including Corporate Giving, Chamber of Commerce and Marketing events


Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Sales oriented with experience and successful track record selling standard commercial lines products in the noted territories
  • Ability to communicate orally and in writing with others to explain complex issues
  • Full knowledge of all commercial line’s standard insurance products and usages
  • Ability to manage multiple clients, tasks, and requests
  • Adequate knowledge of rating procedures, coverages, and industry operations to effectively manage, maintain, and write assigned client and prospect lists
  • Knowledge of insurance markets and reference to markets
  • Knowledge of insurance underwriting procedures
  • Results oriented with the ability to meet strategic goals as required for the assigned territory
  • Excellent analytical, problem resolution, negotiating and project management skills
  • Professional, committed, and self-motivated with the ability to focus on daily tasks
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office – Outlook, Word, Excel 


Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred (High School Diploma or GED required)
  • Minimum 5 years’ commercial insurance company experience in insurance industry, specifically in either Commercial Lines Marketing, Sales, Production Underwriting, Distribution and/or Relationship Management
  • Specific knowledge of the commercial lines in the Maryland / Delaware marketplace as it relates to new agent appointments and account opportunities


Required Certifications or Licenses: 

  • Must maintain and remain current with their producers’ state licenses and continuing education credits. If you do not currently have an active license, you will be expected to obtain one within a defined period of time.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $0-$0

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer - SCCM / Endpoint Management
jobs.description_html:
The Infrastructure Systems Architect focuses on design configuration, security and the health of NJM’s systems management solutions. This position provides directions for workstation client provisioning as well as maintaining systems at current patch versions.  The position is also responsible for creating, operating, and monitoring solutions to secure NJM’s systems and data including on-premises end user computing technologies while supporting IT and business objectives.

This role involves collaborating with various IT teams, business partners, and project managers to identify requirements, develop implementation plans, and deliver solutions.  As a senior position it is expected guidance in all facets (technical or enterprise knowledge) will be provided for lower-level team members. The official NJM job title is Infrastructure Systems Architect.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
 

Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM) Administration

  • System upgrades and future state planning
  • System health monitoring
  • Create and maintain Windows workstation Operating System build procedures
  • Device driver management for authorized hardware
  • Enablement and monitoring of Windows workstation client patch management
  • Deployment of application packages
  • Software package availability, workstation builds and system updates communications

Infrastructure Systems Administration

  • Provide oversight and assistance to team members related to systems management platform administration
  • Work closely with BU/software requestor aiding technical expertise with new system implementations
  • Recommend new and emerging technologies to solve business problems
  • Participate in yearly Disaster Recovery exercise
  • Client computing hardware evaluations
  • Install, configure, test and maintain systems, application software and infrastructure tools.

Infrastructure Projects

  • Coordination and deployment of Patch Management approved security and software updates
  • Perform yearly Microsoft license inventory for true-up positions
  • Fulfill ad hoc client configuration deployment and reporting requests
  • Serve as a key team member using existing technical knowledge and have the skills to perform specific projects independently
  • Maintain the highest levels of systems and infrastructure availability
  • Interact with other engineers and management to recommend areas of improvement for operational efficiency
  • Work closely with technical and non-technical personnel within and across NJM departments and vendors
  • Accountable for managing all assigned tasks and projects

Support

  • Provide Tier 3 client problem support and troubleshooting for Windows Operating Systems and application software package deployment
  • Create and maintain documentation including configuration specifics and procedures, for implementation and ongoing operation/maintenance of infrastructure solutions
  • Provide technical support for all IT Infrastructure enterprise systems
  • Address ticket assignments in a timely manner

Documentation

  • Prepare documentation for consumption by peers and co-workers is complete, accurate, and available.
  • Ensure documentation formatting utilizes standard formats and templates where made available.
  • Maintain appropriate information in engineering design documents, implementation plans, service calls, change control records and work order problem tickets.

Required Qualifications:

  • 15+ Years as a Systems Engineer and SCCM Administrator
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent work experience required
     

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Microsoft 365 Endpoint Administrator Associate Certification
  • Microsoft 365 Mobility and Security Certification
  • Microsoft 365 Identity and Services Certification

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $144,643-$167,898

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Appraisal Vendor Coordinator
jobs.description_html:
The Appraisal Vendor Coordinator oversees and works with NJM shops to ensure processes are followed and customer issues are resolved.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a liaison between various General Claims departments on repair processes
  • Ensure NJM shops complete required processes to keep customers and NJM informed of repair status
  • Provide updates to customers and Claims staff of status of repair escalations
  • Document all issues into NJM’s Vendor Tracker
  • Serve as a point of contact for Enterprise Rent-a-Car to monitor rental average for NJM shops
  • Recover reimbursements from NJM shops due to excess rental or corrective repairs needed
  • Address all Customer Surveys needing attention involving negative shop performance and/or customer dissatisfaction
  • Review estimates from NJM Staff and Independent Companies as part of a bi-monthly Audit
  • Perform Paint & Material calculations to resolve cost issues with shops
  • Provide monthly report on shops not following required update process
  • Complete arbitration responses on a monthly basis

Required Qualifications:

  • Strong communication skills
  • Minimum 3 years repair shop or Auto Appraiser experience
  • Ability to prioritize workload 
  • High School Diploma or GED

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with NJM’s Vendor Portal

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $77,698-$90,252

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. jobs.title: First Notice of Loss Associate
jobs.description_html:
The First Notice of Loss Associate serves as the first point of contact for policyholders, claimants or other parties reporting claims. They are responsible for addressing customer inquiries concerning the claim process and collecting essential details about the incident, to accurately and efficiently establish new Auto, Property and Commercial claims.  


Available Shift(s):

  • Monday-Friday (9:30am-5:45pm) with one Saturday per month (8:30am-4:30pm)
  • Monday-Friday (10:45am-7:00pm) with one Saturday per month (8:30am-4:30pm)

Salary: $44,994.95


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • Receive initial reports of loss or damage from policyholders, claimants or other parties.
  • Accurately process information into the system for assignment to an adjuster.
  • Address customers’ questions and concerns related to the claims process and procedures and offer clear instructions on the next steps.
  • Determine appropriate coverage and complete necessary follow-ups in a timely manner.
  • Navigate systems with proficiency to access appropriate information to service callers.
  • Perform additional duties within the department, as needed.

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to build rapport with customers and demonstrate empathy during what may be a stressful time
  • Excellent listening skills
  • Ability to navigate multiple programs simultaneously.
  • Accurate keyboarding and data entry skills
  • High School Diploma or GED

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. jobs.title: Litigation Processor
jobs.description_html:
The Litigation Processor is responsible for providing clerical support to the General Claims Legal Department by reviewing, analyzing, and processing incoming complaints directed to the Company.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provide support to staff attorneys in processing complaints.
  • Provide support to the PIP Litigation team in processing PIP arbitration demands.
  • Provide support as needed to FNOL (First Notice of Loss) Dept in taking claims.
  • Receive, analyze, and process complaints, determine type of lawsuit, and prepare investigation file accordingly.  Assign trail adjuster, submit complaint to staff attorney for review.
  • Process various types of legal letters to defense firms and insureds.
  • Maintain Legal Exchange (electronic billing site) by creating matters, closing matter and processing attorney invoices for payment.
  • Periodic telephone communications with insureds, plaintiff counsel and defense firms regarding the status of legal pleadings.
  • Update Claim Center to reflect all litigation information.
  • Process incoming mail and import in to Claim Center for further review.
  • Review the investigation file material, select appropriate document information, and electronically send to defense firms.
  • Obtain additional underwriting documentation such as declaration sheets, policy jackets and police reports.
  • Process vendor invoices for payment through Claim Center financial system.

Required Qualifications:

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to meet deadlines in a high-volume environment due to time sensitivity of legal pleadings.
  • The ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Computer knowledge and strong data entry skills.
  • The ability to manage time and tasks effectively and efficiently.
  • Must have good typing skills.
  • Strong knowledge/experience of MS Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Skilled in problem solving and as well as decision making.
  • Detail oriented as well as the ability to multitask.
  • Minimum High School Diploma or GED equivalent.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $46,950-$54,546

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: I.T. Data Administration Intern
jobs.description_html:
Consider joining NJM’s 2027 Paid Summer Intern Program!

 

This robust program includes:

  • Lunch with leaders; featuring insights from an Executive Leadership Team member, and a former NJM intern. Opportunity to network with leaders and professionals across multiple departments.
  • Contribute to and collaborate on meaningful work within your department.
  • Team Intern Project: Research and present a business question to NJM leaders.
  • NJM Seminars designed to build essential professional skills and expand knowledge of the insurance industry.
  • Professional headshots to help enhance your personal brand.
  • Intern Fun:
    • Night at the Trenton Thunder Game
    • Volunteer activities to give back to the community in which we serve
    • Networking and social events with fellow interns, former interns, and leaders

Overview

NJM Insurance Group is accepting applications for our 2027 Summer Internship Program. We are looking for an analytical and inquisitive intern to join our I.T. Data Administration team.


Job Responsibilities:

Expand knowledge of data engineering and analysis and:


  • Analyze source repositories and create database queries to retrieve necessary information.
  • Build appropriate data objects to consistently extract, transform or load information across company ecosystem.
  • Construct concise and appealing visualizations to provide insights to end users.
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis on incoming business requests to determine proper course of action.
  • Explore edge technologies (alternate software or new libraries) and present advantages to the team.
  • Participate in software as a service/ integrated technology configurations and management:
  • Review and document existing external software providers while assisting efforts to further enhance business use cases.
  • Independently research or communicate with vendors to understand new features while spotlighting appropriate capabilities to internal staff.
  • Coordinate technical discussions between internal and external resources to open or resolve company requests.
  • Prototype new technologies or additional use cases of existing SAS offerings.

Required Skills & Qualifications:


  • Currently Pursuing bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT or equivalent
  • Demonstrate knowledge in one or more informational / analytical programming languages such as SQL or Python.
  • Demonstrate knowledge in one or more database technologies such as MS SQL Server, Postgres, Oracle, MySQL, MongoDB, Databricks, Redshift, Snowflake.
  • Demonstrate knowledge in one of more analytical / reporting software packages such as Power-BI, Tableau, Qlik, Looker, DOMO
  • Demonstrate aptitude for data engineering / analytics
  • Learning – Ability to learn quickly (functional and technical aptitudes) and apply those learnings
  • Minimum of 3.0 GPA (3.5 or above is preferred)
  • Commutable to our West Trenton, New Jersey office

The IT Data Administration intern position can pay $21-$25 hour.

Starting Rate: $0

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.description_html:
Here at NJM, we are seeking a Client Services Associate in our West Trenton office. The Client Service Associate is primarily responsible for answering inbound phone calls, providing general information and welcoming visitors. They handle incoming calls and transfer customers to the appropriate department or individual. This role also involves greeting visitors in the lobby and maintaining the reception area. This opportunity is hybrid and does require you to work 3 days in the office and 2 days at home.


Schedule: Monday to Friday (12:45PM-9:00PM). This includes a 15% shift differential.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • Answer and direct incoming calls promptly and professionally.
  • Proficiently utilize available resources and ask relevant questions to determine the proper destination of a call.
  • Answer questions and address the needs of internal and external customers. 
  • Greet walk-in lobby customers in a timely and professional manner.
  • Perform general receptionist duties.
  • Learn and perform additional administrative tasks which support the Contact Center.

  • Excellent customer service and verbal communication skills

jobs.title: Commercial Claims Specialist II - Hybrid
jobs.description_html:
The Commercial Claims department is seeking a Commercial Claims Specialist II. A Claims Specialist handles all lines of Commercial business including coverage issues and litigation exposures. The Commercial Claims Specialist II is a disciplined self-starter with outstanding communication & customer service skills. Has developed coverage skills, negotiation experience, and is a creative & analytic proactive problem solver. Also, can prioritize work assignments, is an independent worker but can work as a member of the team. Individuals should be decisive, "own" the decisions they make, and the work produced, responsible, dependable and developing presentation skills.


This position can be based in our Hammonton or West Trenton, NJ Offices.


Once the full time training in the office is complete , the schedule will be Hybrid; 3 days in the office and 2 days at home. There is no option for fully remote.


Schedule: Monday-Friday, specific hours are subject to selected start times between 8:00am-9:00am pending supervisory approval.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • Regular reviews of all open exposures, including input from the supervisor as needed, focusing on the investigation and the accuracy of the file reserves. Has experience with coverage issues requiring Reservation of Rights and coverage declination letters.
  • Investigate, review, analyze and evaluate the assigned property damage and bodily injury claims expeditiously (and if necessary, through the litigation process) in preparation for prompt resolution.  Will keep the supervisor informed on claims progress as needed.
  • Has experience with coverage issues requiring Reservation of Rights and coverage declination letters.

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • A minimum 3-8 years of claims experience, this should include handling litigated and non-litigated property damage and bodily injury claims related to BOP, CA and CGL policies.
  • Initiates appropriate action to review coverage and proactively resolve all claim exposures in a manner consistent with existing law, license and company guidelines.
  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Other insurance designations.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $81,124-$94,141

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. jobs.title: Maintenance Operator - 2nd or 3rd Shift
jobs.description_html:
There’s never been a better time to join NJM!  With a nationally ranked reputation for outstanding customer service and a history that spans more than a century, NJM is a leading provider of worker’s compensation, automobile, and homeowner’s insurance in New Jersey. It is an exciting time to join NJM as we are expanding into other states.      

                                                                                                                                            Become a member of our team and you’ll be part of company who operates for the benefit of its policyholders and is committed to maintaining the highest levels of service.  Team members are offered a competitive compensation package and benefits including: a 401k plan, health coverage, a generous paid time off plan, and much more!  


NJM is seeking a Maintenance Operator (depending on experience this has the flexibility to be filled at the Senior level). The Maintenance Operator will assist with the daily operation of all facility systems, consisting of HVAC, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire suppression, building automation, and backup power systems. Provides instruction and guidance to other staff. Performing routine preventive maintenance and repairs on all facility systems and equipment. Overseeing and working alongside outside contractors on various jobs and PM assignments. Performs minor work assignments as needed on their own or with other maintenance staff. Monitors facility systems by computer, visual inspections, and logged readings. On call as needed when issues or emergencies arise. Works closely with supervision keeping them advised of operations and unresolved situations. Maintains and repairs numerous varying types of equipment.


Hours:

2nd shift: Monday to Friday: 3PM to 11:30PM with a 10% shift differential.

or

3rd Shift: Sunday to Thursday: 11:00PM to 7:30AM with a 15% shift differential.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • Maintain facility work flow through established work order system, and updating PM schedules and assignments.
  • Routinely monitor the computer-based work order program for service requests that are entered and report any upset conditions to Supervisor.
  • Demonstrate a high regard for timely response and clear communication in response to situations that could impact business operations.
  • Monitor conditions and make adjustments to building mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection systems.
  • Perform visual inspections of mechanical and electrical rooms and mission critical equipment and communicate any concerns or problems to the shift supervisor.
  • Oversee the shift operators monitoring of conditions and establish practices and routines to confirm systems are operating normally.
  • Identify potential system problems or abnormalities which may impact mission critical systems or the workplace environment
  • Serve as a first responder to emergency conditions caused by utility failures or malfunctions of mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection systems.
  • Keep management informed in a timely manner of all situations which may impact business operations.
  • Organize and maintain all maintenance records and technical documentation related to NJM systems.
  • Keep current and accurate as-built drawings of systems, bills of materials, system maintenance and repair records, and equipment inventories.
  • Document any contractor onsite, operating conditions, equipment status, incidents and system changes made in daily log entries.
  • Supervise upkeep and housekeeping of equipment rooms and other areas under the control of the maintenance department.
  • Confirm that all service vendor contract obligations are being met.
  • Proactively study, review, and maintain a working knowledge and understanding of the mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection systems throughout the facility.

jobs.description_html:
NJM is seeking a Litigation Claims Adjuster – Bodily Injury (Trial Prep Rep is the official NJM title). A Trial Prep Rep is responsible for appropriately managing and resolving litigation claims, which includes reviewing and analyzing newly assigned files, coordinating with defense counsel, attending court proceedings as necessary, and ensuring all actions are consistent with company guidelines and applicable law. 

Compensation: This role may be filled at a Level II or Senior level based on skills, experience and credentials.

Level II: $67,542.80-$102,805.30

Sr. Level: $84,609.85-$111,913.10

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Prepare required reports necessary for evaluation and conclusion of litigated claims.

  • Communicate effectively with trial counsel and attend legal proceedings as appropriate.

  • Review, update, and evaluate assigned files on an ongoing basis with supervisor and establish reserves as necessary.

  • Review and analyze newly assigned litigation files to determine appropriate action and additional investigation necessary.

Required Qualifications:

  • 2 years of prior bodily injury claims experience is required

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

  • Strong multi-tasking, problem-solving and decision-making skills

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Ability to juggle multiple priorities and manage time effectively

  • Technical aptitude, including a working knowledge with Microsoft Office

  • Ability to think critically, use resources and seek answers
