jobs.title: Accident and Health Senior Claims Specialist (Provider XS/ESL)
jobs.description_html:
This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance.  We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture.  As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

AXIS is seeking an experienced Accident & Health Senior Claims Specialist to provide technical claims expertise and oversight across a diverse product portfolio. This role partners with Third-Party Administrators (TPAs), Managing General Underwriters (MGUs), underwriting, actuarial, legal, compliance, and operations to support consistent claims administration, strong partner oversight, and regulatory compliance.

The position is primarily focused on Employer Stop Loss, HMO/Managed Care, Medical Excess, and Provider Excess products, while also supporting the broader Specialty Accident & Health portfolio.

What You'll Do

Serve as a senior claims resource for complex, high-severity, and escalated matters, including appeals and authority referrals.

• Conduct claims and operational audits of TPAs and MGUs, report findings, and monitor corrective actions.

• Support due diligence reviews and onboarding of delegated claims partners.

• Monitor compliance with delegated authority, service standards, and claims handling guidelines.

• Coordinate responses to complaints, regulatory inquiries, attorney correspondence, carrier reviews, and benefit interpretation requests.

• Analyze claims and operational data to identify trends, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities.

• Partner across functions to support product performance, business initiatives, and process improvements.

What You'll Bring

• 4–6 years of relevant Accident & Health claims experience.

• Strong expertise in Employer Stop Loss, HMO/Managed Care, Medical Excess, and Provider Excess products.

• Experience overseeing TPAs, MGUs, delegated claims operations, and claims audits.

• Knowledge of medical claims, provider reimbursement, cost containment, exposure evaluation, and reserving.

• Knowledge of ERISA and applicable state claims handling requirements.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and relationship-management skills.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent industry experience; insurance designation preferred.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Employer Stop Loss, HMO/Managed Care, Medical Excess, and Provider Excess products, along with working knowledge of Specialty Accident & Health lines, including Leisure Travel, Excess Accident, Pet, Firefighter Line of Duty, Limited Medical Benefits, and Voluntary Benefits.

Work Environment • Hybrid schedule with an expectation of three days per week in the office. • Periodic travel within the U.S. and Canada to support audits and business initiatives.

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range is $95,000–$130,000, based on experience and location. AXIS also offers incentive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; health and wellness programs; retirement plans; tuition reimbursement; and paid time off. Accident & Health Senior Claims Specialist

Why AXIS?

Join a growing Accident & Health organization where you can influence claims quality, strengthen delegated partner oversight, and contribute across a broad portfolio of products. This role offers meaningful collaboration with experienced business partners and the opportunity to help shape claims practices and operational improvements.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Job Description: North America Programs/MGA Cash and Receivable Lead Manager

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

This role will be part of the North America Insurance Premium Accounting team.  The team is responsible for collection of all premium receivables and cash allocations for the Insurance premium written on US writing companies – including Canada.  This team is instrumental in making sure premiums are paid timely and are key to the cash flow of the company overall.

What will you do in this role?

  • Lead the North America Insurance Premium Accounting team - providing guidance on how to resolve differences/issues on cash allocations and premium receivables and assist in escalation process if required.

  • Ensure the team is following up on premium receivables and cash variances as expected.  Escalate items where internal/external contacts are not responding timely

  • Work in conjunction with the internal departments and external brokers to research and resolve any outstanding issues and/or inquiries.

  • Communicate with brokers and Axis internal customers on past due premium receivables.

  • Review the overdue receivables report produced by the BPO vendor and work with Axis internal departments and/or brokers to resolve discrepancies.

  • Track the entry of the cash receipts into the premium accounting system by the BPO vendor daily while ensuring adherence to established process and delivery standards.  Ensuring controls are being followed by the BPO vendor for cash processing.

  • Month-end close processing for the legacy system

  • Review and approve bank reconciliations produced by the BPO vendor

  • Review and authorize disbursement requests.

  • Assist the BPO team in researching issues.

  • Conduct other duties as assigned.

You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.

About You:

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.

What you need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance or equivalent work experience.

  • Minimum of 5 years P&C insurance industry experience

  • Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of related automated financial systems.

  • Demonstration of strong software skills including Excel, Access, and Outlook.

What we prefer you to have:

  • Excellent communication, analytical and proven problem-solving skills with a commitment to meeting daily, weekly, and monthly deadlines.

  • Hands-on manager that will dive into details

  • Detail oriented, deadline driven, organized, able to handle multiple tasks while working independently or as part of a team.

  • Highly motivated and dedicated to contributing to the growth and success of the company.

  • Problem solver – identification, analysis, recommend, implement.

  • Ability to prioritize and learn quickly.

  • BPO management experience or equivalent work experience

Role Factors:

In this role, you will typically be required to:

  • Be in the office 3 days per week – with the exception of the last week of the month for month-end

  • Be flexible during month-end with higher work demands

What we offer:

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $95,000 to $115,000. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. 

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.  

Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is Exempt for FLSA purposes.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Job Description: Strategic Sourcing Operations Lead

About the Team
 

The Strategic Sourcing & Procurement team helps AXIS make informed supplier, sourcing, contracting, and purchasing decisions. The team partners with business stakeholders to manage supplier value, improve procurement discipline, support contract governance, and identify opportunities to reduce cost, risk, and complexity across the organization.


How does this role contribute to our collective success?
 

The Strategic Sourcing Operations Lead supports effective procurement decision-making by providing analysis, sourcing coordination, supplier research, contract administration, and stakeholder support across assigned spend categories. The role helps AXIS improve savings visibility, contract discipline, supplier performance, and procurement governance while building future capability within the Strategic Sourcing & Procurement function.
 

What will you do in this role?

  • Supporting Category Managers with category plans, sourcing pipelines, savings trackers, supplier documentation, and leadership-ready updates.

  • Coordinating sourcing activities by managing documentation, supplier communications, timelines, bid analysis, stakeholder meetings, and recommendation materials.

  • Analyzing spend, supplier, contract, and pricing information to identify savings, consolidation, risk reduction, and process improvement opportunities.

  • Managing contract administration activities by tracking renewals, expiration dates, notice periods, pricing obligations, service commitments, and key contractual requirements.

  • Preparing contract summaries, renewal options, supplier comparison materials, total cost summaries, dashboards, reports, and other decision-support materials.

  • Conducting supplier research and market scans to identify potential vendors, alternative supply options, emerging providers, market trends, and supplier risks.

  • Supporting supplier onboarding, due diligence, performance tracking, issue follow-up, supplier business reviews, and compliance documentation.

  • Serving as a day-to-day procurement operations contact for assigned internal stakeholders and helping them navigate sourcing, contracting, onboarding, and procurement processes.

  • Maintaining accurate procurement records, templates, process documentation, trackers, systems data, and audit-ready supporting materials.

  • Escalating complex commercial, contractual, supplier performance, governance, or risk-related matters to Category Managers or senior procurement professionals when appropriate.

  • You may also be asked to perform other reasonable duties, as required, to support the needs of the business.


About You
 

What we’re looking for:
 

  • Possess a bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, Operations, or a related field, or demonstrate equivalent relevant experience.

  • Demonstrate experience supporting procurement, sourcing, supplier management, contract administration, finance, consulting, operations, data analytics, or a related business support function.

  • Able to analyze data, prepare reports, identify trends, and translate findings into practical business insights and recommendations.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, records, and stakeholder requests with accuracy and consistent follow-through.

  • Demonstrate experience working with contracts, suppliers, purchasing processes, business stakeholders, or highly transactional operational work.

  • Able to communicate clearly with internal stakeholders and suppliers, including summarizing information, documenting requirements, and preparing concise materials for review.

  • Able to work independently on routine and lower-risk matters while recognizing when to escalate complex commercial, contractual, supplier, or risk-related issues.

  • Demonstrate a service-oriented, collaborative, curious, and proactive approach to supporting stakeholders and building procurement capability.

  • Possess working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including the ability to organize, compare, and analyze data; experience with pivot tables, lookup formulas, or dashboards is preferred.

  • Experience with procurement, sourcing, contract lifecycle, spend analytics, reporting, or supplier management platforms is preferred.

Role Factors
 

  • This is a hybrid role with onsite office attendance required at least 3 days a week minimum.

  • This role may require participation in supplier or stakeholder meetings across different time zones, depending on business needs.

  • Travel is not expected to be a regular requirement, but occasional travel may be required for business meetings or supplier-related activity.

What we offer
 

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary of $76k to $95k in Alpharetta, Georgia. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.
 

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate performance and your individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.
 

Where this role is based in the United States of America, the FLSA exemption status should be reviewed and confirmed by HR before posting.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

 Supporting Category Managers with category plans, sourcing pipelines, savings trackers, supplier documentation, and leadership-ready updates.
 Coordinating sourcing activities by managing documentation, supplier communications, timelines, bid analysis, stakeholder meetings, and recommendation materials.
 Analyzing spend, supplier, contract, and pricing information to identify savings, consolidation, risk reduction, and process improvement opportunities.
 Managing contract administration activities by tracking renewals, expiration dates, notice periods, pricing obligations, service commitments, and key contractual requirements.
 Preparing contract summaries, renewal options, supplier comparison materials, total cost summaries, dashboards, reports, and other decision-support materials.
 Conducting supplier research and market scans to identify potential vendors, alternative supply options, emerging providers, market trends, and supplier risks.
 Supporting supplier onboarding, due diligence, performance tracking, issue follow-up, supplier business reviews, and compliance documentation.
 Serving as a day-to-day procurement operations contact for assigned internal stakeholders and helping them navigate sourcing, contracting, onboarding, and procurement processes.
 Maintaining accurate procurement records, templates, process documentation, trackers, systems data, and audit-ready supporting materials.
 Escalating complex commercial, contractual, supplier performance, governance, or risk-related matters to Category Managers or senior procurement professionals when appropriate.

 About You 
 What we’re looking for: 
 Possess a bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, Operations, or a related field, or demonstrate equivalent relevant experience.
 Demonstrate experience supporting procurement, sourcing, supplier management, contract administration, finance, consulting, operations, data analytics, or a related business support function.
 Able to analyze data, prepare reports, identify trends, and translate findings into practical business insights and recommendations.
 Able to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, records, and stakeholder requests with accuracy and consistent follow-through.

 Able to communicate clearly with internal stakeholders and suppliers, including summarizing information, documenting requirements, and preparing concise materials for review.

 Possess working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including the ability to organize, compare, and analyze data; experience with pivot tables, lookup formulas, or dashboards is preferred.
 Experience with procurement, sourcing, contract lifecycle, spend analytics, reporting, or supplier management platforms is preferred.
 Role Factors 
 This is a hybrid role with onsite office attendance required at least 3 days a week minimum.
 This role may require participation in supplier or stakeholder meetings across different time zones, depending on business needs.
 Travel is not expected to be a regular requirement, but occasional travel may be required for business meetings or supplier-related activity.
 What we offer 
 For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary of $76k to $95k in Alpharetta, Georgia. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.
 In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate performance and your individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.

We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture.  As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

How does this role contribute to our collective success?
The pricing team has responsibility for developing consistent, worldwide pricing and portfolio management practices across AXIS, and is primarily responsible for Pricing Models, New Business Development, Product Monitoring, Portfolio Management, Business Planning, and Price Monitoring. The pricing team interacts extensively with other functions including underwriting, reserving, risk management, capital modelling, and finance.

What will you do in this role?
• This role has direct responsibility for pricing and portfolio management of all Cyber Reinsurance business written across the globe through offices in US, London and Zurich.
• This role may include managing supporting pricing analysts during busier renewal periods.
You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.

About You:
We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.

What you need to have:
• At least 5 years’ experience in an actuarial role; strong preference for both reinsurance pricing experience and familiarity with the cyber line of business.
• Strong time management and organizational skills; ability to prioritize and complete work in an efficient manner during peak season.
• Fellow or Associate of a relevant actuarial organization.

What we prefer you to have:
• Excellent communication, organization and interpersonal skills; able to establish credibility with underwriters, clients, and management.
• Passion for pushing the boundaries of actuarial analysis and tools. Advanced knowledge of Reinsurance pricing structures and techniques.

Role Factors:
In this role, you will typically be required to:
• Lead pricing across Cyber Reinsurance, with responsibility for new and renewal proportional and non-proportional reinsurance treaty pricing.
• Assist with portfolio management for Pricing across Cyber Reinsurance, with responsibility for rate monitoring, portfolio monitoring, and business planning.
• Maintain and make periodic improvements to pricing tools used in Cyber Reinsurance pricing that are aligned to broader AXIS standards, including developing and maintaining pricing parameters.
• Collaborate with Cyber Exposure Management on systemic pricing for treaties and at a portfolio level.
• Contribute to wider actuarial projects across AXIS Reinsurance as a member of the Pricing Team.

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $185,000-$225,000 (NY). Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. 

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.  

Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is [Exempt/Non-Exempt] for FLSA purposes.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Support Lead
jobs.description_html:
This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance.  We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture.  As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

How does this role contribute to our collective success?
AI solutions are becoming increasingly important to AXIS' ability to drive efficiency, improve decision making, and enhance customer and employee experiences. As AI capabilities mature and move into production, maintaining their effectiveness, reliability, fairness, and business value becomes critical.

The AI Solutions Support Lead is responsible for the ongoing support, maintenance, monitoring, and enhancement of AI solutions that have been deployed into production. Once an AI solution has been delivered and transitioned from the Data Science & AI Delivery team, ownership of day-to-day operational support and continuous improvement will transfer to this role.

Leading a team of AI engineers provided through our strategic delivery partners, the AI Solutions Support Lead will ensure production AI solutions remain stable, performant, compliant, and aligned to evolving business needs. This role acts as the central coordination point between AI engineering, Data Science & AI Delivery, Data Engineering, BTS, business stakeholders, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions continue to deliver measurable value throughout their lifecycle.

The role combines technical leadership, operational excellence, stakeholder management, and people leadership, requiring an individual who is equally comfortable discussing model performance, coordinating incident response activities, managing enhancement roadmaps, and engaging senior business stakeholders.


What will you do in this role?

Own Production AI Solutions

  • Assume operational ownership of AI solutions following successful deployment and handover from delivery teams.

  • Establish and maintain support processes, documentation, runbooks, monitoring dashboards, escalation paths, defect management and operational procedures. once a solution has met agreed production acceptance criteria, including runbooks(those will need to be created and handed over to support team), monitoring dashboards, support ownership, escalation paths, defect management, and release evidence

  • Ensure clear ownership, accountability, and service management practices are in place for all production AI solutions.

  • Maintain an accurate inventory of supported solutions, dependencies, business owners, and support requirements.


Lead AI Support & Incident Management

  • Coordinate investigation and resolution of production issues affecting AI solutions.

  • Manage defect remediation activities and oversee the delivery of code fixes through internal and partner engineering teams.

  • Act as the primary point of coordination during major incidents impacting AI services.

  • Ensure issues are identified, triaged, prioritised, communicated, and resolved effectively.

  • Support post-incident reviews and implementation of preventative actions.


Monitor Solution Performance & Effectiveness

  • Own monitoring frameworks to assess solution performance, reliability, usage, accuracy, cost, and value realization.

  • Monitor AI outputs for signs of performance degradation, model drift, bias, fairness concerns, or changing business effectiveness.

  • Ensure solutions continue to meet business objectives, operational requirements, and governance standards.

  • Identify optimisation opportunities and drive continuous improvement activities.


Drive Continuous Improvement & Enhancements

  • Own and manage enhancement backlogs for production AI solutions.

  • Coordinate development and deployment of approved enhancements.

  • Ensure solutions evolve in line with changing business processes, regulatory expectations, and technology capabilities.

  • Support release planning and production deployments.


Collaborate Across Technology & Data Teams

  • Work closely with the broader Data Science & AI Delivery team to ensure effective transition of solutions into support.

  • Partner with Data Engineering teams to maintain data pipelines, integrations, and platform dependencies.

  • Collaborate with BTS teams to align with enterprise support processes, infrastructure standards, change management, and operational controls.

  • Coordinate activities across internal and external delivery teams to ensure service excellence.


Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Ensure AI solutions operate in accordance with AXIS AI governance policies and standards.

  • Support periodic reviews of AI solutions to confirm continued appropriateness, effectiveness, transparency, and risk management.

  • Maintain appropriate operational documentation, support evidence, and audit artefacts.

  • Contribute to governance forums, operational reviews, and risk assessments where required.


What success looks like

  • Success in this role will be measured through:

  • High availability and reliability of production AI solutions.

  • Timely resolution of incidents and defects.

  • Strong stakeholder satisfaction with AI services and support.

  • Evidence that AI solutions continue to deliver expected business outcomes.

  • Effective monitoring and management of performance, fairness, bias, drift, and operational risk.

  • Delivery of enhancements and continuous improvements aligned to business priorities.

  • Smooth transition of solutions from delivery into operational support.

  • Well-managed support teams and partner resources.



About You
You are an organised, technically strong leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of technology, operations, and business value. You have experience supporting complex production systems and can confidently coordinate multidisciplinary teams to resolve issues and drive continuous improvement.

You combine strong technical understanding with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling you to translate business priorities into practical operational outcomes.

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Significant experience supporting, operating, or maintaining production AI, machine learning, analytics, or data-driven solutions.

  • Strong understanding of AI solution lifecycles, including deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancement.

  • Experience leading technical teams and coordinating third-party delivery partners.

  • Strong incident management and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Experience managing application support, service management, or operational delivery functions.

  • Strong understanding of data platforms, APIs, cloud environments, and software delivery practices.

  • Experience working with Agile delivery methodologies and DevOps practices.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Ability to prioritise effectively and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

  • Strong organisational and leadership capabilities.


Desirable

  • Experience supporting Generative AI, machine learning, large language model (LLM), or agentic AI solutions.

  • Experience with Azure AI, Databricks, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, Foundry, or similar AI technologies.

  • Understanding of Responsible AI principles, model monitoring, bias management, and AI governance requirements.

  • Experience within insurance, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.

  • Familiarity with ITIL, Service Management, or Site Reliability Engineering practices.



Working Arrangements

This role forms part of the operational backbone of AXIS' AI capability.

Given the critical nature of production support responsibilities, occasional out-of-hours work, including evenings and weekends, may be required to support incident resolution, production deployments, testing activities, or other business-critical operational events.

Role Factors:
In this role, you will typically be required to:

Attend your local office at least three (3) days per week to meet and build relationships with colleagues and the wider business.

Engage in company activities to grow your network and build a strong team culture.

What we offer: 
For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $175,000 - $200,000 USD (New York, NY), $110,000 - $130,000 CAD (Halifax, Nova Scotia) Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.  

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.   

Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is Exempt for FLSA purposes.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Job Code

P01013

About the Team
 

AXIS is a leading provider of specialty insurance and global reinsurance. The Employment Practices Liability team is an engaging team handling excess and primary claims for various AXIS policy forms. The strength of our team is grounded in our people and culture, encouraging collaboration, growth, and diversity.
 

How does this role contribute to our collective success?
 

The selected individual will collaborate with a team to investigate, analyze, and evaluate Third Party Liability claims, ensuring proper coverage determinations. Expertise will be developed in Employment Practices Liability while engaging with complex insureds on significant and dynamic disputes. This role offers meaningful opportunities to contribute to impactful case resolutions within specialized insurance sectors. The selected individual will also have exposure to Fiduciary Liability claims.
 

What Will You Do In This Role?
 

  • Serving as a Claims Specialist focused on Employment Practices Liability Claims within AXIS' North America Claim team.
  • Determining the appropriate valuation of complex claims, recommending settlement strategies, adhering to company policies, and collaborating with insureds, brokers, and partners effectively.
  • Traveling to participate in mediations, observe trials, and strengthen relationships with vital AXIS partners.
  • Escalating coverage concerns to internal teams and collaborating with external coverage attorneys when specific assignments necessitate their involvement.
  • Developing claims and litigation strategies, delegating tasks, and overseeing the work of external legal advisors effectively.
  • Assisting with underwriting inquiries while analyzing claim trends, conducting data analysis, and performing comprehensive risk assessments to support decision-making processes.
  • Keeping precise records of claim activities and promptly updating systems with all relevant details ensuring accuracy and efficiency.

About You
 

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.
 

What We're Looking For
 

  • Seek candidates who bring unique perspectives and diverse skills to the team.
  • Contribute actively to the success of a growing and dynamic team by bringing energy and a positive attitude.
  • Hold a Juris Doctorate.
  • Operate efficiently in settings with high visibility, shifting deadlines, and evolving expectations while staying focused and achieving outcomes.
  • Demonstrate organizational abilities and solve problems effectively.
  • Exhibit outstanding skill in verbal communication and written expression.
  • Showcase skill as a litigator or litigation manager, well-versed in dispute resolution.
  • Write coverage letters independently with precision and attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in all aspects of the work.

Role Factors
 

Travel is associated with this role. The role requires you to be in office 3 days per week and adhere to AXIS licensing requirements.
 

What We Offer
 

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $85,000 - $130,000. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.
In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.

Senior Underwriter - North America Casualty Reinsurance
Job Profile: Senior Underwriter, Reinsurance
________________________________________
How does this role contribute to our collective success?
Reporting to the Head of North America GL and WC Casualty, AXIS Re, the successful candidate will be responsible for underwriting and managing a portfolio of General Liability and Workers Compensation Treaty Reinsurance business across North America.
The role carries significant responsibility for business production, portfolio performance, broker and client relationship management, underwriting strategy execution and portfolio management. The successful candidate will work closely with Casualty leadership to identify growth opportunities, support portfolio construction, manage market cycle dynamics and contribute to broader casualty initiatives.
In addition to their core General Liability and Workers Compensation responsibilities, the individual will have opportunities to contribute across other casualty lines, including Professional Liability and Cyber, supporting a diversified underwriting platform and long-term talent development objectives.
________________________________________
What will you do in this role?
• Originate, negotiate and underwrite General Liability and Workers Compensation treaty reinsurance business in compliance with AXIS Re underwriting guidelines, authority, risk appetite and portfolio objectives.
• Manage and grow a portfolio of business with accountability for underwriting performance, profitability and portfolio quality.
• Support the development and execution of underwriting strategy, business plans, portfolio construction initiatives and market engagement efforts.
• Build, maintain and expand broker and client relationships to support profitable business origination and long-term franchise value.
• Lead complex underwriting analyses and develop creative and effective reinsurance solutions that balance client needs with AXIS Re profitability objectives.
• Monitor portfolio performance and proactively identify emerging opportunities, trends and risks.
• Track legal, regulatory, economic and market developments affecting casualty lines and incorporate insights into underwriting decision-making.
• Participate in strategic discussions with brokers and clients regarding portfolio performance, market developments and emerging risk issues.
• Participate in underwriting audits, peer reviews, referral discussions and portfolio monitoring activities.
• Mentor and support the development of less experienced underwriting professionals.
• Collaborate closely with actuarial, claims, finance, operations and exposure management teams to support effective portfolio management and business decision making.
• Support underwriting initiatives across other casualty portfolios, including Professional Liability, where appropriate.
• Maintain a strong understanding of current issues affecting the insurance and reinsurance industries with respect to General Liability, Workers Compensation and broader casualty markets.
• Travel frequently to service clients and brokers and attend industry conferences.
You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.
________________________________________
About You
The successful candidate will be a highly regarded casualty reinsurance professional with a demonstrated track record of underwriting and managing profitable General Liability and Workers Compensation portfolios within a leading reinsurance, insurance or brokerage organization.
The individual will possess strong technical underwriting expertise combined with portfolio management, relationship management and business development capabilities. They will be comfortable engaging with senior client executives, brokers and internal stakeholders while contributing to portfolio management and strategic underwriting discussions.
Candidates should demonstrate the ability to balance underwriting judgment, portfolio management, client advocacy and commercial execution within a dynamic and evolving market environment.
We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table. While there are qualifications and experiences we believe are important for success, we are open to discussing how your individual background can contribute to our objectives and long-term success.
________________________________________
What you need to have
• Strong expertise in General Liability and Workers Compensation insurance and reinsurance markets.
• Demonstrated track record of profitable underwriting and portfolio management.
• Experience managing treaty reinsurance portfolios and contributing to underwriting strategy and business planning.
• Strong understanding of casualty loss trends, claims dynamics, policy coverage, treaty structures and emerging risks.
• Working knowledge of actuarial, pricing and portfolio management concepts.
• Ability to communicate technical underwriting concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including Executive Leadership.
• Strong communication, negotiation and influencing skills.
• Proven ability to develop and maintain productive broker, client and internal stakeholder relationships.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Sound judgment and decision-making skills when faced with ambiguity and competing priorities.
• Strong understanding of contract wording, policy forms and underwriting governance principles.
• Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities during peak renewal periods.
• Highly collaborative with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
• Ability to lead projects and influence outcomes across functions.
• Bachelor's Degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent professional experience.
________________________________________
What we prefer you to have
• CPCU, ARe, ARM or other relevant industry designation.
• Based in the New York metropolitan area.
• Minimum 8 years of casualty insurance or reinsurance underwriting and/or broking experience.
• Significant experience in General Liability and Workers Compensation underwriting.
• Experience working across multiple casualty classes, including Professional Liability and other specialty casualty lines.
• Strong industry relationships and reputation among leading brokers and insurers.
• Demonstrated portfolio management and business planning experience.
• Experience mentoring and developing junior underwriting talent.
• Ability to build dashboards and data models using Power BI.
• Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups and data analysis.
________________________________________
Role Factors
In this role, you will typically be required to:
• Travel frequently to visit clients, brokers and attend industry conferences.
• Be in the office (or visiting brokers/clients) three days per week.
• Attend broker and client events in the evenings and occasionally on weekends as required.
________________________________________
What We Offer

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $250,000 to $300,000 (NY). Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. 
In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate performance and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical coverage, retirement plans, health and wellness programs, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation and much more.
This role is Exempt for FLSA purposes.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.description_html:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

The Portfolio Lead serves as the operating partner to the Business Lead and Value Stream Lead for the Claims and Corporate strategic investment portfolios. The role translates business strategy into investment decisions, execution priorities, measurable outcomes, executive reporting, and course corrections across the full portfolio lifecycle—from strategy and prioritization through execution, value realization, and communication.

This role goes beyond portfolio reporting and delivery tracking; it actively questions, shapes, and influences portfolio direction in partnership with business sponsors, Value Stream Leads, Product Owners, Application Delivery, Data & Analytics, AI and COE teams. Key responsibilities include investment planning and prioritization, maintaining delivery roadmaps, managing budgets and risks, defining and tracking business value metrics, and ensuring leadership has the insight needed to make informed decisions and adjust course when outcomes are not on track.

What will you do in this role?

Drive and guide portfolio strategy in collaboration with Business Leaders, Business Sponsors, Product Owners, Value Stream Leads, Release Train Engineers, and delivery partners to ensure investment decisions, execution priorities, outcomes, and reporting remain aligned with business objectives. Specifically, they will execute:

  • Strategy Translation and Portfolio Leadership: Serve as an operating partner to the Business Lead and Value Stream Lead, translating strategy into portfolio priorities, investment choices, delivery roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.

  • Investment Planning, Prioritization, and Governance: Lead portfolio planning and prioritization activities, including quarterly business reviews and planning cadences, to ensure funding, sequencing, capacity, and trade-off decisions are aligned to strategic business priorities.

  • Outcomes and Value Ownership: Establish, track, and communicate business value metrics, benefits realization, Objectives & Key Results (OKRs), and investment outcomes to ensure portfolio investments deliver expected business results; shape course corrections when value delivery is not on track.

  • Proactive Risk, Issue, and Root Cause Management: Identify delivery, funding, dependency, capacity, and value realization challenges early; perform root cause analysis and partner with business and technology leaders to define mitigation plans and course corrections.

  • Executive Reporting and Stakeholder Communication: Create clear, insight-driven executive reporting and communications that inform senior leaders on portfolio health, investment outcomes, risks, decisions required, and recommended actions.

  • Financial and Resource Stewardship: Manage portfolio financials, including budgets, forecasts, actuals, investment trade-offs, and resource allocation decisions, ensuring transparency and alignment between spend, capacity, and expected business value.

  • PI Planning and Quarterly Business Review Cadence: Actively participate in Program Increment (PI) Planning and quarterly business review cadences, identifying cross-Value Stream dependencies, helping set execution priorities, validating progress against business outcomes, and escalating impediments or decisions required.

You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.

About You:

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.

What you need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration or a related field.

  • Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean Six Sigma certifications, Agile delivery certifications (e.g. SAFe SPC, SAFe Lean Portfolio Management, PMI-ACP) , or other relevant certifications are advantageous.

  • Proven experience in portfolio leadership, strategic planning, investment prioritization, or project/program management, with a track record of shaping and delivering large-scale initiatives in a matrixed business and technology environment.

  • Experience partnering with senior business sponsors, Value Stream Leads, and technology leaders to translate strategy into investment plans, execution priorities, business outcomes, and executive decision-making materials.

  • Proven experience in the insurance industry preferred.

  • Demonstrated financial acumen, including experience with portfolio budgets, forecasts, investment trade-offs, benefits realization, and value-based decision support.

Critical competencies:

  • Ability to think strategically and translate business strategy into portfolio priorities, investment decisions, delivery outcomes, and measurable business value for the Claims and Corporate Divisions.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex delivery, financial, risk, and value information and identify root causes of portfolio challenges.

  • Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to create clear, concise, decision-oriented materials for senior business and technology leaders.

  • Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and manage ambiguity.

  • Keen attention to detail to ensure project plans and deliverables are accurately developed and maintained.

  • Strong collaborative skills to work effectively with various teams and stakeholders.

  • Ability to balance structure and flexibility, with a focus on results and accountability.

  • Strong executive presence and credibility, with experience influencing senior stakeholders, business sponsors, and cross-functional leaders through ambiguity and investment trade-offs.

  • Strong financial acumen, including the ability to connect budget, forecast, capacity, benefits realization, and investment outcome data to portfolio decisions.

  • Effective influencing, negotiating, and decision-making skills.

  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate and manage multiple priorities.

  • Proficiency in using AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, improve analysis, streamline communication, and support effective portfolio management.

  • Proficiency in project management tools and software platforms.

Role Factors:

In this role, you will typically be required to:

  • Embrace the hybrid culture offered at AXIS, you need to be in office 3 days per week.

Much of the work involves using computers for data entry, analysis, and communication. Comfort with prolonged screen time is necessary.

While much of the work may be desk-bound, there might be occasions requiring mobility within the office environment, such as attending meetings or accessing filing systems.

What we offer:

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $137,500 - $229,000. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.  

Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is Exempt for FLSA purposes.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

This role plays a critical part in advancing the organization’s Copilot Premium capabilities by supporting enterprise readiness, enabling secure and effective usage, and driving continuous improvement across the platform. The incumbent will act as a key technical resource, partnering with stakeholders across IT and the business to ensure Copilot operates effectively, aligns to governance standards, and delivers business value.

What will you do in this role?

  • Serve as a primary technical resource for Microsoft Copilot Premium, independently handling complex operational issues and escalations while identifying patterns and recommending sustainable solutions.

  • Partner with SharePoint, Security, Identity, and Compliance teams to ensure Copilot readiness, including permissions design, content accessibility, and governance alignment.

  • Own and drive resolution of incidents and problems end-to-end, including root cause analysis, cross-team coordination, and implementation of corrective actions.

  • Support and enhance Copilot enablement processes, including onboarding, access management, and lifecycle activities, ensuring scalability and efficiency.

  • Analyze trends, usage data, and recurring issues to recommend process improvements and optimize platform performance.

  • Contribute to the implementation and stabilization of new Copilot features, assessing operational impact and recommending improvements to deployment approaches.

  • Act as a key point of contact for stakeholders, working with business and technical partners to understand needs, troubleshoot issues, and apply effective solutions.

  • Develop and maintain documentation, runbooks, and knowledge resources, ensuring consistency and operational excellence.

  • Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to L1/L2 teams and peers, supporting capability development across the function.

About You

We encourage you to bring your expertise and perspective. You will play an important role in delivering solutions, improving processes, and strengthening Copilot operations across the organization.

What you need to have:

  • Proven experience (2+ years) supporting Microsoft 365 technologies, including hands-on experience with Copilot Premium or equivalent AI-driven platforms.

  • Strong understanding of how Copilot integrates with SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Exchange, Microsoft Search, and related services.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently analyze and resolve complex technical issues, including those involving data access, permissions, and platform behavior.

  • Experience performing root cause analysis across multiple domains (data, identity, configuration) and recommending improvements.

  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple issues or projects, working effectively with limited supervision.

  • Working knowledge of security, compliance, and governance controls, including sensitivity labels, retention, and access management.

  • Experience operating within an IT service management framework (e.g., ServiceNow), including incident, request, and problem management.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to work directly with stakeholders to understand issues and apply solutions.

What we prefer you to have:

  • 3– 5 years of experience in IT support or platform operations.

  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale implementations of Microsoft 365 or similar platforms.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify process improvement opportunities and recommend changes that enhance service delivery.

  • Experience contributing to projects or initiatives with moderate scope and duration, including feature rollouts or system enhancements.

  • Ability to collaborate across technical domains and influence outcomes without direct authority.

  • Proven ability to produce clear, structured documentation and operational guidance.

Role Factors

In this role, you will typically be required to:

  • Work in a hybrid environment in accordance with company policy.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Infrastructure, Security, Identity, Compliance, and Digital Workplace.

  • Independently manage workload and contribute to projects with defined scope and timelines.

  • Engage regularly with stakeholders to address operational needs and improve service outcomes.

  • Apply analytical thinking to solve problems of moderate scope and complexity.

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of Alpharetta: $87K - $115K or Halifax: 85K CAD – 105K CAD. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. 

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.  

Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is Exempt for FLSA purposes.

Job Description: Ceded Finance Analyst - Reporting

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

AXIS is a global insurer and reinsurer focused on specialty lines and treaty reinsurance.  AXIS is headquartered in Bermuda and operates in North America, EMEA, Asia, and Global Markets (including Lloyd’s). 

The Ceded Reinsurance Finance and Operations function is responsible for delivering a strategic and forward-looking organization that will:

  • Advance the Company’s growth and profitability goals through the enablement of the Ceded Reinsurance Strategy;

  • Provide clear accountability for outward reinsurance contract administration, outwards reinsurance controls and outward reinsurance reporting; and

  • Drive process excellence and better data and analytics through technological enablement and our partnership with Genpact.

The Ceded Finance Analyst – Reporting (CRM) will report to the Ceded Re Lead who reports to the Global Head of Ceded Re Finance and Operations.  The CRM will lead the global ceded reinsurance reporting and collateral function and ensure timely and accurate reporting per regulatory and corporate requirements. 

What will you do in this role?

  • Global Ceded Reporting and Collateral Management

  • Ceded Reporting

  • Assist in preparation and analysis of ceded reinsurance results for Group/legal entities/business units for financial close and reporting

  • Assist reinsurance reporting, including monthly or quarterly reports, to committees / boards and Group / legal entity

  • Ceded regional reporting includes but not limited to - US STAT, Bermuda, Canada, Lloyds, Solvency II and US GAAP

  • Regulatory reports include quarterly SEC supplement, Solvency II templates and QRTS, Singapore MAS reports, Syndicate reports and others

  • Assist and support preparation of other reports and analysis, including but not limited to reinsurance recoverable reports, risk transfer analysis and memos

  • Support ProCede Schedule F module administration   

  • Ceded Collateral Management

  • Assist in collateral reviews and reporting related to ceded reinsurance contracts

  • Market reporting and coordination to obtain collateral increases and return of overfunding per contract terms

  • Quarterly review of balances and collateral for Captives

  • Assist in management and safekeeping of ceded collateral - letters of credit, trusts and funds withheld

  • Assist and support regulatory compliance

  • Develop strong relationships with internal and external clients to ensure accurate communication and timely response to inquiries

  • Support reporting team to ensure accurate and timely reporting

  • Ensure departmental compliance with operational controls including, but not limited to SOX controls

About You:

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.

What you need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or equivalent

  • Range of 1-5 years’ experience in reinsurance reporting

  • Strong analytical and reconciliation skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite of products applications (Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint). 

  • Advanced excel knowledge required

  • Internationally recognized qualification pursuit or equivalent experience (CPA, CA, ARe, CPCU) a plus

  • Retrocession and / or third-party capital industry knowledge with operations and reporting experience a plus

  • Experience with ceded reinsurance and financial systems a plus (ProCede and Oracle/SmartView)

What we prefer you to have:

  • Highly motivated and organized to drive company initiatives, showing a strong level of accountability, integrity, and professionalism

  • Ability to meet tight deadlines, work effectively during occasional challenging timelines and respond to changing priorities

  • Team player with ability to collaborate with internal and external customers, understand the needs and goals of a customer and actively look for ways to meet or exceed them

  • Good oral and written communication skills, which will include report writing skills and the ability to develop and maintain effective working relationships.

  • Highly numerate with analytical and problem solvency abilities


Role Factors:


In this role, you will typically be required to be in the office 3 days per week.

What we offer:


You will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid annual leave, and much more.

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $65,000 - 75,000 (Alpharetta) , $45,000 - 55,000 CAD (Halifax). Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.  

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.   

Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is [Exempt/Non-Exempt] for FLSA purposes. 

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.description_html:

Job Description: Strategic Delivery Lead – COO

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

The Strategic Delivery Lead – COO oversees the internal COO of strategic initiatives spanning operations, technology, and data & analytics. This role provides a clear, integrated view of delivery and helps ensure that initiatives are prioritized, governed, and executed in support of COO business objectives.

Key responsibilities include maintaining cross-functional delivery roadmaps, managing budgets, risks, dependencies, and initiative-level reporting, and ensuring alignment across operations, technology, and data & analytics priorities. The role operates in a matrixed environment, partnering with business leaders, Product Owners, Value Stream Leads, Release Train Engineers, Application Delivery, Data & Analytics, AI, and COE teams to shape, launch, and oversee COO initiatives.

What will you do in this role?

Drive and guide strategy for COO projects in collaboration with Business Leaders, Product Owners, Value Stream Leads, Release Train Engineers, and delivery partners, ensuring alignment across operations, technology, and data & analytics objectives. Specifically, they will execute:

Strategic Alignment: In support of COO leadership, the Strategic Delivery Lead ensures that operations, technology, and data & analytics initiatives align with enterprise priorities, COO objectives, and measurable business outcomes.

Governance and Management: The Strategic Delivery Lead manages governance, financials, delivery status, dependencies, and reporting across COO projects, including budgets, actuals, Objectives & Key Results (OKR) attainment, delivery metrics, and other KPIs.

Risk Management: The Strategic Delivery Lead identifies and mitigates risks that could impact success.

Stakeholder Communication: The Strategic Delivery Lead maintains clear communication with stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment on goals and progress.

Resource Allocation: The Strategic Delivery Lead supports prioritization and allocation of resources required to deliver COO initiatives, including work that spans operations teams, technology delivery teams, data & analytics teams, and initiatives not supported by Agile Teams.

Participating in PI Planning: The Strategic Delivery Lead actively participates in Program Increment (PI) Planning, identifying cross-Value Stream dependencies, helping set priorities, and mitigating impediments.

You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.

About You:

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.

What you need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration or a related field.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean Six Sigma certifications, Agile delivery certifications (e.g. SAFe SPC, SAFe Lean Portfolio Management, PMI-ACP) , or other relevant certifications are advantageous.
  • Proven experience in strategic delivery leadership, portfolio or project management with a track record of successfully leading and delivering large-scale projects in a matrixed environment.
  • Proven experience in the insurance industry preferred.
  • Experience overseeing cross-functional progrmas that include business operations, technology delivery, data & analytics, process improvement, and transformation initiatives.

Critical competencies:

  • Ability to think strategically and align project goals with the overall business objectives of the COO organization, including operations, technology, and data & analytics priorities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities, including strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and manage ambiguity.
  • Keen attention to detail to ensure project plans and deliverables are accurately developed and maintained.
  • Strong collaborative skills to work effectively with various teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to balance structure and flexibility, with a focus on results and accountability.
  • Strong executive presence and credibility, with experience dealing with senior business leaders.
  • Effective influencing, negotiating, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate and manage multiple priorities.
  • Proficiency in using AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, improve analysis, streamline communication, and support effective delivery management.
  • Proficiency in project management tools and software platforms.

 

Role Factors:

In this role, you will typically be required to:

  • Embrace the hybrid culture offered at AXIS, you need to be in office 3 days per week.
  • Much of the work involves using computers for data entry, analysis, and communication. Comfort with prolonged screen time is necessary.
  • While much of the work may be desk-bound, there might be occasions requiring mobility within the office environment, such as attending meetings or accessing filing systems.

What we offer:

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $160,000 -$180,000. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.  

Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is Exempt for FLSA purposes.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Reinsurance Technical Accountant
jobs.description_html:
This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance.  We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture.  As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

Role Summary
The Reinsurance Technical Accountant will be responsible for supporting assumed reinsurance technical accounting activities across global portfolios, based on business need. This role requires strong technical accounting knowledge, attention to detail, analytical judgment, and the ability to work across multiple regions, systems, and stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate processing, reporting, and resolution of reinsurance accounting activity.

The role will support close and reporting deliverables, review and process reinsurance statements of account, analyze premiums, losses, commissions, and related balances, and help ensure accounting activity is recorded accurately in accordance with contract terms and internal procedures. The position will also support issue resolution, aged balance review, account analysis, and coordination with internal stakeholders including Underwriting, Claims, Finance, Cash Accounting, offshore processing teams, and Reporting.

This role is critical to maintaining continuity, control integrity, and service quality across the global assumed reinsurance portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform assumed reinsurance technical accounting activities across global portfolios, regions, and business needs.
  • Review, analyze, and process reinsurance statements of account, ensuring activity is complete, accurate, and aligned with contract terms and internal procedures.
  • Analyze and record reinsurance activity, including premiums, losses, commissions, fees, adjustments, and other contract-related balances.
  • Support monthly and quarterly close processes, ensuring assigned deliverables are completed timely and accurately.
  • Monitor, research, and resolve open items, exceptions, and aged balances related to assigned accounts and portfolios.
  • Work closely with Cash Accounting to support timely clearing of aged balances, investigate receipt or payment-related questions, and resolve cash application or statement of account processing inquiries.
  • Partner with offshore processing teams to provide guidance, answer questions, review outputs, and support quality and consistency of processing.
  • Coordinate with Underwriting, Claims, Finance, Reporting, Cash Accounting, and other internal stakeholders to resolve account questions and ensure accurate financial reporting.
  • Support account reconciliations, variance analysis, and investigation of unusual or unexpected movements.
  • Identify and escalate complex issues, control concerns, processing delays, or aged balance risks in a timely manner.
  • Maintain clear documentation of accounting conclusions, open items, follow-ups, and resolution steps.
  • Support audit, internal control, and compliance-related requests, including preparation of supporting documentation and explanations.
  • Contribute to process improvements, reporting enhancements, automation readiness, and opportunities to improve efficiency, visibility, and control across the Technical Accounting function.
  • Assist with training, knowledge transfer, and documentation of account-specific or region-specific procedures as needed.
  • Provide flexible support across regions, portfolios, and deliverables as priorities shift within the global Technical Accounting function.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in reinsurance accounting, insurance accounting, technical accounting, finance, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of assumed reinsurance concepts, including premiums, losses, commissions, statements of account, treaty activity, and related accounting flows.
  • Ability to interpret reinsurance activity, identify exceptions, and apply judgment when reviewing account activity.
  • Strong analytical, reconciliation, and problem-solving skills.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple deliverables, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with onshore, offshore, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Ability to escalate issues appropriately and support timely resolution of complex accounting matters.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and ability to work with accounting systems, reporting tools, and large data sets.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience with assumed reinsurance technical accounting.
  • Experience supporting global, multi-region, or complex reinsurance portfolios.
  • Familiarity with reinsurance administration systems and reporting platforms.
  • Experience working with offshore processing teams or shared service models.
  • Experience supporting month-end or quarter-end close, audit requests, and control documentation.
  • Experience with aged balance analysis, account reconciliations, and statement of account review.


Key Skills and Competencies

  • Technical accounting knowledge
  • Assumed reinsurance accounting
  • Statement of account processing
  • Analytical judgment
  • Account reconciliation
  • Aged balance review and resolution
  • Issue identification and escalation
  • Stakeholder management
  • Control awareness
  • Documentation and follow-through
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Ability to work in a complex, deadline-driven, global environment

For this position, the anticipated base salary range is $75,000 - $85,000 USD (Stamford, CT). Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.  

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.   

This posting is for an existing vacancy.
