jobs.title: Absence Management Consultant
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY

Acts as a Consultant to assigned accounts, including servicing and/or business development.  Expert in all time-off benefit programs, with special emphasis in Absence and Disability program development, implementation and monitoring.  


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Develops, implements, and evaluates/adjusts absence management strategies, particularly in the areas of disability, occupational and non-occupational disability, FMLA, workers compensation, statutory and non-statutory leave management programs, return to work programs, and ADA;

Evaluates the performance of insured/self-funded disability programs for change options and best potential outcomes.  This includes evaluation of third party administrators and insurers by investigating and assessing program performance, conducting quality and control audits, reviewing claim data and claim handling practices;

Conducts detailed analysis of disability incidence and duration and develops specific initiatives to positively impact these metrics via the utilization of best practices;

Develops and implements strategies that integrate healthcare disability programs, and mitigates the impact of disabilities/absences on health benefits programs (insured or self-funded);

Manages all client required services and maintains client relationships; 

Participates in team selling process including finalist interviews and RFP responses; 

Understands, evaluates, coordinates, and optimizes external resources available from carriers, employer health departments, and other applicable vendors to effectively assist clients;

Promotes to clients other services offered by our firm including Individual Disability and Voluntary Benefit program strategies;

Provides analysis and recommendations concerning client's existing coverages;

Selects carriers for solicitation and negotiates with carriers for benefit and premium considerations;

Receives and responds to client inquiries including benefit and claim questions and issues;

Reviews client coverage contracts and amendments for accuracy;

Manages and negotiates third party vendor relationships and contracts on behalf of the client;

Review of internal compliance and client disclosure requirements, external vendor contracts, summary plan documents, insurance certificates and policies, performance guarantees and employee communications to ensure alignment with client expectations, business requirements documents, and legal requirements;

Manages vendor stewardship meetings including review and refinement of vendor developed program stewardship meeting materials;

Stays abreast of all legislative issues/updates that affect absence and disability benefit programs;

Stays abreast of all vendor/carrier new product offerings;

Contributes to Intellectual Capital development by drafting White Papers, Case Studies, POV statements, etc.

Manages all client required services through frequent client interaction and maintains client relationships;

Moderate travel required – approximately five days per month; 

Collection of fees, reconciliation and resolution of any outstanding balances within 60 days of invoicing date;

Complies with agency management system data standards and data integrity (enters and maintains complete and accurate information);

Other duties as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience  

Ten (10) or more years of related work experience  

Understanding of the principles of absence and disability management and assistive technology

Must continue to meet Continuing Education requirements for license renewal or credential


SKILLS

Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Excellent problem solving and time management skills

Excellent planning, organizational and prioritization skills

Ability to lead a team and to foster teamwork

jobs.title: Account Manager - EB General Agency
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 

Responsible for serving as the primary operational liaison between company, independent insurance producers, employer groups, and carrier partners. Provides consultative support throughout the customer lifecycle including new business development, implementation, enrollment, ongoing service, renewals, and carrier administration. Acts as an extension of the General Agency and carrier service teams by delivering operational support, resolving service issues, coordinating implementations, educating producers, employers and employees, and supporting the growth and retention of General Agency business.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Builds and maintains trusted relationships with assigned brokers, agencies, carrier partners, and employer groups to promote retention, growth, and exceptional service.

Serves as the primary day-to-day General Agency contact for assigned producers and carrier partners.

Supports producer-led new business efforts including quoting, plan recommendations, proposal preparation, RFP responses, and quote-to-card coordination.

Reviews and scrubs new business submissions for completeness and accuracy prior to carrier submission.

Coordinates new group implementations, installation activities, enrollment timelines, and carrier onboarding requirements.

Conducts or participates in employer implementation meetings, employee education meetings, benefit presentations, and open enrollment meetings in partnership with producers and carrier representatives.

Facilitates renewal activities including proposal preparation, alternative plan options, plan design changes, and renewal strategy discussions.

Provides first-line operational support by researching and resolving eligibility, billing, claims, pharmacy, ID card, provider directory, plan change, member add/termination, reinstatement, ancillary product, and other service-related issues using carrier service platforms whenever possible.

Assists producers and employer groups with carrier portals, eServices, Employee Navigator, connectivity, and other enrollment or technology platforms.

Coordinates resolution of complex service issues and appropriately escalates matters that cannot be resolved through established carrier resources.

Maintains working knowledge of carrier products, underwriting guidelines, administrative procedures, technology platforms, and regulatory requirements affecting General Agency operations.

Supports producer education by delivering training on carrier products, processes, enrollment tools, and General Agency resources.

Collaborates with carrier sales and service teams to implement new products, initiatives, and strategic growth opportunities.

Maintains accurate documentation and utilizes agency management systems and other technology platforms to support operational excellence.

Exercises sound judgment in balancing producer advocacy with carrier requirements while ensuring a high-quality customer experience.

Performs all duties in accordance with all company policies and procedures, and all federal, state and local laws, wherein the Company operates.

Performs other duties as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

Five (5) or more years related work experience  

Valid Insurance License

Must continue to meet Continuing Education requirements for license renewal


SKILLS

Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills

Ability to conduct producer, employer and employee meetings

Excellent customer service skills

Good analytical, problem solving and time management skills

Ability to be organized and to prioritize work for multiple projects and deadlines

Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, agency management systems, carrier portals and enrollment technology

jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 


Responsible for evaluating and underwriting submissions for all pricing requests, including advanced underwriting and analysis projects.  Leads and/or assists in the management and execution of all assigned client projects. 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  


Competent in all major areas of general underwriting including, but not limited to, pricing forecasts for medical, pharmacy, dental, vision, life and AD&D, disability and EAP pricing for both rate development as well as option pricing;

Competent in special pricing and marketing projects such as:  medical network changes, claim re-pricing, disruption analysis, migration analysis, insured to self-funded modeling, contribution structure change modeling, as well as others;

Meets with Producers, clients, Underwriters, Account Executives and Benefits Analysts as needed to define and accomplish projects;

Expert in understanding actuarial plan values and how they are used in various pricing and analysis projects.  This includes ability to competently use software available for such types of plan analysis and pricing;

Full understanding of underwriting models and reporting templates, with ability to fully modify and customize to meet customer needs;

Works with internal staff and vendors to establish project timelines, identifies critical deadlines for completion and performs necessary functions to ensure project completion;

Assists or leads all assigned client underwriting projects, including the ability to present analysis to clients directly in a confident and easy-to-understand manner;

Maintains data tracking and reporting for financial management, underwriting models, client reports and other analytical reporting deliverables;

Assists with the development of new reporting tools and models;

Competent in multiple carrier data and reporting systems as needed to obtain claim data for reporting and analysis purposes;

Confidently analyzes and challenges insurance company renewal calculations for fully-insured contracts (Health, Dental and Vision);

Maintains files and historical data on all assigned clients and/or programs;

Actively engages in educational opportunities to further underwriting knowledge, market trends and regulatory environment;

Responsible for accuracy and timeliness of all work performed, including proper management of timelines and meeting deadlines as established;

Addresses incoming correspondence and responds as required in a timely manner;

Assists with development and training of other Underwriters;

Assists with the development of training materials and presentations;

Peer review of other Underwriters’ work for accuracy and completeness;

Serves as mentor to Underwriter I and II;

Complies with agency management system data standards and data integrity (enters and maintains complete and accurate information);

Other duties as assigned


QUALIFICATIONS 

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE 


Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience


Three (3) or more years related work experience


Valid Insurance License within 90 Days


Must continue to meet Continuing Education requirements for license renewal


  

SKILLS


Excellent verbal and written communication skills


Excellent problem solving and time management skills


Good customer service skills, including telephone and listening skills


Excellent planning, organizational and prioritization skills


Ability to work within a team and to foster teamwork


Ability to completely manage small and mid-level projects as well as effectively manage and lead small teams to complete goals


Ability to work productively as an individual to accomplish assigned projects


Ability to prioritize work for multiple projects and deadlines


Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, advanced MS Excel skills required

jobs.title: Claims Adjuster - Professional Liability
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 

Responsible for handling high exposure professional liability and litigated claims, as well as commercial injury and non-injury general liability and automobile claims, in accordance with client, carrier and company guidelines, statutory regulations and best practices. Primary duties include investigating, evaluating, reporting to authorities as applicable, and maintaining adequate reserves. Manages claims through well-developed action plans to an appropriate and timely resolution.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  

Maintains diary system to ensure claim files are up to date, and that required follow-up is taking place;

Investigates and evaluates claims to determine liability and compensability;

Communicates with vendors, producers, policy holders, clients and insurance companies to communicate claim status;

Negotiates settlements with claimants and insureds;

Reports to authorities as applicable, providing updates on litigated claims, serious injuries, and claims over the adjuster’s authorization limits;

Sets and manages reserve accounts, and ensures that adequate levels are maintained;

Analyzes and reviews invoices for payment;

Provides producer inquiry assistance;

Provides set-up of rental vehicles for clients as needed;

Creates and maintains reports and worksheets as needed;

Provides training and mentoring to less experienced adjusters;

Travels as necessary to attend appeal hearings, trials, and perform on-site investigations;

May act as backup for Supervisor on an as needed basis;

Complies with agency management system data standards and data integrity (enters and maintains complete and accurate information);

Other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

High School Diploma or equivalent combination of education and experience

Responsible for attending continuing education as

Seven (7) or more years experience in liability claims processing

SKILLS

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including telephone and listening skills

Excellent customer service skills

Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills

Strong analytical skills and problem solving skills

Strong organizational and time management skills

Discretion and independent judgment required

Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite - Excel, Word, Outlook

Develop assigned marketing plans and provide service assistance to agents; Handle 50–100 telephone calls per day with  agencies and agents on all aspects of assigned products; Recruit, train, service and assist agents to enable agents to produce at highest level possible; Assist agents with issues including recruit kits for carriers, training, contracting, certification, transactional issues such as electronic signature, telephonic signatures and app-by-email; Communicate with agents regularly regarding product information, rate changes and key agent benefits; Monitor compliance with program reporting rules and sales requirements; Provide technical support training, sales and marketing coaching; Identify and cultivate top producers; Identify problem agents; Recruit agents to participate in special opportunities, such as new lead sources, alternative methods of enrollment (e-commerce, e-signature, tele-app., etc.). Department Support Functions:  Update and maintain Contact Management System information in accordance with policies and procedures; Manage Team Roster; Update and maintain task list.  Have working knowledge of Who Quit Writing, Debit Balances, MGA reports, lead distribution/lead management, incomplete contracts, certification process, moving agents and agencies into production, able to conduct webinars and display/introduce SMS technology tools.

Special Projects:  Work collaboratively with fellow staff to advance the values and mission of Senior Market Sales by serving on relevant internal and external committees; Assists with special projects/assignments as requested by members of management.

Performs other duties as assigned by management.*


QUALIFICATIONS 
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's Degree in marketing or a related field

High School Diploma or GED

Three (3) or more years general insurance industry or related field (financial services, marketing, web-based business, business-to-business customer service or call center) experience

Life/Health Insurance license


SKILLS

Working knowledge of insurance services industries and specific current knowledge of product lines assigned to the marketer.

Knowledge of the general industry procedures, practices and terminology.

Skill in working effectively with inbound and outbound callers/customers.

Skill in negotiating and problem solving to resolve internal and external conflicts.

Skill in the use of office equipment including computer, fax, printer, telephone system, etc.

Skill in the use of time management and organization skills.

Skill in maintaining effective working relationships with all customers, employees and the general public.

Skill in project management.

Proficient computer skills (Microsoft/Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Adobe Acrobat, MS Outlook software preferred).

Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, in a constructive manner.

Ability to approach and communicate with a wide range of personalities in a professional and courteous manner.

Ability to be patient under frustrating circumstances and demonstrate controlled emotional affect in difficult situations.

Ability to engage in effective interpersonal interaction, verbal communication and written communication.

Ability to persuade.

Ability to maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail while remaining flexible and responsive when faced with multiple urgent requests.

Ability to read, write and communicate English effectively.

Ability to maintain all company policies, including all confidentiality and safety policies.

Ability to actively contribute to team effort.

Ability to work independently, exercise independent judgment, make and execute decisions.

Ability to be a self starter, motivated and accomplish goals and tasks within a given time frame.

Strong verbal and written proficiencies of the English language is required and bilingual (Spanish and English) preferred.

jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY

Responsible for providing a wide variety of support services to promote the company's product portfolio and develop and support the Marketing Department to increase company revenue and profit; and has a leadership role with less experienced marketers and carrier relations; and participates in setting the strategic direction of the department and represents the company professionally at outside events.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Agent Support Functions:  Promote the company’s product portfolio at a “proficient” level to qualify for the Senior Marketing Consultant position within product area and the ability to cross-sell, educate and promote all company products and services. Have proven ability to operate at an expert level when working with the technology required to produce at a high level. This includes, but is not limited to the software, hardware, tools, websites and web-based programs that the company utilizes to execute this position.

Team Roster:  Develop assigned marketing plans and provide service assistance to agents; Handle 50–100 telephone calls per day with  agencies and agents on all aspects of assigned products; Recruit, train, service and assist agents to enable agents to produce at highest level possible; Assist agents with issues including recruit kits for carriers, training, contracting, certification, transactional issues such as electronic signature, telephonic signatures and app-by-email; Communicate with agents regularly regarding product information, rate changes and key agent benefits; Monitor compliance with program reporting rules and sales requirements; Provide technical support training, sales and marketing coaching; Identify and cultivate top producers; Identify problem agents; Recruit agents to participate in special opportunities, such as new lead sources, alternative methods of enrollment (e-commerce, e-signature, tele-app., etc.). Develop a Team Roster of agents/agencies and maintain regular contact/support. Manage Team Roster and excel in managing book of business.  Show a proven pattern of managing complex relationships and the ability to support/educate/establish credibility with biggest producers.   It may also require the ability to help train the field, as well as internal employees, on compliance and suitability requirements to do business with certain carriers. Normally there should be no communication directly with the end consumer; all communications with the end consumer should be made by and through the Agent. There can be exceptions to this rule based on specific circumstances and requests. For example, a marketer cannot participate in the closing of a sale or make recommendations. However, it may be possible to lend support regarding specific product information. This needs to be reviewed and approved by a marketing supervisor prior to the conversation taking place.

Leadership Responsibilities:  Demonstrated expertise in all aspects of the job including task management, carrier knowledge, technology, problem solving, negotiating and marketing strategies.  Represents company at carrier meetings, teleconferences and has authority to contact selected carrier reps to resolve problem situations.  Serves as a resource for newer marketers in mastering the role.  Follows all company procedures and fully capable to manage the most sensitive relationships.  Develops strong relationships between departments and communicates effectively in writing, phone and stand-up presentations.  Has assigned regional responsibilities for carriers that are managed regionally.  Regularly leads discussions at Department marketing meetings and is respected by peers, carriers and producers.

Department Support Functions:  Update and maintain system information in accordance with policies and procedures; Manage Team Roster; Update and maintain task list.  Have working knowledge of Who Quit Writing, Debit Balances, MGA reports, lead distribution/lead management, incomplete contracts, certification process, moving agents and agencies into production, able to conduct webinars and display/introduce SMS technology tools. Ability to conduct agent webinars, product introductions, special projects and prepare information for internal marketing meetings.  Assist with training of new employees.   Ability to travel on behalf of the company to attend meetings.


QUALIFICATIONS
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

High School Diploma or GED

Bachelor's Degree in Marketing or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience

Five (5) or more years of General Insurance Industry or related field (financial Services, marketing, web-based business,  business-to-business customer service or call center

Valid Life/Health Insurance License within 90 Days


SKILLS

Enhanced knowledge of insurance services industries and specific current knowledge of product lines assigned to the marketer.

Fully proficient in SMS products, technology and services.

Highly experienced in working effectively with inbound and outbound callers/ customers.

Proficient at negotiating and problem solving to resolve internal and external conflicts.

Proven skill in initiating change needed to help Department improve processes and achieve business goals.

Proven skill in the use of office equipment including computer, fax, printer, telephone system, etc.

Proficient in the use of time management and organization skills and leads by example in terms of documentation, Contact Manager usage, etc.

Experience in maintaining effective working relationships with all customers, employees and the general public.  Maintains confidentiality of discussions including SMS business strategy, carrier data, employee personal information; and any Nondisclosure Agreements that are entered into by the Company.

Excels in project management.

Proficient computer skills (Microsoft/Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Adobe Acrobat, MS Outlook software preferred) including conducting effective webinars with producers.

Proven ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, in a constructive manner and properly document information such as contracts sent, conversations with agents and agent or company commitments in the Contact Manager.

Proven ability to approach and communicate with a wide range of personalities in a professional and courteous manner.

Proven ability to engage in effective interpersonal interaction, verbal communication and written communication.

Proven ability to persuade.

Successfully able to maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail while remaining flexible and responsive when faced with multiple urgent requests.

Proven ability to read, write and communicate English effectively and articulately.

Proven ability to maintain all company policies, including all confidentiality and safety policies.

Effectively and actively contribute to team effort.

Proven ability to work independently, exercise independent judgment, make and execute decisions.

Proven ability to be a self-starter motivated and accomplish goals and tasks within a given time frame.

jobs.title: Underwriter Lead
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY

Responsible for reviewing, underwriting and rating broker submissions for new and renewal business.  Ensures content of submissions is complete; obtains additional information from Retail Producers and Account Managers as needed.  Markets to carrier to obtain quotes, negotiate pricing, define coverage's, and determine commissions

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Evaluates new and renewal business in accordance with established underwriting guidelines in order to achieve goals of profit, rate and growth;

Manages preparation of program renewal specifications and distribution to markets;

Participates in all appropriate committees as recognized in managed programs;

Works with program’s insurance/reinsurance markets to formalize and implement annual business plan;

Manages renewal expiration lists and creates timelines for renewals;

Reviews policies and endorsements to identify errors or omissions to ensure agreement with binding order; reviews for discrepancies with application, quote, proposal, and/or binder;

Orders necessary reports such as credit, location, motor vehicle, and/or inspection reports, as well as building cost estimates;

Analyzes inspection reports to accept or reject new business;

Coordinates the preparation of policy delivery with all related documents;

Issues policies and endorsements; binds coverage and coordinates binders/evidences;

Technical expert assisting management, staff, producers, carriers and account managers with resolving complex issues;

Coordinates the preparation and distribution of management reports;

Maintains and manages coverage bordereaux;

Manages and delegates work to underwriters, assistant underwriters and administrative staff; monitors to ensure timely and accurate completion;

Maintains updated logs; submissions, written or lost business;

Maintains files, historical data and client suspense; conducts follow-ups as appropriate;

Coordinates underwriting audits;

Complies with agency management system data standards and data integrity (enters and maintains complete and accurate information);

Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

Eight (8) or more years related work experience, knowledge of insurance industry and prior supervisory experience

Valid Insurance License

Must continue to meet requirements for license renewal

DL NUMBER - Driver License, Valid and in State

jobs.title: Assistant Controller
jobs.description_html:
*****NO RECRUITERS PLEASE*****

Assistant Controller (CPA Required) | Hybrid

Experienced Senior Accountants and Accounting Managers with an active CPA license are encouraged to apply. We are seeking professionals with expertise in budget preparation, leadership of month-end close processes, team management, and driving process improvement initiatives.

POSITION SUMMARY

Windward Risk Managers is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Assistant Controller (CPA Required) to support the Controller in leading the organization's accounting and financial reporting functions. This highly visible leadership role is responsible for overseeing month-end close. financial reporting, budgeting, cost allocation, financial analysis, and accounting operations while providing guidance and mentorship to the accounting team.

The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in financial reporting, budgeting, and process improvement, along with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Hybrid Schedule: This position offers a hybrid schedule of four days in the office and one day remote following the initial training period. During training (up to six months), the position is fully onsite five days per week.
 

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

General Ledger and Financial Reporting

  • Lead month-end closing and preparation of monthly internal financial statements and reporting packages.
  • Review journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and reports.
  • Work closely with the Commissions team to develop, analyze, and reconcile reports and statements.
  • Support Accounts Payable and Claims Billing functions as needed.
  • Train and mentor junior staff.
  • Assist with annual audit preparations.
  • Assist with system reviews and process improvements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Budgeting & Financial Analysis

  • Lead the annual operating budget process in coordination with department heads.
  • Maintain department-level budgets and support models.
  • Prepare monthly budget-to-actual variance analyses.
  • Partner with department leaders to review variances and support corrective actions.
  • Ensure budgets align with organizational objectives and cost structures.

Cost Allocation & Expense Management

  • Develop, document, and maintain cost allocation methodologies across departments, entities, and cost centers.
  • Ensure cost allocations are applied consistently, accurately, and in accordance with internal policies.
  • Collaborate with Accounting to reconcile allocated costs to the general ledger and resolve discrepancies.
  • Assesses allocation methodologies periodically to ensure continued appropriateness and transparency.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune’s Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting
  • Active CPA License (Required)
  • More than five years of progressive accounting experience, preferably in publicly traded and multi-entity environments
  • Experience in budgeting, cost analysis, and cost allocation
  • Experience leading month-end close
  • Strong understanding of financial reporting and meeting deadlines

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas and financial models
  • Solid understanding of general ledger accounting and expense structures
  • Ability to communicate financial concepts to non-financial audiences
  • Proven ability to collaborate across departments
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities
     

Due to current business and operational considerations, we currently hire employees residing in the following states at this time: AL, AR, CA, CT, FL, GA, KY, MO, NC, NV, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WI.

Work Authorization Requirement:

  • This role requires permanent U.S. work authorization and does not offer employer sponsorship now or in the future.

​​​​WRM is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We take affirmative action to ensure that all employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and abilities.

Notice to Third Party Agencies: WRM does not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting firms. Absent a signed Service Agreement by WRM’s Human Resources Department, WRM reserves the right to pursue and hire these candidates without financial obligation to recruiters or agencies.

jobs.title: Business Analyst I, II, III (Personal & Commercial Residential Insurance)
jobs.description_html:
Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst with solid expertise in personal and/or commercial residential property insurance to support and enhance our Policy and/or Claims Administration systems. This role will partner with business stakeholders and technology teams to analyze workflows, define requirements, support system enhancements, and resolve production issues that impact critical insurance operations.

This position may be filled at the BA I, BA II, or BA III level, depending on the candidate’s experience, skills, and demonstrated ability to work independently, lead initiatives, and influence outcomes. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, regulated environment with evolving priorities.

Essential Functions:

Business & Systems Analysis

  • Partner directly with Underwriting, Product, Operations, Compliance, Claims, and Technology teams to gather and document business requirements
  • Translate underwriting and/or claims guidelines, eligibility rules, rates, forms, endorsements, and workflows into functional system requirements
  • Support enhancements and configuration of online quote/bind applications and policy/claims administration systems
  • Create user stories, business process flows, requirement documentation, acceptance criteria, and traceability artifacts
  • Analyze impacts of product or regulatory changes to system functionality and business processes
  • Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned to support business objectives.

Project Delivery & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Participate in or lead requirements workshops, discovery sessions, and backlog refinement meetings.
  • Manage changing priorities and scope while ensuring requirements remain clear, documented, and approved.
  • Participate in testing validation, defect triage, and production implementation activities
  • Provide clear, timely communication and status updates to stakeholders.

Documentation & Quality Assurance

  • Create and maintain documentation while ensuring Confluence is consistently updated and serves as the single source of truth for requirements including workflows, business rules, system behaviors, and configuration details.
  • Develop and execute test plans, track defects and coordinate fixes.
  • Ensure delivered solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and compliance expectations.

Production Support & Issue Resolution

  • Troubleshoot system issues, identify root cause, and coordinate resolution with IT and development teams.
  • Support production incidents and escalated help desk tickets related to our systems.
  • Communicate issue status, risks, and resolution progress effectively to business partners.
  • Review escalated Service Desk tickets to identify opportunities for process improvement, knowledge base development, and training, facilitating the transition of repeatable support activities and issue resolution from higher support tiers to Level 1 Service Desk teams.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune's 2026 Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • Professional experience in the Property & Casualty Homeowners and/or Residential Commercial insurance industry functioning in a Business Analyst capacity, including requirements elicitation, documentation, and collaboration with technical teams to implement changes to insurance or policy administration systems.
  • Proven experience analyzing business problems, troubleshooting issues, and applying logical, detail-oriented approaches to develop effective solutions with limited supervision.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple assignments simultaneously, prioritizing work, managing scope, and driving work to completion with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.
  • Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional teams, business stakeholders, and technical resources, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working in Agile / Scrum or sprint-based delivery environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in a Business Analyst role within the Property & Casualty insurance industry.
  • Experience supporting Homeowners and/or Residential Commercial lines of business for Florida, Texas, and/or California risks, including familiarity with state-specific products, forms, rating, underwriting, or regulatory requirements.
  • Experience with Duck Creek.
  • Familiarity with regulated environments such as Florida and/or Texas.
  • Insurance carrier or MGA background strongly preferred.
  • Business Analyst certification (CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA) a plus.

Essential Skills:

  • Ability to understand technical concepts and communicate effectively with developers and system vendors.
  • Strong attention to detail especially when working with policy, forms, rating, claims, or billing system changes.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to evaluate business needs and translate them into clear, well-defined requirements.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining accountability for quality and timeliness of deliverables.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to research issues, recreate steps, identify root causes, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Ability to understand complex business processes, system workflows, and dependencies.
  • Proficiency with business analysis, documentation, and collaboration tools used to support project delivery.
     

Due to current business and operational considerations, we currently hire employees residing in the following states at this time: AL, AR, CA, CT, FL, GA, KY, MO, NC, NV, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WI.

Work Authorization Requirement:

  • This role requires permanent U.S. work authorization and does not offer employer sponsorship now or in the future.

We take affirmative action to ensure that all employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and abilities.

jobs.description_html:
Position Summary:

This senior-level management role will drive the development of a new commercial residential property insurance product line in Florida. The position requires a collaborative leader with deep expertise in product development, underwriting, and market risk modeling and analysis.

Essential Functions:

  • Develop and implement a commercial residential program aligned with the organization’s risk appetite, goals, and objectives to accelerate business growth.
  • Create a detailed business plan that aligns to the commercial residential opportunities in the Florida market including opportunities, risk parameters, and underwriting requirements.
  • Utilize expertise to develop commercial residential underwriting activities and processes to address all aspects of potential risk.
  • Partner with the risk management team to develop guidelines, forms, and procedures regarding risk exposure, application requirements, and other related activities.
  • Collaborate and coordinate with leaders across the organization to meet the goals and objectives of the program.
  • Monitor performance, analyze data, and identify trends and opportunities for improvement of the program.
  • Assist in setting financial targets, budget development and monitoring.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees

  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support

  • Minimum 15 years underwriting, product development or related experience in the property insurance industry, with at least 10 years focused on Florida Commercial Residential policies.
  • 5+ years' proven leadership/management experience required.
  • CPCU certification preferred.

jobs.title: Help Desk Analyst III (Contract)
jobs.description_html:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Windward Risk Managers is seeking an experienced Help Desk Analyst III to serve as a senior technical
resource within the IT Help Desk. This hands-on position handles complex incidents and escalations that
exceed Level 1 and Level 2 capabilities, independently drives issues through resolution, and partners with
Infrastructure, Systems, Network, and Security teams on advanced troubleshooting. The successful candidate
will also mentor junior technicians, strengthen documentation and operational standards, and contribute to
endpoint management and technology rollouts while maintaining responsive end-user support.

WORK LOCATION: 
This is a full-time, in-person position based at our Boca Raton, Florida office during regular business hours. Remote and hybrid work arrangements are not available for this role.
 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Own and resolve advanced Level 2 escalations and complex Level 3 incidents; conduct root-cause
analysis, document findings, and coordinate with specialist teams when infrastructure-level changes are
required.
• Provide expert remote and onsite support for Windows 11 and macOS endpoints, including recurring
operating system failures, application conflicts, device performance, encryption, driver and peripheral
issues.
• Troubleshoot Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online issues involving Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, shared
mailboxes, permissions, licensing, authentication, and user productivity.
• Perform advanced Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID account, group, access and identity
troubleshooting; follow approved access controls and change procedures.
• Diagnose client-side network and remote access issues using DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, Wi-Fi and VPN
troubleshooting; collaborate with Network and Security teams on upstream causes.
• Use NinjaOne and other approved remote management tools to investigate endpoint health, deploy
software, execute vetted scripts, support patch remediation, and improve endpoint consistency.
• Lead technically complex onboarding, offboarding, device replacement, reimaging and hardware lifecycle
tasks, ensuring accurate provisioning and asset records.
• Provide technical ownership for Help Desk workstreams in system migrations, operating system upgrades,
software deployments, service catalog improvements, and ticketing platform initiatives.
• Mentor Level 1 and Level 2 analysts through ticket reviews, troubleshooting guidance and knowledge
transfer; help establish clear escalation standards and reduce repeat incidents.
• Maintain accurate tickets, troubleshooting notes, knowledge articles and SOPs; adhere to security, audit,
change management and documentation requirements.
• Identify recurring incidents, propose automation and preventive fixes, and contribute to service quality,
response-time and resolution improvements.
• Communicate clearly with end users, management and cross-functional technical teams during
high-priority incidents and outages.
 

WHY WINDWARD RISK MANAGERS:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune's 2026 Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• At least 5 years of progressive hands-on IT support experience, including substantial Level 2
troubleshooting and demonstrated ownership of senior-level escalations; equivalent relevant experience
will be considered.
• Strong practical knowledge of Windows endpoint support, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Active
Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.
• Demonstrated ability to independently diagnose complex hardware, software, identity, connectivity and
endpoint management issues rather than relying solely on scripted troubleshooting.
• Working knowledge of DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, VPN connectivity and common network troubleshooting tools.
• Experience with RMM platforms, remote support, patching, software deployment and endpoint lifecycle
management.
• Experience using an ITSM ticketing platform and maintaining thorough, audit-ready ticket documentation.
• Strong judgment, prioritization, customer service, communication and mentoring skills; ability to work
effectively in a fast-paced onsite support environment.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• CompTIA Network+, Security+, Microsoft MD-102, or comparable relevant certification.
• Hands-on experience with NinjaOne, HaloITSM or ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus.
• Experience with PowerShell for troubleshooting and approved endpoint automation.
• Experience supporting a multi-site, security-conscious or regulated organization, including documented
access controls and change management.
• Exposure to endpoint security tools, Microsoft Intune, and cross-functional incident response.


ROLE EXPECTATIONS:

This is a senior individual-contributor position, not a people-management role. The Analyst III remains
actively engaged in the support queue while taking primary ownership of escalated technical issues,
mentoring junior analysts, and helping improve Help Desk operations.
 

Due to current business and operational considerations, we currently hire employees residing in the following states at this time: AL, AR, CA, CT, FL, GA, KY, MO, NC, NV, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WI.

Candidates must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future.

WRM is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We take affirmative action to ensure that all employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and abilities.

Notice to Third Party Agencies: WRM does not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting firms. Absent a signed Service Agreement by WRM’s Human Resources Department, WRM reserves the right to pursue and hire these candidates without financial obligation to recruiters or agencies.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative - (California)
jobs.description_html:
***Candidates must reside in California for this role ***

Position Summary: 

The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) is responsible for sales development efforts to assigned agencies. The ISR will provide training and support to agencies on use of WRM systems, tools, and resources to develop sales of WRM products. This position will support agencies in multiple markets and various states and may require non-standard hours.

Essential Functions:

  • Work with assigned agents by proactively providing support and training to facilitate sales of WRM insurance products. 
  • Assist with sales campaigns as assigned 
  • Provide concierge service for new business issues to specific high-performance agencies 
  • Contact agencies when new market opportunities arise to increase quoting activity and applications
  • Complete quote data for agents to facilitate the move of books of business
  • Support the Sales Development Managers (SDM) with their agents as requested
  • May be asked to support the CAT response efforts in the event of a storm

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description_html:
Position Summary: 

We are seeking a strong, hands-on Network Engineer to join our IT infrastructure team. Reporting to the Senior Network Engineer, this role owns the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and improvement of the company's network, firewall, and connectivity infrastructure across on-premises data centers and a growing Microsoft Azure environment, including the Cisco compute fabric, NetApp storage networking, and Palo Alto security platforms that support it. The ideal candidate is a deeply technical engineer with strong fundamentals, disciplined troubleshooting, and excellent documentation.

Work Location:
This is a full-time, in-person position based at our Boca Raton, Florida office. Remote and hybrid work arrangements are not available for this role.

Technical Environment: 

  • Security: Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls (PAN-OS) across on-premises data centers and Azure, GlobalProtect VPN, Cloudflare, and Zero Trust / network access control.
  • Switching and compute fabric: Cisco Catalyst campus switching and Cisco Nexus (NX-OS) data-center switching; Cisco UCS X-Series (chassis, Fabric Interconnects, Intersight).
  • Routing and WAN: BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP across a multi-site WAN (MPLS / DIA circuits) with site-to-site IPSec VPN.
  • Storage networking: NetApp ONTAP (FAS / AFF) with SnapMirror replication; Tintri.
  • Cloud: a substantial and growing Microsoft Azure networking footprint (hub-and-spoke VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, Azure Firewall, NSGs, and user-defined routes).
  • Wireless and monitoring: UniFi wireless; Site24x7 monitoring.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate, maintain, and monitor enterprise LAN, WAN, and UniFi wireless infrastructure across multiple sites.
  • Administer Palo Alto Networks firewalls (PAN-OS), including security policy, NAT, threat prevention, URL filtering, and GlobalProtect VPN; tune App-ID and SSL / TLS decryption.
  • Design, implement, and support Microsoft Azure networking, including hub-and-spoke VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, Azure Firewall, NSGs, and user-defined routes.
  • Configure and troubleshoot routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP) across Cisco Catalyst and Cisco Nexus (NX-OS) switches and the Cisco UCS X-Series Fabric Interconnect environment in a multi-site network.
  • Build and maintain site-to-site IPSec VPN connectivity with business partners and vendors.
  • Support NetApp ONTAP storage networking and replication.
  • Administer network monitoring platforms; maintain alerting, dashboards, NetFlow, and device-health visibility.
  • Administer and support network security applications and Zero Trust / network access control.
  • Respond to network alerts and incidents; perform root-cause analysis and permanent remediation.
  • Participate in planned maintenance windows, including change preparation, verification, and rollback procedures.
  • Create and maintain network documentation, diagrams, IP address management (IPAM), and runbooks.
  • Install, rack, and cable network hardware; support equipment lifecycle and refresh projects.
  • Assist with network security tasks, including certificate management, vulnerability remediation, and access reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune's 2026 Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of hands-on network engineering or network administration experience.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP fundamentals, including subnetting, routing, NAT, DNS, and DHCP.
  • Production experience with enterprise-class routers and switches, including Cisco Catalyst, Cisco Nexus (NX-OS), and Cisco UCS X-Series Fabric Interconnects.
  • Hands-on production experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls (PAN-OS), including security policy, NAT, and VPN.
  • Working knowledge of at least one dynamic routing protocol (OSPF, EIGRP, or BGP).
  • Demonstrated experience with Microsoft Azure networking (VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, NSGs, and routing).
  • Experience with NetApp (or comparable enterprise) storage and its supporting network connectivity.
  • Experience with network monitoring tools and alerting platforms.
  • Experience supporting network security applications.
  • Methodical troubleshooting skills using packet captures, logs, and device diagnostics.
  • Strong written documentation skills.
  • Works well in a collaborative team environment, with strong self-motivation to drive projects through to completion.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Palo Alto Networks Network Security Professional, the entry-level certification in the current role-based program. The legacy PCNSA also applies.
  • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA).
  • Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700) and / or Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104).
  • NetApp Certified Technology Associate (NCTA).
  • Experience with Cisco UCS X-Series and Intersight data-center compute fabric.
  • IPSec VPN design and troubleshooting experience.
  • Familiarity with server, virtualization, or storage environments.

Work Environment:

  • Reports to: Senior Network Engineer.
  • Scope: owns day-to-day network operations and project execution; partners with the Senior Network Engineer, who leads network architecture and standards.
  • Full-time position with participation in an on-call rotation.
  • Occasional travel between company sites may be required.
     

Due to current business and operational considerations, we currently hire employees residing in the following states at this time: AL, AR, CA, CT, FL, GA, KY, MO, NC, NV, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WI.

Candidates must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future.

WRM is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We take affirmative action to ensure that all employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and abilities.

Notice to Third Party Agencies: WRM does not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting firms. Absent a signed Service Agreement by WRM’s Human Resources Department, WRM reserves the right to pursue and hire these candidates without financial obligation to recruiters or agencies.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description_html:
Position Summary:

We are seeking a detail-oriented Project Manager to support the planning, execution, and delivery of projects in an Agile environment. This role is accountable for coordinating project activities, managing timelines and deliverables, tracking risks and dependencies, and communicating status to stakeholders. The Project Manager will lead Scrum-based delivery activities as part of the overall project execution, ensuring work is planned, monitored, and delivered in alignment with business objectives.

Essential Functions:

  • Project Planning & Execution:
    Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables. Track progress against plans and support on-time, on-scope delivery.
  • Individual Work & Progress Tracking:
    Actively track each team member’s planned and completed work, including commitments made during daily stand-ups and sprint planning. Retain and follow up on prior-day and sprint-level commitments to ensure transparency, accountability, and forward momentum.
  • Delivery Awareness & System Understanding:
    Develop a working understanding of the systems, applications, and business processes the team supports in order to effectively track progress, ask informed questions, and identify delivery risks or bottlenecks.
  • Scope, Schedule & Resource Coordination:
    Assist in defining project scope, managing changes, and coordinating resources across cross-functional teams to meet delivery commitments.
  • Agile & Scrum Delivery Oversight:
    Lead Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives as part of the project execution framework. Ensure Agile practices are applied to support delivery predictability and transparency.
  • Stakeholder Management & Communication:
    Serve as a primary point of contact for project communications. Provide regular status updates on progress, risks, issues, and dependencies to business and technical stakeholders.
  • Risk, Issue & Dependency Management:
    Identify, document, and track project risks, issues, and dependencies. Support mitigation plans and escalate concerns as needed to minimize delivery impacts.
  • Reporting & Documentation:
    Maintain project documentation, schedules, and status reports. Ensure project information is accurate, current, and accessible.
  • Delivery Governance & Controls:
    Support adherence to project management standards, processes, and governance requirements while ensuring alignment with Agile delivery practices.
  • Continuous Improvement:
    Capture lessons learned and contribute to process improvements to enhance project execution and delivery outcomes.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune's 2026 Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, IT, or a related field.
  • Project management certification (PMP, CAPM)
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience managing projects within the homeowner’s insurance domain, including coordination of cross-functional teams and delivery of business or system initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proficiency in tools like JIRA, Trello, Miro, Smartsheet, or MS Project

Essential Skills:

  • Strong foundational understanding of project management principles (scope, schedule, cost, risk).
  • Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum delivery within a project-managed environment.
  • Clear and professional communication skills with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a structured, deadline-driven environment.
     

Due to current business and operational considerations, we currently hire employees residing in the following states at this time: AL, AR, CA, CT, FL, GA, KY, MO, NC, NV, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WI.

Candidates must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future.

The SDMs measure of success is broken into key annual objectives with specific metrics agreed upon with the Director of Sales:

jobs.title: Senior Database Administrator
jobs.description_html:
Position Summary: 

Windward Risk Managers is seeking a highly skilled Senior Database Administrator to serve as the primary administrator for the company’s Microsoft SQL Server and Azure SQL database estate across on-prem and cloud environments. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in SQL Server administration, high-availability architecture, and Azure SQL / Managed Instance, with a focus on continuously improving, optimizing, and validating database performance, protection, and recoverability. This role owns database-level backup, recovery, and disaster-recovery readiness in close partnership with the Systems, Network, Security, and broader Infrastructure teams to keep business-critical data protected, performant, and recoverable.

Work Location:
This is a full-time, in-person position based at our Boca Raton, Florida office. Remote and hybrid work arrangements are not available for this role.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary administrator for the company’s Microsoft SQL Server and Azure SQL / Managed Instance environments across on-prem data centers and Azure, including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, and instance consolidation.
  • Design, implement, and maintain database high-availability and disaster-recovery architecture, including Always On Availability Groups, failover clustering, log shipping, and replication, aligned to defined Recovery Time Objective and Recovery Point Objective targets, and partner with the System Administrator on infrastructure-level DR planning, runbooks, and failover testing.
  • Own the database backup strategy, covering native and third-party backups, transaction-log management, point-in-time recovery, retention, and immutability, and coordinate with the Systems team so database backups integrate cleanly with the Veeam, storage, and Azure data-protection environment.
  • Validate recoverability through regular restore testing and automated verification; confirm all critical databases are covered, configurations follow best practices, and gaps are identified and remediated.
  • Continuously monitor, tune, and optimize database performance, including query and index tuning, execution plans, wait-statistics analysis, capacity and growth planning, and resource governance, to sustain performance and availability as data volumes grow.
  • Size and scale the company’s database estate across both Azure and on-premises data centers, right-sizing compute, memory, and storage capacity and expanding or consolidating resources appropriately as workloads change to meet performance, business continuity, backup, and DR targets while maintaining access control and cost governance.
  • Administer database security, including authentication, role-based access control, encryption (TDE, Always Encrypted), key management, and least-privilege enforcement, in coordination with the Security team.
  • Contribute to the company’s business continuity program, supporting business impact analysis, recovery strategies for critical data assets, and the ongoing maintenance and testing of continuity plans as systems change.
  • Monitor database health, capacity, and SLA compliance; perform root cause analysis on failures and performance incidents and implement preventive measures.
  • Support compliance and audit requirements related to data protection, retention, access, and recoverability, including evidence gathering and remediation of audit findings.
  • Automate administration, verification, and reporting with PowerShell and T-SQL; maintain runbooks and documentation; serve as the escalation point for database and recovery issues.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for database administration, performance, high availability, and recovery operations.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune's 2026 Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • 7 to 10 years of database administration experience in a hybrid (cloud and on-premises) environment.
  • Hands-on production experience designing and managing Microsoft SQL Server, including high-availability configurations (Always On Availability Groups, failover clustering).
  • Administrator-level experience with Azure SQL Database and / or Azure SQL Managed Instance (provisioning, access control, storage, cost governance).
  • Solid understanding of database backup and disaster-recovery concepts, including Recovery Point Objective and Recovery Time Objective, replication, log shipping, snapshots, immutability, point-in-time recovery, and DR testing.
  • Strong performance-tuning skills, including query optimization, indexing strategy, execution-plan analysis, and capacity planning.
  • Practical PowerShell and T-SQL scripting skills; working knowledge of Windows Server and enterprise storage.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, the ability to prioritize effectively, and clear written and verbal communication.
     

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate (DP-300)
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
  • Experience with SQL Server on VMware vSphere and with Veeam application-aware / database backups
     

Due to current business and operational considerations, we currently hire employees residing in the following states at this time: AL, AR, CA, CT, FL, GA, KY, MO, NC, NV, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WI.

Candidates must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future.

WRM is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We take affirmative action to ensure that all employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and abilities.

Notice to Third Party Agencies: WRM does not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting firms. Absent a signed Service Agreement by WRM’s Human Resources Department, WRM reserves the right to pursue and hire these candidates without financial obligation to recruiters or agencies.

jobs.description_html:
***Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to Brevard, Osceola, and Indian River Counties***

Position Summary:

Position is responsible for prompt and thorough investigation of routine to moderately complex residential property claims.  This is a field-based position involving on-site inspection of insured properties.  Regular travel within assigned territory is required.

Essential Functions:

  • Prompt and courteous servicing of property claims, including insured and agency contact and follow through.
  • Communicate and interact with a variety of individuals to foster the timely resolution of claims, including, but not limited to, policyholders, public adjusters, attorneys, vendors, and experts.
  • Timely identification, analysis and resolution of coverage issues arising in claims investigation.
  • Factual investigation of cause of loss.
  • Coverage determination based on a variety of policy and endorsements.
  • Maintain proper file documentation reflecting progressive claim handling.
  • Coverage and Payment Letters necessary to settle and conclude the claim.

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience:

  • Must maintain a Florida All-Lines adjuster (620) license.
  • 3+ years of homeowner’s claims field adjusting experience required handling all perils. 
  • Must be proficient with Xactimate and sketching, including mobile applications (iPad etc.)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Exceptional customer service skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.

jobs.title: System Administrator
jobs.description_html:
Position Summary:

Windward Risk Managers is seeking a highly skilled System Administrator to serve as the primary administrator for backup, recovery, and cloud infrastructure across the company’s on-prem and cloud environments. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Veeam, vCenter, and Microsoft Azure, with a focus on continuously improving, optimizing, and validating data protection and high-availability architecture. This role leads disaster-recovery planning and testing in partnership with the Systems, Network, Database, and Security teams to keep business-critical systems protected and recoverable.

Work Location:
This is a full-time, in-person position based at our Boca Raton, Florida office. Remote and hybrid work arrangements are not available for this role.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Continuously improve and evolve the company’s disaster-recovery environment across our data centers and Azure; lead DR planning, runbooks, and failover testing, engaging the Systems, Network, Database, and Security teams; configure fault-tolerant features and maintain Recovery Time Objective and Recovery Point Objective documentation.
  • Design, implement, and optimize the Veeam Backup & Replication environment, including job architecture, repositories, replication, retention and immutability policies, and storage usage.
  • Administer the VMware vSphere / vCenter environment as it relates to data protection, including replication and recovery validation, along with the supporting SAN / NAS storage (NetApp, Tintri), deduplication appliances (ExaGrid), and immutable backup repositories.
  • Validate backup integrity through regular restore testing and automated verification; confirm all critical systems are covered, configurations follow best practices, and gaps are remediated.
  • Contribute to the company’s business continuity program, supporting business impact analysis, recovery strategies for critical business functions, and the ongoing maintenance and testing of business continuity plans as infrastructure and systems change.
  • Manage and expand the company’s Microsoft Azure footprint, building out cloud infrastructure to support business continuity, backup, and DR targets while maintaining storage, access control, and cost governance as adoption grows.
  • Monitor backup health, capacity, and SLA compliance; perform root cause analysis on failures and implement preventive measures.
  • Support compliance and audit requirements related to data protection, backup retention, and recoverability, including evidence gathering and remediation of audit findings.
  • Automate verification and reporting with PowerShell; maintain runbooks and documentation; serve as the escalation point for backup and recovery issues.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for data protection, storage management, and recovery operations.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune's 2026 Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • 5 to 8 years of systems administration experience in a hybrid (cloud and on-premises) environment.
  • Hands-on production experience designing and managing Veeam Backup & Replication and VMware vSphere / vCenter environments.
  • Administrator-level experience with Microsoft Azure (resources, access control, storage, cost governance).
  • Solid understanding of backup and disaster-recovery concepts, including Recovery Point Objective and Recovery Time Objective, replication, snapshots, immutability, and DR testing.
  • Practical PowerShell scripting skills; working knowledge of Windows Server and enterprise storage (NetApp and / or Tintri preferred).
  • Strong problem-solving skills, the ability to prioritize effectively, and clear written and verbal communication.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Veeam Certified Engineer (VMCE)
  • VMware Certified Professional (VCP) or Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104)
     

Due to current business and operational considerations, we currently hire employees residing in the following states at this time: AL, AR, CA, CT, FL, GA, KY, MO, NC, NV, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WI.

Candidates must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future.

WRM is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We take affirmative action to ensure that all employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and abilities.

Notice to Third Party Agencies: WRM does not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting firms. Absent a signed Service Agreement by WRM’s Human Resources Department, WRM reserves the right to pursue and hire these candidates without financial obligation to recruiters or agencies.

Will you be graduating this year with a passion for risk assessment? Are you looking to kickstart your career in the insurance industry? Join our team as an Associate Underwriter and embark on a journey of learning and professional growth.

jobs.title: Employee Benefits
jobs.description_html:
Why Join Marshall+Sterling?

As a 100% employee-owned company with roots dating back to 1864, Marshall+Sterling offers the strength of a time-tested organization and the energy of an ownership-driven culture. Guided by our mission to empower clients to predict, prepare for, and preempt risk, we are relentlessly focused on helping people and businesses protect what matters most — so they can move forward with confidence. Our vision of creating a future that’s safer and more secure drives everything we do.

Innovation is not optional here — it's imperative. We constantly seek better, smarter ways to serve our clients and improve as a company. Collaboration is at our core, because we know we are stronger together — across teams, with our clients, and in the communities we serve. Our employee-owners are not only valued and empowered, but also directly invested in our collective success.

At Marshall+Sterling, you’re not just joining a company — you’re joining an inclusive culture built on integrity, impact, and people-first values. Your ideas matter, your growth is prioritized, and your work helps shape a more secure future for all.

Join our Client Solutions team and play an important role in helping clients navigate the complexities of benefits compliance and regulatory reporting. In this role, you’ll partner with internal teams and client HR and Benefits Administrators to deliver accurate, reliable compliance support that helps clients stay informed and on track. From preparing Wrap, SPD, and POP documents to completing Form 5500 filings, supporting monthly ACA reporting, and calculating and communicating PCORI fees, you’ll bring organization, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to work that makes a real difference for our clients.

Primary responsibilities:

  • Create Wrap/SPD/POP compliance documents for new and renewing clients, drafting from client and Benefit Point data, routing for Account Manager review, and finalizing for client delivery
  • Complete Form 5500 report filings, including determining filing requirements, gathering required schedules and data, and completing filings
  • Support ACA monthly check-ins, plan updates, and year-end reporting for an assigned book of ACA clients
  • Calculate and communicate PCORI fees, including requesting covered life counts from carriers and sending fee notices to clients
  • Follow established workflows and update internal systems accurately
  • Adhere to established employee manual policies and guidelines
  • Maintain confidentiality in all aspects of client, staff and agency information

Qualifications

  • Ability to manage data within compliance and benefits administration systems
  • Proficient with basic office automation software; strong background with Microsoft Outlook, Excel and Word preferred
  • Ability to effectively and accurately manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • High level of organizational ability with attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Knowledge of ERISA, ACA and Group Health Insurance plan design is a plus, but not required.

Total Rewards Package:

Compensation: $47,500 - $52,500, based on experience, education, and work location.

Benefits: Comprehensive package including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with match, Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), thirteen paid holidays, company-paid life insurance for you and your dependents, employee assistance fund and programs, wellness perks, and more!

Employee Stock Ownership Program

  • Review policies for accuracy and completeness, ensuring updates are made per workflow procedures.
  • Address cancellation requests and assist in retaining accounts.
  • Treat each service contact as an opportunity for account development, including upgrading coverage and obtaining referrals.
  • Regularly communicate with clients to thank them for their business and document all interactions regarding coverage and exposures.
  • Perform financial duties as directed by management.

  • College degree preferred, high school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Prior experience in insurance lines of coverage, fundamental rating, underwriting and procedural skills.
  • Experience and knowledge of Microsoft Office programs.
  • Experience with Vertafore a plus.
  • Proven ability to exceed expectations.
  • Appropriate state insurance licenses and continuing education required.
  • Works effectively and relates well with others including superiors, colleagues, and individuals inside and outside the company in a professional manner.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively.
  • High level of organizational ability with attention to detail.

  • Collaborative & Engaged Culture: Employee ownership fosters a team-oriented environment where everyone has a stake in the company’s growth and success.
  • No Out-of-Pocket Costs: Unlike stock purchase plans, our ESOP is entirely company-funded, meaning you gain equity without any personal investment.
