If you’re a hands-on leader who enjoys building strong teams, improving how work gets done, and driving growth, we’d love to have you join us.

  • Lead and develop the region’s leadership team by recruiting, retaining, mentoring, and supporting high-performing Account Managers and Supervisors.
  • Oversee key client relationships and growth opportunities, taking a direct leadership role with the region or division’s largest accounts and supporting strategies that strengthen client retention.
  • Drive effective account management practices by ensuring consistent use of Service Timelines, Book Segmentation, and other tools that support proactive client service and retention.
  • Develop and execute regional business strategies that support growth, profitability, staffing needs, and long-term retention goals.
  • Monitor team performance and operational effectiveness, using key metrics and feedback to identify opportunities, improve processes, and ensure the region is delivering a high level of service.
  • Champion quality, consistency, and innovation by identifying and sharing best practices, strengthening workflows, and supporting the adoption of new technology and agency-wide initiatives.
  • Build a strong employee-owner culture and promote Marshall+Sterling, fostering collaboration across teams while representing the organization positively with employees, clients, and the community.

Qualifications

  • College degree preferred; high school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Appropriate state insurance licenses and required continuing education. Active P+C insurance license preferred
  • Five years of related insurance or business experience, including one to three years of supervisory experience.
  • Strong knowledge of insurance products and brokerage/consulting practices.
  • Strong business, leadership, and strategic decision-making skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and email; Vertafore experience a plus.
  • Valid driver’s license.

Total Rewards Package:

Compensation: $100,000 - $150,000, based on experience, education, and work location.

jobs.title: Software Application Specialist
jobs.description_html:
As a Software Application Specialist, you’ll be the go-to resource for helping employees get the most out of the technology that powers our business. You’ll solve problems, simplify complex technology, provide hands-on training, and help employees work more efficiently across our core applications. You’ll also have the opportunity to research new features and solutions, test system enhancements, create helpful resources, and identify smarter ways to use technology. If you’re naturally curious, enjoy solving problems, and like helping people turn technology into practical solutions, this role offers the opportunity to make a real impact every day.

This role will be based out of Marshall+Sterling’s Poughkeepsie Office, with the expectation of being able to travel to other offices as needed, including Middletown and Latham.

  • Provide day-to-day support for core business applications, including AMS360, BenefitPoint, ImageRight/WorkSmart, Salesforce, Microsoft 365/Office applications, Claude and other approved AI tools, as well as other insurance and business applications.
  • Provide help desk support via phone and email, troubleshoot application issues, respond to employee questions, and ensure timely follow-up on support tickets.
  • Configure and administer applications, including user setup, permissions, adding and updating brokers, companies, and employees, and supporting system upgrades, releases, integrations, and other system changes.
  • Develop and deliver user training, webinars, recordings, guides, procedures, and quick-reference materials to help employees effectively use core systems and applications.
  • Participate in quality assurance and testing of software releases, updates, and system changes to identify and report issues before they impact end users.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize processes, streamline workflows, and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of business applications and technology solutions.
  • Collaborate with internal IT resources and external vendors to escalate and resolve complex issues while applying an understanding of insurance agency workflows and how technology supports business processes.
  • Travel between company locations as needed to provide on-site application support, training, and assistance to employees.

Qualifications

  • Experience supporting business applications, software platforms, or similar technology solutions preferred.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and related productivity tools.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot issues logically and independently.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to train and support both technical and non-technical users.
  • Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and automation platforms.
  • Insurance licenses are a plus. Please include any current licenses with your application.

  • Monitor sales performance and recommend strategies to improve productivity and profitability.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, carrier partners, and internal teams.
  • Stay current on industry trends, market conditions, insurance products, regulatory changes, and emerging technology.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Proven sales and management skills. 

  • Excellent organizational and management skills. 

  • Experience and knowledge of Microsoft Office programs. 

  • Experience with Vertafore a plus. 

  • Ability to delegate effectively. 

  • Works effectively and relates well with others including superiors, colleagues and individuals inside and outside the company in a professional manner. 

  • Appropriate state insurance licenses and continuing education required. 

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively. 

  • High level of organizational ability with attention to detail. 

  • Valid driver’s license and acceptable driving record.

Total Rewards Package:

Compensation: $250,000 - $275,000+, based on demonstrated insurance sales experience and measurable achievements.

Benefits: Comprehensive package including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with match, Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), thirteen paid holidays, company-paid life insurance for you and your dependents, employee assistance fund and programs, wellness perks, and more!

Employee Stock Ownership Program

As a 100% employee-owned company, Marshall+Sterling offers you the unique opportunity to build long-term wealth while growing your career. Here’s what makes our ESOP so valuable:

We’re looking for a people-focused Account Manager who can combine relationship-building with strong commercial insurance expertise to help create a future that’s safer and more secure for our clients. In this role, you’ll manage your own book of business, collaborate with our producers and executives, and deliver the kind of client experience that builds trust and long-term partnerships.

This position can be based out of either Marshall+Sterling’s Middletown office.

If you’re passionate about helping businesses protect what matters, guiding clients through every stage of their risk management journey, and mentoring others to grow alongside you—you’ll thrive here.

  • Manage your own book of business- serving as the main point of contact to ensure smooth account management and exceptional client service.
  • Partner with Sales Executives and Producers to design risk management strategies, prepare renewals, and strengthen client relationships.
  • Lead client meetings including policy reviews, renewal discussions, and coverage planning—both in person and online.
  • Build strong carrier relationships to secure competitive coverage options and resolve client service needs.
  • Review and prepare applications, policies, endorsements, audits, and proposals for accuracy using Microsoft Office and agency systems.
  • Stay up-to-date on industry trends, regulations, carrier guidelines, and coverage changes to provide clients with informed recommendations.
  • Mentor Assistant Account Managers, offering guidance and support to help them succeed.

Qualifications

  • This position requires a P+C brokers license.
  • A four-year college degree in business or related field
  • Experience with basic office automation software, such as Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Must have own transportation or access to reliable transportation and maintain a valid driver's license throughout employment.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

The salary range for this position is $80,000 to $100,000, depending on experience and based on commission.

Benefits: Comprehensive package including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with match, Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), thirteen paid holidays, company-paid life insurance for you and your dependents, employee assistance fund and programs, wellness perks, and more!

This position will be based out of Marshall+Sterling's Latham Office.

We are seeking a licensed and client-focused Client Service Specialist with strong communication skills and a passion for delivering top-tier service in the insurance industry. This role is perfect for a proactive professional who holds a Property+Casualty Insurance license and thrives on building strong client relationships, ensuring policy accuracy, and contributing to account retention and growth. You will play a key role in supporting clients in either personal or commercial insurance, collaborating with internal teams to provide a seamless service experience.

  • Review policy coverage, identify areas for enhancement, and coordinate with the Account Manager.
  • Underwrite individual risk situations to meet agency and carrier standards.
  • Secure applications for coverage from Sales Executives, Account Managers, and/or clients.
  • Review policies for accuracy and completeness, ensuring updates are made per workflow procedures.
  • Address cancellation requests and assist in retaining accounts.
  • Treat each service contact as an opportunity for account development, including upgrading coverage and obtaining referrals.
  • Regularly communicate with clients to thank them for their business and document all interactions regarding coverage and exposures.
  • Perform financial duties as directed by management.

Qualifications

  • College degree preferred, high school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Prior experience in insurance lines of coverage, fundamental rating, underwriting and procedural skills.
  • Experience and knowledge of Microsoft Office programs.
  • Experience with Vertafore a plus.
  • Proven ability to exceed expectations.
  • Appropriate state insurance licenses and continuing education required.
  • Works effectively and relates well with others including superiors, colleagues, and individuals inside and outside the company in a professional manner.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively.
  • High level of organizational ability with attention to detail.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Salary Range is $47,500 - $52,500.The specific salary offered may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate's relevant experience, education, and work location.

Benefits: Comprehensive package including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with match, Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), thirteen paid holidays, company-paid life insurance for you and your dependents, employee assistance fund and programs, wellness perks, and more!

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description_html:
Talent Acquisition Partner

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We’re improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us!

At Siemens, we’re driven by the desire to shape what’s next—creating smarter, more sustainable, and more connected solutions that transform industries and improve lives. We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner to join our exceptional team in supporting Smart Infrastructure – Buildings.

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner, and this position will be remote within the US.

As a Talent Acquisition Partner, you’ll be a trusted partner in fueling Siemens’ success through great hires. You’ll collaborate closely with business leaders, hiring managers, and People & Organization (P&O) partners to design and execute effective recruitment strategies while managing the full hiring lifecycle.

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Build strong partnerships with Business Unit leaders, hiring managers, and P&O partners to understand business objectives and talent needs.
  • Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for Siemens Smart Infrastructure Buildings, including requisition initiation, sourcing strategy, candidate selection, offers, and pre-boarding.
  • Facilitate Recruitment Strategy Calls with hiring teams to align target profiles, goals, and hiring expectations.
  • Leverage creative and data-driven sourcing strategies—networking, social media, employee referrals, events, and recruitment marketing—to engage top talent.
  • Conduct thorough screenings and interviews to assess candidates’ technical skills, experience, and cultural fit.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates, ensuring an outstanding experience throughout the hiring journey.
  • Coach hiring teams on best practices to promote transparency, timely feedback, and a strong candidate experience.
  • Ensure full compliance with Siemens’ recruitment policies, processes, and all relevant employment regulations.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of recruiting experience in a corporate environment, with a focus on skilled trades, engineering, manufacturing, and/or high-volume hiring.
  • 4+ years of experience leveraging Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and other recruiting technologies to streamline hiring processes.
  • 2+ years of experience recruiting within Siemens’ Building Automation, Fire/Life Safety, and Security Systems business units.
  • Authorized to work in the United States without the need for company sponsorship now or in the future.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Proven experience recruiting for manufacturing or skilled trade roles, with an understanding of workforce dynamics in production environments.
  • Familiarity with Avature (ATS/CRM) and digital interviewing platforms is a strong plus.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and rapport across all levels of the organization.
  • Demonstrated success in sourcing, attracting, and hiring diverse, high-quality talent across a range of functions.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to balance multiple searches and competing priorities effectively.
  • A proactive, adaptable, and collaborative mindset, thriving in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

You’ll benefit from:

  • Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
  • The pay range for this position is $91,463-$156,794 and the annual incentive target is 10% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications and premium geographic location.

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

jobs.title: US Head of Vertical Market – Life Sciences
jobs.description_html:
At Siemens, we empower our customers by combining the real and digital worlds to improve how we live, work, and move today and for future generations. Our people are at the center of everything we do, driving innovation, collaboration, and sustainable growth.

We are looking for a US Head of Vertical Market – Life Sciences.

The One Tech Company transformation is creating new opportunities for Siemens to bring together innovative technologies, deep industry expertise, and cross-business collaboration to serve customers in more meaningful ways. The US Head of Vertical Market – Life Sciences will help lead this effort across one of Siemens' most important strategic markets. This role will serve as a key connector across businesses, stakeholders, and customers, helping to align market strategies, unlock growth opportunities, and strengthen Siemens' position throughout the Life Sciences ecosystem.

You'll Make an Impact By

  • Leading Siemens USA’s growth strategy and business plan for the assigned Vertical, aligning global Vertical priorities with US market trends, customer needs, competitive insights, and the One Tech Company ambition.
  • Serving as the US representative for the global Vertical and as the primary local coordination point for Siemens US leadership, the global Vertical organization, Siemens businesses, customers, partners, and other internal and external stakeholders.
  • Operating as an integrated member of the global Vertical organization, with a solid-line reporting relationship within Siemens US and a strong dotted-line relationship into the global Vertical organization.
  • Leading strategic opportunity capture and pursuits by mobilizing Siemens businesses, orchestrating cross-business resources and executive sponsorship, and creating a coordinated One Tech Company experience for customers.
  • Building and leading the US Vertical community across businesses, functions, sales teams, regions, and channels to align priorities, strengthen collaboration, and accelerate growth.
  • Developing and executing the US Vertical business plan, including market priorities, target segments, focus accounts, strategic opportunities, ecosystem partnerships, and growth initiatives.
  • Determining the localization of global Vertical strategy, including US go-to-market approaches, account focus, sales motions, channel and partner strategies, and coordinated marketing execution.
  • Building trusted executive customer and ecosystem relationships, representing Siemens in the market, and expanding Siemens’ influence through industry engagement, advocacy, and thought leadership.
  • Acting as the voice of the US customer, market, and industry by translating insights into enterprise action, portfolio priorities, solution development, investment choices, enablement needs, and business results.
  • Leveraging global Vertical leadership, market development, architecture, subject matter experts, and other supporting capabilities to accelerate local strategy, opportunity development, solution design, and execution.
  • Identifying cross-business synergies, portfolio and capability needs, solution gaps, resource requirements, and investment priorities, and aligning the appropriate Siemens businesses and functions to address them.
  • Ensuring relevant Siemens capabilities—including sales enablement, marketing, financing, consulting, architecture, and other supporting functions—are engaged in the right opportunities and implemented effectively.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of Life Sciences industry experience and knowledge, including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices, and healthcare, with an understanding of industry customers, market dynamics, supply chain complexities, regulatory requirements, and digital transformation trends.
  • Deep understanding of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and CDMO manufacturing environments and the business, operational, quality, and technology priorities shaping these markets.
  • Knowledge of FDA, EMA, and other global Life Sciences regulatory frameworks, including GxP requirements such as GMP, GCP, and GLP, as well as GAMP 5 principles.
  • Experience with Life Sciences digital transformation initiatives and technologies, including MES, Electronic Batch Records (EBR), PLM, laboratory informatics, quality management systems, industrial data management, AI, digital thread, and digital twin technologies.
  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university.
  • Ability to travel approximately 30–40%.
  • Must be eligible to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding Siemens’ portfolio, with the ability to identify and apply relevant solutions across Digital Industries, Smart Infrastructure, Mobility, Software, Financial Services, and consulting offerings to address Life Sciences customer needs.
  • Proven ability to drive strategic business development in highly regulated environments, including identifying growth opportunities, developing account strategies, and navigating complex sales cycles and customer pursuits.
  • Ability to translate Siemens technologies and digitalization capabilities into meaningful customer outcomes, such as accelerating drug development and technology transfer, improving manufacturing efficiency and quality, increasing asset availability, strengthening regulatory compliance, and reducing operational risk.
  • Ability to engage credibly with customers on Life Sciences reference architectures, digital manufacturing strategies, and technology roadmaps.
  • Strong customer-facing and executive credibility with senior leaders across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and CDMO organizations.
  • Demonstrated understanding of the broader Life Sciences ecosystem, including technology partners, OEMs and machine builders, engineering and system integration partners, and industry organizations such as ISPE.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and influence, with the ability to align diverse internal businesses and teams while engaging effectively with customers, regulators, technology partners, and industry leaders.
  • Strategic and commercial acumen, with the ability to anticipate industry and regulatory shifts, translate market needs into growth priorities and business plans, and connect Siemens’ broader portfolio to customer challenges across the Life Sciences value chain.
  • Innovation and digital transformation mindset, with an understanding of emerging technologies and their potential to accelerate drug discovery and development, optimize manufacturing, improve quality and productivity, and drive better outcomes across the Life Sciences value chain.

Scope, Impact & Accountability

As the Head of Vertical Market Strategy, you will be responsible for shaping and executing Siemens' U.S. growth strategy within your assigned market vertical. You will serve as the connective leader across Siemens’ businesses, bringing together teams, solutions, and expertise to help customers solve their most critical challenges.

In this highly visible role, you will translate global strategy into market-specific growth plans, identify and pursue strategic opportunities, and help drive go-to-market priorities across the U.S. market. You will serve as the voice of the U.S. customer within Siemens' global vertical organization, helping influence future portfolio development, ecosystem partnerships, and investment priorities based on evolving market needs.

Success in this position requires the ability to build alignment across a complex organization, inspire collaboration among diverse stakeholders, and orchestrate high-value opportunities that accelerate growth. Working closely with business leaders, sales teams, and subject matter experts around the world, you will play a pivotal role in strengthening Siemens' market position and expanding our impact within the industry.

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.


You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $171,000 - $293,000 annually with a target incentive of 25% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

 Building and leading the US Vertical community across businesses, functions, sales teams, regions, and channels to align priorities, strengthen collaboration, and accelerate growth.
 Developing and executing the US Vertical business plan, including market priorities, target segments, focus accounts, strategic opportunities, ecosystem partnerships, and growth initiatives.
 Determining the localization of global Vertical strategy, including US go-to-market approaches, account focus, sales motions, channel and partner strategies, and coordinated marketing execution.
 Building trusted executive customer and ecosystem relationships, representing Siemens in the market, and expanding Siemens’ influence through industry engagement, advocacy, and thought leadership.
 Acting as the voice of the US customer, market, and industry by translating insights into enterprise action, portfolio priorities, solution development, investment choices, enablement needs, and business results.
 Leveraging global Vertical leadership, market development, architecture, subject matter experts, and other supporting capabilities to accelerate local strategy, opportunity development, solution design, and execution.
 Identifying cross-business synergies, portfolio and capability needs, solution gaps, resource requirements, and investment priorities, and aligning the appropriate Siemens businesses and functions to address them.
 Ensuring relevant Siemens capabilities—including sales enablement, marketing, financing, consulting, architecture, and other supporting functions—are engaged in the right opportunities and implemented effectively.
 Required Qualifications 
 10+ years of semiconductor industry knowledge, including equipment manufacturers, fabs, foundries, integrated device manufacturers (IDMs), supply chain participants, customers, and market growth trends.
 Executive-level credibility across semiconductor design, manufacturing, operations, facilities, and infrastructure.
 Strong understanding of semiconductor design and manufacturing processes, including ramp-up, yield, quality, productivity, and operational performance drivers.
 Knowledge of semiconductor industry standards, quality frameworks, regulatory requirements, and government incentive programs, including SEMI standards.
 Bachelor's degree from accredited university
 Ability to travel 30-40% of the time.
 Must be eligible to work in the US without visa sponsorship.
 Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of Siemens' EDA, PLM, Simulation, MoM, equipment engineering, FMCS, and Totally Integrated Power portfolios and their application within the semiconductor industry.
 Strong commercial acumen across direct sales, partners and channels, account strategy, and complex customer pursuits.
 Ability to translate semiconductor market and customer needs into growth priorities, business plans, portfolio strategies, and account strategies.
 Ability to translate Siemens technologies, including digital threads, digital twins, and AI, into measurable customer outcomes such as faster time to market, improved yield, higher asset availability, increased productivity, and reduced operational risk.
 Ability to advise customers on semiconductor reference architectures, digitalization strategies, and technology roadmaps.
 Strong communication and executive presence, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders across businesses and functions without direct authority.
 Strategic business acumen with the ability to anticipate industry shifts, identify growth opportunities, shape market and account strategies, and drive profitable growth.

jobs.title: Business and Financial Professional
jobs.description_html:
Business and Financial Professional


Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us!

Join our Smart Infrastructure (SI) team as our Business and Financial Professional

to help us to successfully manage all financial aspects across our network of factories. The successful candidate will report to the Electrical Products Finance Operations Manager of Governance and Performance Controller, partner closely with the Head of Finance, North America Operations, Fin. Director of Operations, Systems, EP NA Factories, the Segment Fin teams and other functions while owning and improving financial aspects of accuracy of books and records, planning and controlling, measuring the achievement of KPIs and driving improvement projects

We are looking for Business and Financial Professional. This position will be based preferably at Peachtree Corners, GA or at one of our US Plant locations, Remote work would also be considered.

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Lead performance controlling, governance, and financial oversight for key operational and corporate initiatives, including but not limited to:
    • EP NA OFLDP Program Lead
    • Expansion Controlling, Reporting, Transparency and Commentary
    • Standard and Ad hoc Analytics
    • Partner to EP NA FIN OPS Leadership on driving Strategic initiatives
    • EP NA FIN OPS Special Projects
    • Knowledge sharing with OPS Technical teams
    • Additional strategic initiatives as assigned
  • Partner proactively with factory leadership, operations teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate business performance, identify risks and opportunities, and drive corrective actions.
  • Develop and deliver management presentations, business reviews, and decision proposals that support executive decision-making.
  • Independently analyze complex business, organizational, process, and system-related topics, translating findings into actionable recommendations and measurable improvement initiatives.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for assigned areas of responsibility, providing guidance, governance, and best practices across the organization.
  • Drive the continuous enhancement of reporting, analytics, and business intelligence tools to improve transparency, standardization, and productivity.
  • Perform regular and ad hoc analysis of business performance against targets, proactively identifying trends, risks, anomalies, and improvement opportunities.
  • Facilitate constructive performance discussions with factories and key stakeholders to ensure accountability and achievement of business objectives.
  • Provide qualified backup support across the EP NA Finance Operations Governance and Performance Controlling organization, ensuring continuity of critical processes and deliverables.
  • Support special projects, strategic initiatives, and other business requirements as needed.

Key Competencies

  • Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
  • Performance Management
  • Business Partnering
  • Executive Communication
  • Governance & Compliance
  • Process Improvement
  • Data Analytics & Reporting
  • Project Leadership
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Strategic Thinking

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:  

Basic Qualifications:

  • BS in Accounting, Finance.
  • 8-10 years’ experience in Finance, preferably in a manufacturing plant environment
  • Very strong in depth knowledge of SAP (FI/CO) and digitalization- / automation tools (Tableau, Snowflake, etc.)
  • Strong Networking-, Collaboration- and Stakeholder Management skills
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Project Management Skills and Experience / Change Management experience
  • Solution oriented thinking and ability to practically apply methodic approaches to overcome business challenges
  • Ability to effectively manage deadlines, prioritize and multi-task in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience and in-depth know how of large and complex manufacturing environments
  • Comprehensive SCM- and manufacturing process understanding (beyond finance)

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us. 

Protecting the environment, conserving our natural resources, fostering the health and performance of our people as well as safeguarding their working conditions are core to our social and business commitment at Siemens. They are an integral part of our Business Conduct Guidelines and our corporate strategy.

The pay range for this position is $91,463 - $156,794 annually with a target incentive of 10% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Client Service Manager – Building Automation
jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role supports our Tampa, FL branch location, which serves customers throughout the greater Tampa, FL area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?  

 

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.  

Transform the everyday with us!


Our Client Service Managers manage a portfolio of service agreements (through delivery) and are responsible for profit and loss of these agreements. As a Client Service Manager, ensuring the financial performance of our service agreements and customer satisfaction are critical to our success. You’ll be working directly with the customer to develop trusted-advisor relationships and recommend services and solutions. 


As a Client Service Manager, you will:  

  • Manage assigned service agreement accounts, driving to a financial target and outstanding customer satisfaction and retention
  • Balance time between on-site customer interactions and back-office responsibilities
  • Develop account strategies to achieve the customer’s business goals, leveraging the company’s entire service and product portfolio
  • Develop service delivery plans with the customer to provide service agreement scope of work
  • Identify customer needs and make prioritized recommendations for service agreement adds, upgrades, and escalations
  • Participate in the development of a master schedule to deliver service for all customers in the service area and lead quality assurance activities that will support service agreement renewals
  • Maintain excellent organizational and interpersonal skills


You will make an impact with these qualifications:  

Basic Qualifications:  

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED
  • 3+ years of on-the-job experience working within:
  • The Building Technology industry
  • Engineering HVAC or Building Automation systems
  • Experience using Microsoft Office and business software systems
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience in demand-side energy services or Certified Energy Manager 
  • Associate degree from a two-year/technical college or bachelor's degree
  • 5+ years of experience in the building technology industry

jobs.title: Head of Performance Insights (f/m/d)
jobs.description_html:
Location: Any Siemens location in the world

Welcome to Foundational Sales – a new global organisation at the Siemens level. Our mission is to build ONE Sales Fabric: a consistent, scalable, and data-driven go-to-market foundation that empowers our Sales Units to win in their Verticals and markets – and that makes it easier for our customers to do business with Siemens. Our work spans six focus areas – Process & Data Domain, Sales Enablement & Activation, Digital Sales Channel, Vertical Governance & Operations, Demand Acceleration, and Partner Sales. Together, we create the shared standards, systems, and AI-enabled capabilities behind one coordinated face to the customer. Do you want to help redefine how a global tech company sells in the AI era? Then join us – and through radical collaboration and the "Together, unless" principle, help unlock the power of ONE.

Digital Sales Channel enables scalable, profitable growth by designing and operating Siemens' digital sales ecosystem – owning the end-to-end digital customer lifecycle, the core digital business platform, and the digital go-to-market that amplifies direct and partner sales.

Within Digital Sales Channel, the Strategy & Governance Team defines the strategic direction, investment priorities and operating model to drive digital growth across the business. By combining strategy, governance, and data-driven performance insights, we help transform ambitious ideas into measurable commercial impact.

The Performance Insights team defines the value realisation and performance measurement framework for Digital Sales, ensuring end-to-end visibility of data and generating actionable insights that enable stakeholders to continuously optimise the customer journey, platform performance, customer adoption and commercial success.

At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

How you will make an impact with us as Head of Performance Insights (f/m/d)

Leadership

  • Shape the direction for Performance Insights within DSC Strategy & Governance – defining how digital sales performance is measured, interpreted, and used to steer platform investment and GTM decisions across Siemens
  • Build Performance Insights as a credible analytics function within DSC — establishing ways of working and key interfaces across DSC, FS and senior sales leadership
  • Lead and develop a diverse team – nurturing talent, fostering collaboration, and shaping a working culture that turns ambition into outcomes

Data Analytics & Reporting Excellence

  • Own the Digital Sales performance management framework – defining standardised KPIs, measurement methodologies, and scalable reporting capabilities across the channel and platform ecosystem
  • Lead the application of advanced analytics and data science capabilities, including predictive modelling, customer segmentation, funnel analytics, and churn prediction, to identify growth opportunities and performance risks
  • Define and govern executive reporting and performance dashboards for various internal stakeholders, including senior leadership, business units, and GTM teams
  • Present key findings, trends, and recommendations in a clear, concise, and compelling manner to influence strategic decisions and act as the primary subject matter expert for all Digital Sales performance-related inquiries

Insight to Action

  • Translate performance data into clear findings and recommendations that inform platform investment decisions and GTM priorities across DSC Strategy & Governance
  • Partner with FS PDD on available data products and dashboards as the baseline for DSC-specific performance management – identifying gaps and driving requirements for improved data coverage
  • Connect performance signals to commercial outcomes – linking channel metrics, monetisation trends, and conversion data to support the investment prioritisation work of Platform Strategy & Business Planning

What you bring

Education & Skills

  • Extensive background in performance management, business intelligence, or digital analytics – with demonstrated experience building and leading analytics teams in complex, multi-stakeholder environments
  • Proven experience in Digital Sales, e-commerce, digital platforms or omnichannel commercial environments with a strong understanding of digital customer journeys and omnichannel strategies – preferably in a B2B technology and industrial environment
  • Hands-on experience with leading business intelligence and data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Qlik Sense) and cloud-based analytics platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Strong analytical and technical capabilities in SQL, Python, or R or comparable analytical tools for data modelling, statistical analysis and insights generation

Ways of working

  • Experience leading a team and developing talent with an inclusive leadership style
  • Strong collaboration mindset across departments and organisational boundaries
  • Thrives in a mixed greenfield and brownfield environment, shaping a new team while harmonising and modernising what already exists – comfortable with ambiguity, evolving scope, and decisions made in motion
  • University degree in a relevant discipline; advanced degree is a plus
  • Familiarity with technology company operating models is a benefit, not a requirement

Languages

  • High proficiency in written and spoken English; additional languages are a plus

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce

At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us

To solve the biggest challenges of our time, we need bright minds with the ambition to make the impossible possible. Siemens is the place where you can thrive, challenge the status quo, make an impact, and grow alongside a team of innovators who share your passion for technology. Are you in?

www.siemens.com/careers – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.

FAQ – if you need further information on the application process.

jobs.title: AI Factory HPC Infrastructure Deployment Architect
jobs.description_html:
AI Factory HPC Infrastructure Deployment Architect

 

Position Overview 

 

The AI Factory HPC Infrastructure Deployment Architect will serve as a global technical authority for compute, networking, storage, memory, and IT infrastructure architecture within Siemens' AI Factory organization. The role will track how AI, hyperscale, cloud, HPC, and enterprise platforms are evolving and convert those changes into actionable AI Factory reference architectures and go-to-market guidance. The successful candidate will bring practical experience building or architecting large-scale compute, network, and storage environments and enough data-center fluency to translate upstream IT decisions into clear implications for power, cooling, controls, physical topology, resiliency, and deployment strategy. A critical responsibility is to partner with electrical, thermal/liquid cooling, controls & automation, digital thread, and regional Solutions Architects, rack density, cluster topology, network fabrics, storage architecture, and workload behavior are accurately reflected in the complete AI Factory architecture. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Serve as the technical authority for AI, HPC, cloud, and enterprise infrastructure architectures. 
  • Evaluate emerging processor, accelerator, networking, memory, and storage technologies and assess their impact on AI Factory designs. 
  • Develop scalable reference architectures spanning compute, storage, networking, racks, clusters, and data hall environments. 
  • Translate IT infrastructure requirements into actionable inputs for electrical, cooling, controls, and facility design teams. 
  • Partner with customers, hyperscalers, enterprises, and technology partners on infrastructure strategy and architecture planning. 
  • Develop technical guidance, architecture frameworks, and thought leadership content supporting sales and go-to-market initiatives. 
 

Basic Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline; Master’s preferred. 
  • 10+ years of experience in compute infrastructure, networking, storage, cloud, HPC, enterprise systems, or hyperscale environments. 
  • 5+ years in architecture, principal engineering, technical leadership, or equivalent roles. 
  • Proven experience designing or architecting large-scale infrastructure environments. 
  • Experience with AI infrastructure, accelerated computing, HPC, hyperscale, or high-density data centers. 
  • Strong customer-facing communication and stakeholder management skills. 
  • Ability to travel up to 30-50%. 
 

Technical Expertise 

  • Large-scale compute, AI, HPC, cloud, or hyperscale infrastructure environments. 
  • Server, CPU, GPU, and accelerator architectures. 
  • AI training and inference platforms. 
  • Data center networking including Ethernet, InfiniBand, RoCE, and AI fabrics. 
  • Enterprise and high-performance storage architectures. 
  • Linux, virtualization, containers, and distributed systems. 
  • Rack-level infrastructure, power, cooling, and high-density deployments. 
  • Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and translate them into scalable architecture strategies. 
 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep expertise in compute, HPC, networking, AI infrastructure, hyperscale systems, or a related domain. 
  • Broad knowledge across compute, networking, storage, and data center infrastructure. 
  • Strong systems thinking with the ability to translate technology trends into business and architectural value. 
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive alignment across technical and business stakeholders. 
  • Executive presence with strong communication and presentation skills. 
  • Ability to simplify complex technologies into actionable architectural decisions. 
  • Innovation mindset with a passion for learning emerging technologies and industry trends. 
 

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.

 

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

   

You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $137,000.00 - $222,000.00 annually with a target incentive of 10 of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Building Automation Service Specialist
jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role supports our Tallahassee, FL branch location, which serves customers throughout the greater Tallahassee, FL area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?  

 

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.  

Transform the everyday with us!


Our Service Specialists perform assigned tasks on building automation systems. Tasks include service agreement maintenance, projects, and on-call (time and material) service. Responds to emergency service calls as directed during regularly scheduled hours and after hours as needed. Our ServiceSpecialists are the face of Siemens, and your expertise and regular interaction with the customer will help them save energy and money, as well as create a more sustainable future for our environment.   

  

As a Service Specialist, you will:  

  • Execute digitalization and standard service operations strategies
  • Work with multiple internal service team members including Service Sales, Client Service Managers, Service Coordinators, and RAM Digital Service Center personnel
  • Follow safety requirements as outlined by Siemens and customers and successfully completes assigned training as outlined in the training path
  • Follow mandatory policies, procedures, and standards, may coordinate with contractors on job sites, maintains tools and test equipment
  • Support after hours during on-call rotation, responds to service calls (emergency and on-site) as assigned. Performs repairs as directed on all automation system types 
  • Be responsible for completing service ticket documentation per the policy, follow and maintain preventive maintenance schedules
  • Maintain complete and accurate documentation of services performed and generates reports within Siemens tools
  • Provide instructions to customer personnel regarding proper system operations and assists with training
  • Identify and reports system discrepancies, suggests system upgrade opportunities, and may assist in pricing of repairs and upgrades to existing agreement and performs system checkout and startup on projects
  • Work overtime when needed (Compressed schedule performance can be a factor and will require extended hours to meet commitments)
  • Work rotational on-call and/or minimal overnight travel
  • Participate in job site final walk and/or final completion for systems-to-service turnover on assigned jobs performs other duties as assigned


You will make an impact with these qualifications:  

Basic Qualifications:  

  • 1+ years of experience servicing electronic control or HVAC equipment 
  • Electro-mechanical experience (either in a previous role or through education) and user PC/software skill
  • Ability and willingness to work in a variety of circumstances, including climbing ladders, scaffolds, and high lift equipment, working in ducts, crawl spaces, roofs, basements, above ceilings, and in various conditions
  • Must be able and willing to use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet as well as carrying and moving equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
  • Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) 
  • Ability and willingness to work overtime and be on call on a standard rotation 
  • Must be 18 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED 
  • Specialized skill training/certification 
  • 1+ years of experience installing and servicing electronic control or HVAC equipment
  • Knowledge of building automation systems, PLCs, HVAC, electrical concepts, and building operations 
  • Engineering and programming (PLC or BMS) background 
  • Knowledge of building system communication protocols (BACnet, Modbus, TCP/IP)

The Project Manager facilitates the execution of project/program solution plan for clearly defined sub-projects or sub-programs. This role requires the coordination and delivery of multiple, simultaneous projects considered small to medium in complexity with financial impact between $100K and $2.5M.

As a Project Manager, you will: 

  • Have fiscal responsibility for all project facets, including project billing, job cost reporting, and overall customer satisfaction. 
  • Be responsible for delivery of results for the respective process steps.
  • Guide technical or administrative staff.
  • Act as a functional process resource on projects or programs
  • Contribute to continuous improvement plan.
  • Perform active role in maintaining functionally focused client relationships.
  • Be responsible for several small projects.
  • Review project specifications, drawings and project-specific documents to establish project intent.
  • Develop and maintain a project schedule and coordinate needs with the project team. Identify time-sensitive installation needs.
  • Manage the requisition of supplies and materials to complete projects. 
  • Review plans and specifications and participate in project cost reviews.
  • Assist Operations Manager in the solicitation and contracting of subcontractors.
  • Conduct an orientation for project technicians and provide project documentation, including scope of work, drawings, applicable specifications, application-engineered drawings, project contacts, etc. 
  • Track resources and projects progress. 
  • Document project events that impact the schedule, scope of work, and project efficiency.
  • Pursue project-specific change-order opportunities. 
  • Coordinate and pursue project-specific billing; coordinate with Accounting team and Operations Manager. 
  • Schedule project-specific commissioning resources and provides commissioning documentation. 
  • Expedite the return of project-specific mark-ups for as-built development. 
  • Complete project-specific close-out documentation.
  • Effectively manage and coordinate subcontractors to meet scope, scheduling, and financial requirements.
  • Adhere to local, corporate, and OSHA safety policies and procedures; report unsafe conditions and actions.


You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Associate degree
  • Ability to work in a team environment providing dedicated support to our customers
  • Verbal and written communication skills in English
  • 1+ years of experience managing projects or related
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Mechanical or Electrical Engineering degree 
  • 1-3+ years of technical experience in the HVAC controls industry
  • Experience with Microsoft Office and Microsoft Project 
  • Knowledge and understanding of HVAC industry applications; ability to read and understand MEP drawings and specifications, and/or construction, electrical, network, and control wiring diagrams
  • Knowledge of industry-standard communication protocols such as Ethernet, Modbus, and BACnet

jobs.title: Financial Analyst- Controlling
jobs.description_html:
Financial Analyst -Controlling Professional

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us!

At Siemens Grid Software, we accelerate and secure a successful Energy Transition

Today the energy world is changing to become carbon neutral. Distributed Energy Resources are growing rapidly and decentralized power generation is transforming how energy systems operate. Utility companies are rethinking their IT/OT landscapes and require agile, data-driven solutions to operate efficiently and securely.

At Siemens Grid Software, we are at the forefront of this transformation, enabling our customers through advanced digital solutions, analytics, and software platforms.

Find out more about the Digital world of Siemens Grid Software here:

https://new.siemens.com/global/en/products/energy/topics/smart-grid.html


Our Culture

At Siemens Grid Software, we foster an ownership culture where employees take responsibility, collaborate openly, and continuously improve. We value innovation, transparency, and data-driven decision-making. Our teams operate globally and work closely across functions to drive meaningful business outcomes.

We have major locations in Minneapolis, MN; Foster City, CA; Schenectady, NY; Houston, TX; and Wendell, NC. 


Who are we seeking?

We are looking for a Financial Analyst – Controlling with a solid foundation in finance and a genuine interest in data, analytics, and automation. You will join the Grid Software Services Americas finance team, reporting to the Head of Finance, supporting the full portfolio with a focus on Power Technologies International (PTI), our power systems consulting and engineering business.

You are a hands-on contributor who keeps the day-to-day running accurately and on time – and who looks at every manual, repetitive step and asks “how do we standardize this, and can we automate it?” You will have the support and room to make that happen, turning routine work into reliable, repeatable processes and freeing up time for analysis that helps the business make decisions.


We are looking for Financial Analyst. This position follows a remote work model, allowing employees to work primarily from a home office while supporting business needs as required.


You’ll make an impact by:

PTI Finance Operations

  • Business partnering: Support the finance partner for PTI leadership, project managers, and sales, providing analysis of revenue, margin, costs, and backlog for a consulting business that runs on people, hours, and projects.
  • Project financials: Support PTI project and order setup, review time and billing data, and maintain accurate project revenue recognition (Percentage of Completion) in SAP.
  • Utilization & capacity: Prepare utilization, capacity, and headcount reporting that feeds the monthly business review and helps leadership balance workload against demand.
  • Operational accuracy: Handle a steady volume of transactional and data-entry work with care, and document each recurring process so knowledge is shared across the team rather than held by one person.
Financial Steering & FP&A
  • Closing & Reporting: Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end activities. Lead margin analysis and backlog reporting to ensure a clear picture of business health.
  • Variance Analysis: Prepare monthly commentary that tells the story behind the numbers, explaining variances between actual results and forecasts with clarity and insight.
  • Planning & forecasting: Contribute to budget, forecast, and recurring headquarters requests for the PTI business.
  • Business analysis: Perform targeted data analysis to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

Commercial Operations (Order-to-Cash)

  • O2C Management: Own and improve the end-to-end Order-to-Cash process, including customer setup, order intake, invoicing, and cash receipt.
  • Issue resolution: Spot and help resolve bottlenecks in billing and collections to improve cash flow and customer satisfaction.

Standardization & Automation

  • Standardize: Turn recurring processes into consistent templates, checklists, and controls that others on the team can run.
  • Automate: Identify manual steps and reduce them over time using tools such as Power Query, Power Automate, and KNIME – progressively shifting your own time from data entry to analysis.
  • Partner on reporting: Work alongside the team’s Financial Data Architect, who owns the data models and Power BI platform; you bring the process expertise and are a key user and tester of the reporting tools.
You will impress us by having the following:

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance or Accounting.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in finance and/or accounting roles, ideally within a multinational, software, or professional-services organization.
  • Solid understanding of IFRS 15 / US GAAP ASC 606 (Percentage of Completion, Cost-to-Cost Method), specifically within a project environment.
  • Proficiency with SAP FI and CO modules.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query and relational data modeling – well beyond VLOOKUPs.
  • A strong desire to learn and apply tools like Power BI, Power Automate, and KNIME to improve how finance works.
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States without Visa sponsorship
Preferred Qualifications
  • MBA or professional certification (CPA/CMA).
  • Experience in a consulting or professional-services environment (utilization, time-and-materials and fixed-price project billing).
  • Exposure to SQL or Python.
  • Ability to manage tight deadlines and high-volume work while keeping an uncompromising eye for detail and a collaborative spirit.

Why this role is unique

  • The PTI Edge: You will support Power Technologies International (PTI), the "brains" of the energy transition, gaining exposure to high-level consulting and technical software financials.
  • Developmental Launchpad: This position is explicitly designed as a developmental track. We aren't just hiring for today; we are looking for a future finance leader within the Siemens ecosystem.
  • Digitalization Playground: You will have the autonomy to identify automation opportunities and build the tools that will modernize our regional reporting.

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.


You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $74,970 - $128,520 annually. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Industry Marketing Manager – Semiconductors US
jobs.description_html:
About Siemens Digital Industry Software 

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer-aided design, 3D modeling, and simulation—helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large enterprise and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world-class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, ensuring our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Position Summary 

The Industry Marketing Manager for Semiconductors turns industry strategy, customer insight, and Siemens’ portfolio strengths into focused go-to-market (GTM) priorities, differentiated messaging, executable campaign direction, and high-impact sales enablement materials. Serving as the marketing subject-matter expert for the semiconductor industry, you will connect market opportunities, customer needs, industry priorities, solution capabilities, and business objectives to create actionable strategies that accelerate awareness, engagement, pipeline creation, and revenue growth. Operating as a key integrator across industry leadership, product marketing, sales, technical experts, and implementation teams, success in this role requires both strategic industry leadership and the ability to navigate a complex, matrixed organization while maintaining a razor-sharp focus on customer relevance and business impact. 

Key Responsibilities

  • GTM Ownership & Evolution: Own and continuously evolve the semiconductor go-to-market intent, translating high-level strategy into clear target segments, buying groups, personas, Digital Thread and Solution Domain priorities, and campaign plans.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the industry marketing lead within cross-functional implementation. Bring customer and market relevance to delivery teams, clarify business rationale, surface dependencies and risks, and drive decisions to keep initiatives moving forward.
  • Audience & Persona Strategy: Lead buyer-audience definitions and validate persona-to-topic mapping to reflect how semiconductor companies organize, buy, and transform.
  • Messaging & Value Proposition: Develop and maintain industry messaging frameworks and briefs that connect customer challenges to differentiated Siemens value. Translate highly technical input into credible, outcome-led narratives for executive, technical, and operational audiences.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with industry leaders, solution managers, Digital Thread Factory leads, solution/core marketers, technical experts, and sales to align solution definition, audience strategy, and messaging.
  • Campaign & Content Direction: Lead integrated campaign definitions from strategy through handoff, providing complete inputs for campaign overviews, prioritized topics, audiences, imperatives, messaging, and content requirements while supporting content creators with clear strategic direction.
  • Sales Enablement: Own the creation and delivery of enablement and go-to-market materials that sellers use because they map directly to real customer priorities. Customer Insight & Market Intelligence: Build a continuous feedback loop through customer conversations, sales interactions, customer advocacy, events, market research, and performance data to validate assumptions and guide investment.
  • Customer Insight & Market Intelligence: Build a continuous feedback loop through customer conversations, sales interactions, customer advocacy, events, market research, and performance data to validate assumptions and guide investment.
  • Industry Fluency: Monitor fast-moving semiconductor market and technology developments, including AI and custom silicon, EDA, software-defined development, advanced packaging, silicon photonics, fab/sub-fab digitalization, manufacturing optimization, sustainability, and supply-chain resilience.
  • Governance & Execution: Resolve ambiguity, escalate gaps in ownership or portfolio readiness with clear business implications, and rigorously document decisions, trade-offs, and next steps.
  • Evangelism: Represent the semiconductor industry in internal planning, executive reviews, customer engagements, and key industry forums.
What Success Looks Like
  • Delivery of customer-relevant messaging with the deep technical credibility required by semiconductor audiences.
  • Tight, measurable alignment across industry, solution, campaign, sales, and technical stakeholders. A focused, evidence-based semiconductor campaign strategy that teams can easily understand and execute.
  • High adoption of campaigns and enablement assets by sales teams due to their direct connection to real-world buyer challenges.
  • A trusted, up-to-date industry point of view that adapts to market shifts and sharpens prioritization over time.
Required Skills & Capabilities
  • Industry Expertise: Deep understanding of the semiconductor industry, its ecosystem, value chain, business models, buying dynamics, and technology trends.
  • Technical Agility: Ability to quickly grasp complex technical concepts and distinguish enduring customer needs from short-lived market hype.
  • GTM Strategy: Strong command of go-to-market strategy, segmentation, audience definition, positioning, messaging, and B2B campaign planning.
  • Executive Storytelling: Exceptional strategic writing and storytelling skills; ability to make complex engineering and software topics clear, differentiated, and relevant across all levels of a customer organization. Data-Driven & Inquiring Mindset: Demonstrated customer mindset and research discipline; skilled at combining qualitative insights, market intelligence, competitive context, and performance data to challenge assumptions and guide decisions.
  • Data-Driven & Inquiring Mindset: Demonstrated customer mindset and research discipline; skilled at combining qualitative insights, market intelligence, competitive context, and performance data to challenge assumptions and guide decisions.
  • Influence Without Authority: Proven ability to lead through a global matrixed organization, aligning senior leaders, technical specialists, marketers, sales teams, and external agencies.
  • Project Leadership: Strong leadership and project management skills, including prioritization, decision framing, dependency management, issue escalation, workshop facilitation, and on-time delivery.
  • Business & Sales Acumen: Ability to connect marketing choices directly to growth priorities, pipeline requirements, adoption barriers, and seller readiness.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable thriving in environments characterized by ambiguity and constant change.
  • Communication: Executive-ready verbal communication and presentation skills, coupled with excellent written English.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Engineering, or a related field (advanced degree or equivalent relevant experience preferred).
  • 10+ years of experience in B2B marketing, go-to-market strategy, product marketing, or industry marketing, preferably within the semiconductor, EDA, or industrial software environments.
  • Demonstrated track record of developing audience strategies, messaging frameworks, campaign briefs, thought leadership, sales enablement, and executive presentations.
  • Extensive experience collaborating with global, cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders in complex, matrixed corporate structures.
Preferred Experience
  • Experience spanning multiple segments of the semiconductor value chain, or successfully bridging EDA, systems engineering, simulation, lifecycle management, and manufacturing narratives.
  • Hands-on experience supporting both overarching GTM strategy and integrated tactical campaigns.
  • An established professional network within the semiconductor ecosystem, with strong familiarity with major industry events, associations, and the media landscape.

Why Join Us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility—choosing between working from home and collaborating in the office is a standard part of our culture. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and the robust rewards package you would expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time across more than 200 countries. We are dedicated to equality and welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities where we live and work. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity, creativity, and drive, and help us shape tomorrow. 

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday.
