jobs.title: Senior Storage Administrator - US Remote
jobs.description_html:
About Siemens Digital Industries Software
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a global leader in industrial software, empowering companies worldwide to drive innovation and digital transformation through our comprehensive portfolio of products and solutions. Our cutting-edge technology helps create precise digital twins, enabling customers to master the complexity of smart products and processes.


Join our dynamic Global Storage Team, a strategic pillar supporting Siemens Digital Industries Software's engineers and corporate staff across numerous R&D centers and offices worldwide. 


The Role

As a Senior Storage Administrator, you will be instrumental in driving efficiency and innovation by assisting with the automation of our enterprise storage infrastructure. You'll leverage your deep expertise in NetApp and EverPure/Pure Storage to deliver highly available, performant, and cost-effective solutions, playing a critical role in our digital transformation journey.


Key Responsibilities

The Senior Storage Administrator will also be responsible for critical storage operations support in a primarily NAS environment and will participate in a global on-call rotation. Must be able to perform problem resolution in an effective and timely manner in accordance with SLA's and customer expectations. Time management and prioritization skills will be required to accommodate business requirements and manage scheduled activities. Must work well in a team environment and possess strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Infrastructure Management: Storage platforms administration, monitoring, upgrading, installation and setup, configuration, testing, and deployments optimized for software development and build environments.

  • Performance Engineering & Tuning: Drive performance tuning, capacity planning, and troubleshooting in large-scale enterprise environments with high IOPs and throughput demands (supporting CI/CD pipelines, EDA workloads, and developer scratch spaces).

  • Automation & Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Spearhead process automation, expert scripting, and IaC to enable self-service storage provisioning for engineering teams.

  • Vendor & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with architecture, DevOps, and service delivery teams on new and existing infrastructure initiatives; manage vendor escalations for critical support issues.

  • Operations & Support: Handle tier-3 support tickets for complex customer/developer issues and participate in a global on-call rotation. Ensure reliable operations in a primarily NAS/SAN environment in accordance with strict SLAs.

Job Qualifications

  • Education: BS degree (or equivalent) in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MS degree is preferred.

  • Experience: 5+ years of directly applicable enterprise storage administration experience in large-scale corporate or software engineering environments.

  • Core Storage Expertise:

    • 5+ years working with Network Appliance NAS/SAN technologies, including in-depth experience with NetApp Cluster Mode (cDot) and management tools (e.g., Active IQ Unified Manager).

    • Hands-on administration and troubleshooting experience with Everpure Storage or modern all-flash scale-out platforms.

    • Robust understanding of Data Protection technologies, including SnapMirror/Snapvault replications and disaster recovery paradigms.

  • Software Development & Engineering Support Alignment:

    • Demonstrated experience supporting software development organizations, understanding the unique IO profile of software builds, test execution, compilation workloads, and artifact repositories.

    • Familiarity with High-Performance Computing (HPC) and EDA (Electronic Design Automation) storage requirements (handling high small-file IOPS, concurrency, and massive throughput).

  • Automation & Scripting: Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, PowerShell, Ansible, REST APIs, and Terraform/IaC to eliminate manual administrative toil.

  • OS & Networking Fundamentals: Solid understanding of networking protocols (NFS, SMB/CIFS, TCP/IP) and deep operating system administration skills (Linux and Windows) for diagnosing client-side storage bottlenecks, permissions, and mount issues.

  • Operations Mindset: Solid understanding of problem management, incident management, and change control processes in a global enterprise. Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Knowledge / Skills, Education, and Experience

  • Development Toolchain Familiarity: Exposure to modern developer tools and CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, Docker/Kubernetes persistent volumes).

  • Certifications: NetApp Certified Storage Associate/Professional (NCSA/NCIE) or Pure Storage certifications highly desired. 

  • Virtualization & Cloud: Experience with OpenStack, VMware, or hybrid-cloud storage tiering.

  • EDA Industry Knowledge: Specific familiarity with semiconductor or mechanical EDA tool storage tuning.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Miller Electric
jobs.description_html:
Key Account Manager - Miller Electric

Position Overview

At Siemens, we pride ourselves on enabling sustainable progress through technology. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to improve how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation. We believe that a business thrives when its people thrive, which is why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team is here to support and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? 

Our technology transforms infrastructure, across buildings, electrification, and grids, at speed and scale, enabling collaborative ecosystems to accelerate our customers’ digital journey to become more competitive, more resilient, and more sustainable.

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Account Manager to join our Siemens Smart Infrastructure division, focusing on Power Distribution. This position will play a critical role in advancing our market footprint through a strategic, multi-branch electrical contractor (Miller Electric). The successful candidate will report to the Area Sales Manager and be responsible for driving strategic growth/market share, sales targets, and ensure customer satisfaction.

Key Account Manager - Miller Electric

This position will be remote in Jacksonville metro areas.

Role Description

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Develop and implement strategic account plans to achieve sales targets and market growth. 
  • Build/maintain strong relationships and drive influence with key decision-makers for a national contractor.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the contractor’s national footprint. 
  • Ensure exceptional customer service and satisfaction. 
  • Address and resolve customer issues and concerns promptly. 
  • Conduct regular meetings and quarterly business reviews with the key account to review performance and identify areas for improvement. 
  • Drive sales initiatives and campaigns to achieve revenue targets. 
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to identify growth opportunities. 
  • Collaborate with the strategic national account team and their target general contractors to develop and execute effective sales strategies. 
  • Work closely with other divisions within Siemens Smart Infrastructure to leverage synergies and drive integrated solutions. 
  • Coordinate with product management, engineering, and operations teams to ensure seamless project execution. 
  • Prepare and present regular sales reports, forecasts, and performance analyses to the Area Sales Manager and Regional Sales Director. 
  • Utilize CRM tools to track and manage customer interactions and sales activities. 
  • Ensure adherence to Siemens’ policies, procedures, and ethical standards. 
  • Promote a culture of integrity and compliance within the team. 

You will win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years’ experience in working in the power distribution market and awareness of its key players. 
  • 5+ years’ experience in sales/account management within the power distribution or related industry.
  • Ability to travel 20-30% of the time, as needed, to support locations outside of the Jacksonville market and participate in trade shows/industry conferences.
  • Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States without need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA preferred.
  • 7+ years of demonstrated sales/account management experience. 
  • Proven experience in account management within the power distribution or related industry. 

Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be located here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html

jobs.title: Contract Administrator
jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role is remote.

 

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We're improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation. We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That's why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

 

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn't just about improving buildings; it's about creating perfect places that improve people's lives. 

Transform the everyday with us!

 

Our Contract Administrators serve as the backbone of our contract management operations, ensuring seamless execution of contracts, purchase orders, and other commitment documents. You'll work collaboratively with Sales, Legal, and Management teams to identify and mitigate risks, manage contract workflows, and maintain compliance with company policies. This position offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to Siemens' mission of creating intelligent infrastructure solutions while developing expertise in contract administration and risk management.

 

As a Contract Administrator, you will:      

  • Contract Review & Risk Assessment: Review contracts, purchase orders, proposals, and commitment documents (including change orders) to identify potential risks and ensure compliance with company policy; utilize contract review software to scan, analyze, and flag risks in customer agreements below designated thresholds
  • Contract Workflow Management: Manage end-to-end opportunity workflows using Contract Management software after booking; coordinate contract distribution between internal stakeholders and customers; track and follow up on contract review status with all parties
  • Document Execution & Signature Management: Facilitate the complete contract execution process using Adobe Sign for internal signatures; receive, distribute, and process fully executed contracts; ensure proper documentation and retention of all signed agreements
  • Addendum & Amendment Administration: Prepare and add addenda for contracts under threshold to address execution barriers; collaborate with contract managers to determine necessary terms and conditions requiring modification; register all addenda in the centralized registry and communicate rationale to business owners
  • Specialized Agreement Processing: Manage workflows for Master Agreements and Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs); ensure appropriate Delegation of Authority processes are completed and recorded; submit to Sales Executives Consequential Damages Waiver (CDW) for approval
  • Insurance & Bond Coordination: Distribute and receive Certificate of Insurance (COI) requests; request and process Payment and Performance Bonds
  • Stakeholder Collaboration & Escalation: Interface with Legal, Sales, and Management to resolve contract review actions; refer contract disputes to appropriate business owners and contract managers when necessary; serve as a liaison between all parties to ensure smooth contract execution
 

You will make an impact with these qualifications:     

Basic Qualifications:    

  • 3+ years of administrative experience, preferably in contract administration, contract management, legal support, or related field
  • Organizational skills with ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
  • Experience navigating spreadsheets and databases for data analysis, report generation, presentations, and general correspondence
  • Ability to review and interpret contract terms and conditions below designated thresholds
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:  

  •   Associate or Bachelor’s Degree

jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role supports our Tallahassee, FL branch location, which serves customers throughout the greater Tallahassee, FL area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.

Transform the everyday with us!


Electrical Installers assist with equipment installation, trial runs, investigative tests, repairs, and overhauls of building automation systems, fire alarm, or security systems. Activities include installation and check-out of electric and electronic components, conduit, wire, and cable while keeping records and documentation. In addition to your primary responsibilities, you will also act as a mentor, providing on-the-job training to less experienced installers, fostering a culture of growth and knowledge-sharing within our team. You will also provide on-site product and service training to the customer. Our Electrical Installers ensure safe, efficient, and reliable electrical systems that underpin Siemens’s operations, safety, and success.


As an Electrical Installer, you will:

  • Install conduit, wire, cable, and devices including panels, sensors, and components for a range of systems, ensuring their proper integration
  • Perform preventive maintenance and routine inspections
  • Perform wiring check-out and assist with system start-up. Disconnect and dismantle electric/electronic instruments, panels, sensor, etc. Troubleshoot wiring issues
  • Coordinate with operations for the timely delivery of materials and supplies to the job site
  • Lead teammates through installation requirements, and coordinate work for the installation team. May be required to assist with electrical installation estimates
  • Adhere to local, corporate, and OSHA safety policies and procedures


You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated educational or on-the-job understanding of electrical codes, requirements, and efficient installation methods and practices
  • Demonstrated educational or on-the-job experience installing conduit and running pipe
  • 3+ years' experience installing electrical systems and/or low-voltage control systems 
  • Must be able to:
    • Read and understand design and construction documents
    • Work in a variety of environments in and around mechanical equipment, including climbing ladders, scaffolds, and high-lift equipment, working in ducts, above ceilings, and in outside/inside/heat/cold/day/night conditions; use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet; carry and move equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
    • Differentiate types/colors of wire
  • Must be 18 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate degree
  • 5+ years' experience installing low-voltage control systems

  • Differentiate types/colors of wire
  • Must be 18 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program

  • 3+ years' experience installing low-voltage control systems

jobs.title: Senior Building Automation Systems Specialist
jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role supports our Tallahassee FL branch location, which serves customers throughout the greater Tallahassee, FL area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

 Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.  

Transform the everyday with us!


Our Systems Specialists participate in the installation, startup, and commissioning of building automation system equipment that has been newly installed and supports the verification of the system database and programming, ensuring consistency with the scope of work and sequence of operations. Our Systems Specialists are the face of Siemens, and your expertise and regular interaction with the customer will help them save energy and money, as well as create a more sustainable future for our environment.

 

As a Systems Specialist, you will:  

  • Commission new distributed digital control systems on construction sites within planned timelines
  • Document commissioning details; communicates deficiencies and progress
  • Act as the Lead Technician and plan work with Team Leader 
  • Network technologies: Perform data back-up from data servers and create automated back-up procedures. Troubleshoot and resolve inconsistencies in the functions or sequence of operations Configures PC workstations and user interfaces. Confirm proper network performance
  • Operational testing, verification, and acceptance: Run routine reports to review system operation Perform final inspection, testing and customer acceptance. Provide customer training on system operations. Complete and submit routine written reports. Provide plans and control system documents to engineering for as-built drawings
  • Project site communication and coordination: Coordinate trade contractors to perform startup services
  • Work Overtime as needed (Compressed schedule performance can be a factor and will require extended hours to meet commitments)
  • Work Rotational On-Call and/or Minimal Overnight Travel
  • Submit accurate time and expense reports
  • Adhere to local, corporate, and OSHA safety policies and procedures


You will make an impact with these qualifications:  

Basic Qualifications:  

  • 3+ years of experience with Electro-mechanical systems and user PC/software (either in a previous role or through education)
  • Demonstrated on-the-job experience with:
  • Integration of low voltage building sub-systems industry protocols, such as LON, BACnet, N2, Modbus, etc.
  • Reading, understanding, and interpreting design and construction documents 
  • Ability and willingness to work in a variety of circumstances, including climbing ladders, scaffolds, and high lift equipment, working in ducts, crawl spaces, roofs, basements, above ceilings, and in various conditions
  • Must be able to use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet as well as able to carry and move equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
  • Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) 
  • Must be able to work overtime and on-call as needed
  • Must be 18 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED; Associate or Bachelor’s degree in electronics, mechanical engineering, or related

jobs.title: Technical Learning Consultant - NX Ship Design - Remote USA
jobs.description_html:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

As part of a zone or country Enterprise Learning and Adoption team, work with Professional Services and project management to deliver high-quality Learning and Adoption Services and end user training. Contribute to the delivery of Enterprise Learning and Adoption programs in agreed DI domains that enable customers to minimize user adoption risks and to achieve superior adoption of the Digital Enterprise solution.

Deliver standard and custom instructor-led trainings in center, at customer site or as distance learning. Applies aspects of Adult Learning strategies and Siemens Learning and Adoption best practices to address the needs of Customer user communities. In collaboration with the lead Learning Architect, follows the Learning and Adoption work stream of customer programs deploying multiple Siemens DI products within a single domain (for example: DI, STS, DER) to multiple locations.

Actively participates in and contributes to the global "Learning" Community of Practice and contributes to the definition, development and curation of the Siemens Learning and Adoption best practices. Works under self-management on routine assignment/projects and light supervision on new assignment/projects. Works on projects/assignments of basic to moderate scope.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct in person and online NX Ship Design training classes to our customers.
  • Demonstrate critical thinking, command of specific technical subject matter, ability to learn new technologies very quickly, and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts in the simplest possible terms (relative to the audience)
  • Stimulate interest and enhance learner understanding through appropriate anecdotes, stories, analogies and humor. Use activities that allow learners to review and apply content at appropriate intervals.
  • Apply Adult Learning strategies and Siemens Learning and Adoption best practices to address the needs of customers user communities.
  • Actively participates in and contributes to the global "Learning" Community of Practice and contributes to the definition, development and curation of the Siemens Learning and Adoption best practices.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Willingness to travel up to 50%
  • Bachelor’s Degree is required for this position
  • Required: 5-10 years of experience in design, development and delivery of training, and blended-learning solutions
  • Strong hands-on experience using NX Ship Design, in a Design role, is absolutely required as this person will need to be able to answer many complex question from Ship Designers using NX.
  • Strong preference for recent experience as a Trainer, in addition to the above (But not required)

NOTE: Applicants must not require employer sponsored work Visa authorization, now or in the future for employment in the USA.  Must be able to support US Dept of defense requests


Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Manager of Governance and Performance Controlling, Finance Operations


Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?


Transform the everyday with us!


Join our Smart Infrastructure (SI) team as Manager of Governance and Performance Controlling, Finance Operations to help us to successfully establish, manage and oversee all activities and process related to controls and reporting. The successful candidate will partner closely with the Operations FIN team, the Performance controlling team, the EP Factories, the Segment Fin teams and other functions while owning and aiming to improve all financial transparency, controls, planning and controlling and measuring the achievement of KPIs and driving improvements / projects.

This position is based in Peachtree Corners, GA. Remote eligibility is generally limited to current Siemens employees or candidates with a proven track record of success in remote work environments.”


As the Manager of Governance and Performance Controlling, Finance Operations, you will:

  • Be part of the Finance Operations leadership team and partner with plant finance teams and well as Operations- and Operations Finance leadership team and Business Unit Performance Controlling
  • Recruit, manage, assess, and develop team members by setting challenging targets and ensure achievement by motivating, encouraging and advising as required.
  • Own and drive all performance controlling activities for EP North America Finance Operations (US, MEX, CAN), including:
    • organize, direct and improve planning- and forecasting processes, including timelines, tools, systematic, etc.
    • own, drive and improve regular performance reviews including scope, timelines, tools, Risk and Opportunities
    • create collaborative structure with operations fin teams to ensure we have required transparency
    • own, drive and improve regular performance reviews including scope, timelines, tools, Risk and Opportunities
  • Own Governance for EP North America Finance Operations (US, MEX, CAN), including:
    • design, implement and monitor internal controls across the plant network to ensure accuracy of books and records and process adherence, identify any gaps or weaknesses and coordinate with internal and external auditors.
    • implement new systems, software and tools and enhance existing ones to ensure optimal support of technical and financial needs, e.g. SAP
    • innovate by standardizing and digitalizing existing processes and identify opportunities to develop new KPI’s or reporting that adds business value.
  • Help define long term strategic targets and drive implementation by breaking them into achievable short-term objectives in a highly dynamic environment.
  • Valuate and ensure alignment of operational and commercial targets. Develop KPI’s to measure such targets and collaborate cross-functionally to take corrective actions as necessary.
  • Support and drive accuracy of master data and value flow in factories aiming at standardization and Sherpa readiness

You will make a strong impact if you have the following qualifications:

  • BS in Accounting, Finance or related field.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in Finance, preferably in an industrial manufacturing environment
  • Experience and in-depth know-how of large and complex manufacturing environments
  • Comprehensive SCM- and manufacturing process understanding (beyond finance)
  • Very strong in-depth knowledge of SAP (FI/CO) and digitalization- / automation tools (Tableau, Snowflake, KNIME, PowerBI, etc.) and AI
  • Strong Networking-, Collaboration- and Stakeholder Management skills
  • Ability to effectively manage deadlines, prioritize and multi-task in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting process, performance controlling, and internal controls.
  • Experience and track record in developing and directing teams as well as to manage and develop individuals
  • Strong impact on results in own area.

  • CPA or Advanced degree in Finance

jobs.title: Senior Mulesoft Developer (Technical Lead) - US Remote
jobs.description_html:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and deploy MuleSoft solutions, including APIs, integrations, and connectors like SFDC, SAP, Queue, Database, etc.
  • Design and develop MuleSoft applications using RAML 1.0, API Designer, API Management, and implementation of policies.
  • Strong understanding of DataWeave 2.0 and ability to develop complex logic using DataWave 2.0.
  • Design and develop Munits as part of unit testing.
  • Deployment of applications on on-prem and cloud hub 2.0.
  • Lead the technical design and implementation of integration solutions, ensuring adherence to best practices and scalability.
  • Collaborate with product managers, business analysts, and other developers to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Implement MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, including API Gateway, Anypoint Studio, and CloudHub.
  • Lead the design and development of API-led connectivity and microservices architecture.
  • Perform unit testing, integration testing, and troubleshooting of MuleSoft solutions to ensure high-quality deliverables.
  • Ensure the security, performance, and scalability of the integration solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior developers and team members.
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and solution architecture to promote best practices and maintain high code quality.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, ensuring minimal downtime and efficient resolution.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest MuleSoft features, tools, and industry trends to continually improve the integration solutions.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in software development with a focus on MuleSoft and API integrations.
  • Strong experience in an object-oriented programming language.
  • Proficiency in MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, including Mule 4, Anypoint Studio, API Manager, and CloudHub.
  • Strong experience in designing and developing RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Solid understanding of API-led connectivity and microservices architecture.
  • Proficiency in integration patterns, EAI, ESB, and SOA concepts.
  • Experience with data formats such as JSON, XML, and understanding of data transformation tools.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based technologies, specifically in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Strong knowledge of security standards, such as OAuth, SAML, and API security best practices.
  • Experience with version control tools such as Git, SVN, or similar.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex integration issues.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of Jenkins, Maven and Databases is necessary.
  • Strong experience with all types of integration patterns.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline tools (Jenkins, Maven, etc.).
  • Knowledge of database technologies (SQL/NoSQL) and integration with MuleSoft.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and development practices.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

"Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified Applicants will not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States".

Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday with Us

jobs.title: Data Center Project Manager - Customer Service
jobs.description_html:
Customer Service Associate Project Manager – Data Centers

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrive is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? 

Transform the everyday with us!

About Smart Infrastructure – Electrification and Automation:

The Electrification and Automation (EA) Business Unit offers the full range of energy distribution systems and solutions for all markets and through all sales channels. We provide reliable power distribution grids of today while investing into our Future Grids portfolio and applications to create the power distribution grid of the future. Our comprehensive portfolio meets the growing technical requirements of today’s and tomorrow’s power grid!

Headquarters in Wendell, NC, the EA PMO executes a diverse portfolio of projects, and this position will be focused on service solutions within our Customer Services business. This role comes with ample opportunities for growth, reflective of Siemens’ mission to empower people with a growth mindset. As a customer-facing team, we keep customer satisfaction at the forefront as we manage large projects in a fast-paced environment.

The Siemens Project Management Office (PMO) is looking for a Customer Services (CS) Associate Project Manager to join our team, specifically our Data Centers team. This position can be remote or based out of Wendell, NC.

You’ll make an impact by:

As a CS Project Manager, you will be responsible for the successful execution of projects, from project initiation through final closeout. You will work in a matrix style organization requiring excellent coordination skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.

  • Project Management: Manage projects from inception to completion, ensuring safety, budget, schedule, quality, and performance objectives are met.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Communicate effectively with team members, stakeholders, and management, providing regular updates and managing customer expectations throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Resource Management: Identify, assign, and manage project resources, including engineering, field personnel, vendors, and 3rd-party services.
  • Risk Management: Proactively identify project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and monitor/control 3rd-party vendors to ensure contract adherence.
  • Financial Leadership: Track project budget, schedule completion, and perform monthly revenue forecasting.
  • Contract Management: Review and understand contractual obligations, manage change orders, and participate in vendor negotiations.
  • Quality & Process Improvement: Develop project execution plans like quality & testing plans, schedules, and risk registers. Implement recovery plans to address performance issues.
  • Collaboration & Relationship Building: Collaborate with internal/external teams and clients to develop site schedules, maintain client relationships, and provide "Lessons Learned" feedback to improve project offerings.

Project Types: Installation and commissioning, turn-key, design-build, EPC contracts, data center construction, power system studies, maintenance outage testing and electrical system emergency response/disaster recovery, electrical retrofit, managing teams of field service engineers as well as 3rd party suppliers, consultants and contractors.

Product types: Low and medium voltage air insulated switchgear, medium voltage gas insulated switchgear and switches, low voltage panelboards and automatic transfer switches, air and liquid filled transformers, motor control centers, medium voltage contactors, integrated e-house electrical solution systems, battery systems, electrical cable systems and busways, cable, connectors and supporting systems.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Successful completion of Project Management SkillBridge Program hosted by Siemens SI EA
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Knowledge of electrical power distribution systems
  • 2+ years of direct service project management experience.
  • 2+ years of written and verbal communication skills, to present complex issues to multi-level audiences and effectively communicate progress, status and issues to internal and external Customers.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PMP certification – while not required immediately for this role, for those who do not have it already, obtaining PMP certification is required within 1 year of employment.
  • A degree in engineering or construction management.
  • Experience in specific industry related to service project e.g., field service, EPC projects, construction, energy, and manufacturing.
  • An understanding of medium and/or high voltage electrical equipment.
  • An understanding of datacenter construction projects.
  • Experience with MS Project or other relevant scheduling software.
  • Strong leadership skills with experience in leading cross-functional project teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, to present complex issues to multi-level audiences and effectively communicate progress, status, and issues to internal and external Customers.

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here. 

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce: 

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us. 


You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $77,219 - $132,376 annually with a target incentive of 5% - 10% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Remote Supply Chain Management Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description_html:
The Siemens Government Technologies (SGT) Internship Program enables college students to explore stimulating career possibilities in the government contracting environment. As an intern of SGT, you will be given individual and group assignments that are designed to provide you with experience in a corporate environment and develop your business acumen. 

Objective - Work within the Supply Chain Management (SCM) department to assist with, supplier vetting, on-boarding, reporting, and industry research and KPI analysis. In addition, support Subcontract Administrators with procurement file administration to learn regulatory compliance.

Developmental Aspects - The intern will have direct involvement with Federal Acquisition Regulations, evaluation of suppliers, and the execution of the required documentation internally and externally with suppliers. Communication skills will be developed when engaging internal customer as well as the supplier community. The intern will be exposed to and required to perform various tasks that will enhance analytical skills. The intern will participate in team meetings and continuous improvement projects.

Responsibilities:
•Actively engage in vendor outreach activities and develop the appropriate vendor profile information. 
•Participate in the development and maturation of departmental metrics in Power BI
•Participate in departmental continuous improvement projects, including metrics and enhanced use of AI
•Support to Supply Chain team as required during peak business period
•Compliance reviews of procurement folders

Requirements:
•Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher
•Rising junior or above
•Seasoned in using Microsoft suite and products
•Creativity in problem solving and alternative solutions
•Demonstrated ability to collaborate with others on projects and assignments to achieve optimal results
•Ability to quickly learn the SGT business and understand the values proposition to SGT
•Proven ability to present information in both 1 on 1 and large group settings.
•Strong communication skills
•Ability to meet deadlines and schedules

Preferred: 
•AI experience 

Clearance Requirement:
•Candidate must be a United States Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Security Clearance




You’ll Benefit From
The hourly pay range for this position $23.00 - $29.00 per hour, based off of your projected graduation year. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location. Additionally, interns for Siemens are eligible to contribute into our 401K program.

Transform the everyday with us! At Siemens, we combine the real and digital worlds to enable sustainable progress. Our global, diverse team puts people first, supporting and challenging you to grow in new ways. 

 

Role Overview 

The Technical Marketing Manager bridges technical development and commercial go-to-market strategy for our Data Centers & AI Factories vertical. By combining deep technical fluency with strategic storytelling, you will translate complex technologies such as power systems, cooling, automation, and digital twins into credible, value-driven narratives and assets that empower sales teams, partners, and customers. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Content Creation & Storytelling: Architect and produce high-impact technical assets including white papers, solution briefs, reference architectures, technical presentations, and demos that articulate Siemens’ business and technical value. 
  • Sales & Partner Enablement: Build sales tools (talk tracks, FAQs, competitive guides, discovery questions) and co-deliver training programs, workshops, and launch materials to prepare sellers and ecosystem partners. 
  • Technical Validation: Collaborate with SMEs, engineers, and solution architects to validate technical claims, benchmarks, simulations, and proofs of value for accuracy and credibility. 
  • Cross-Functional Bridge: Serve as the bridge between technical teams, product management, sales, marketing, and partners to ensure consistent, appropriate audience messaging. 
  • Optimization & Innovation: Leverage feedback, performance data analytics, and emerging approaches (including generative AI and interactive media) to continuously improve content quality and relevance. 

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:  

Basic Qualifications 

 
  • Experience: 8+ years in technical marketing, solutions marketing, product marketing, technical communications, solutions architecture, or engineering within B2B technology. 
  • Education: Bachelor’s or higher degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Center Infrastructure, Technical Communications, Marketing, or a related field. 
  • Content & Communication: Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into accurate, compelling narratives across multiple formats (white papers, visual-story telling, presentations, reference architectures). 
  • Collaboration & Cross-Functional Leadership: Experience partnering with engineering, product, sales, and executive stakeholders to drive alignment and validate technical claims. 
  • Enablement & Readiness: Demonstrated track record of creating and delivering training, sales tools, or readiness programs that equip teams to position complex solutions. 
  • Autonomy: A self-starter with strong project management skills, capable of managing multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced, matrixed global organization. 
 

Preferred Qualifications 

 
  • Domain Depth: Familiarity with the full data center lifecycle (design, construction, operation, optimization) and target segments (hyperscalers, neo-cloud, colocation, enterprise, EPCs). 
  • AI & Modern Tools: Experience leveraging generative AI/LLMs responsibly for content scaling, alongside familiarity with modern content management and sales enablement platforms. 
  • Portfolio: A portfolio of technical writing, solution content, demonstrations, or enablement materials showcasing your ability to communicate complex technologies effectively. 
 

About Siemens:

 

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.

 

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

 

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

 

You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $84,206 - $144,352 annually with a target incentive of 15 of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role supports our Winter Park, FL branch location, which serves customers throughout the greater Orlando, FL area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?  

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.

Transform the everyday with us!


Our Fire Alarm Systems Technicians are responsible for the installation, programming, start-up, and commissioning of state-of-the-art fire alarm equipment, including fire safety, mass notification, detectors, and field peripherals. Our Fire Alarm Technicians are the face of Siemens, and your expertise and regular interaction with the customer will help keep their buildings and occupants safe.


As a Fire Alarm Technician, you will:

  • Participate in Operational Testing, Verification, and Acceptance: run routine reports to review system operation, conduct final inspections and testing, and support customer acceptance and the Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ). 
  • Assist in customer training on system operations and provide necessary plans and fire safety system documents for as-built drawings; identify code and non-conformance issues and make recommendations for system installation
  • Conduct project site communication and coordination by supporting scheduling trade contractors to coordinate start-up services and adhere to local, corporate, and OSHA safety policies and procedures


You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications: 

  • 2+ years experience programming commercial fire alarm systems
  • NICET II Fire Alarm Systems Certification
  • Must be willing and able to differentiate types/colors of wire; use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet; carry and move equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
  • Must be 18 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED; Associate degree in electronics or related field 
  • 3+ years’ experience programming commercial fire alarm systems 
  • Ability to read/understand design and construction documents

jobs.title: Legal Manager - US
jobs.description_html:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Position Overview

Siemens Digital Industries Software is looking to hire a Legal Manager to join the team responsible for negotiating customer contracts for the Americas zone for the Global Sales channel. 

The individual in this role will manage a team of attorneys and contracts managers who are partnering with the business on commercial transactions and partner with the business themselves on commercial transactions.  The successful candidate will be part of a global team which is primarily based in the US and will report to a US manager.

Key Responsibilities

This role includes performance of the following:

  • Managing a team of approximately 3 attorneys and contracts managers
  • Providing legal support and counsel to the business in the US, including with a focus on contracts in the aerospace and defense vertical, Components contracts and contracts with the US government, including working with Siemens Government Technologies
  • Autonomously conducting contract negotiations with clients with a focus on software licensing, cloud offerings and data protection
  • Coordinate responses to customer contract clauses, concerns and questions by seeking internal feedback from subject matter experts across the global organization (includes members of Finance, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Government, Risk Management, etc.)
  • Partner with internal clients and finance during contract negotiations
  • Conduct training on legal issues for our business partners
  • Handle matters of high risk, complexity and visibility within the business

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

  • Licensed to practice law in the United States
  • 10+ years of experience drafting and negotiating complex legal agreements
  • Demonstrated expertise negotiating contracts with the US Government is a strong plus
  • An interest and willingness to explore and utilize AI tools to streamline legal workflows
  • Exceptional customer-centric responsiveness and professional demeanor
  • Flexibility to adjust and thrive in a fast-paced environment with evolving requirements
  • Proven ability to thrive as part of a globally distributed, highly matrixed virtual team.
  • Strong attention to detail

"Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified Applicants will not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States".

Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday with Us

jobs.title: Learning Consultant - Active Workspace & Teamcenter - Remote USA
jobs.description_html:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

As part of a zone or country Enterprise Learning and Adoption team, work with Professional Services and project management to deliver high-quality Learning and Adoption Services and end user training.  Contribute to the delivery of Enterprise Learning and Adoption programs in agreed DI domains that enable customers to minimize user adoption risks and to achieve superior adoption of the Digital Enterprise solution.

Deliver standard and custom instructor-led training in center, at customer sites or as distance learning.  Apply aspects of Adult Learning strategies and Siemens Learning and Adoption best practices to address the needs of Customer user communities.  In collaboration with the lead Learning Architect, follows the Learning and Adoption work stream of customer programs deploying multiple Siemens DI products within a single domain (for example: DI, STS, DER) to multiple locations.

Actively participates in and contributes to the global "Learning" Community of Practice and contributes to the definition, development and curation of the Siemens Learning and Adoption best practices.  Works under self-management on routine assignment/projects and light supervision on new assignment/projects.  Works on projects/assignments of basic to moderate scope.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct in person and online training classes to our customers utilizing our Active Workspace and Teamcenter product suite.
  • Demonstrate critical thinking, command of specific technical subject matter, ability to learn new technologies very quickly, and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts in the simplest possible terms (relative to the audience)
  • Stimulate interest and enhance learner understanding through appropriate anecdotes, stories, analogies and humor. Use activities that allow learners to review and apply content at appropriate intervals.
  • Apply Adult Learning strategies and Siemens Learning and Adoption best practices to address the needs of customers user communities.
  • Actively participates in and contributes to the global "Learning" Community of Practice and contributes to the definition, development and curation of the Siemens Learning and Adoption best practices.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Willingness to travel up to 50%.
  • Bachelor’s Degree is required for this position
  • Preferred, not required: 3-10 years of experience in design, development and delivery of training, and blended-learning solutions

jobs.title: Remote Operations Specialist - Advanced
jobs.description_html:
Siemens Government Technologies (SGT) is a dynamic and rapidly growing organization, and we are seeking a self-driven individual to complement our growing team.

As an Operations Specialist you will work under light supervision to support Services Opportunities and Projects of small to mid-size. You will be part of a services organization that coordinates services projects, driving customers’ value realization. The Operations Specialist supports the Services Engagement Lifecycle from opportunity to booking and from order to execution and acts as a point of contact for Engagement Managers, Project Managers, Resource Managers, Services Business Managers, Service Delivery Resources, Finance, Legal, Global Order Management, Procurement, Accounts Receivable and Credit and Collections.
 
Responsibilities:
•Support Engagement Managers through services lead to order including vetting requirements, ensuring alignment of pricing with the finance team and proposal preparation needs with the proposal team
•Manage vendor processes from solicitating quotations with the procurement team through award of purchase order
•Administrate the Project manager’s duties of planning, budgeting, overseeing and documenting all aspects of the project
•Monitor pending customer project billing and support Project Manager with acquiring acceptance documentation for billing
•Review and audit travel billings against FTR regulations
•Support Project Manager with making Budget and Budget Line-Item funding re-allocations 
•Support Project manager to manage and resolve issues with all necessary internal and external partners
•Discuss with Project Manager how to manage project funding balances and close projects using the project closeout process
•Support the organizational culture, values and reputation in company markets and with all staff, customers, suppliers, partners and regulatory/official bodies.
•Adhere to, and promote all core internal and customer processes relating to the effective undertaking of the role
•Ensure that all communication channels within the business are adhered to.
•Provide input, where appropriate to team meetings.
•Undertake any business administration in line with job activity
•Undertake any other duties required by the company.

Qualifications:
•Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration or Project Management or equivalent years of experience . 
•Minimum four (4) years in project coordination or administration experience or equivalent Project Support Experience
•Three (3) years of experience working in a customer-facing environment
•Working knowledge of the administrative functions of the Services business including project setup, contract structure, progress reporting, revenue recognition and billing.
•Experience in identifying and implementing cost savings measures within services projects.
•Leadership skills and proven track record of managing multi-disciplinary teams, including services delivery and project management.
•Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
•Excellent written and verbal communications with the ability to present complex issues to multi-level audiences of company and government executives.
•Ability to effectively communicate progress, status and issues to internal and external customers. 
•Ability to obtain and meet Business goals and results
•Ability to promote complex solutions and drive acceptance with confidence
•Knowledge and ability to deliver goals effectively and drive the project to success with a sense for urgency. 
•Willingness and the ability to travel to appropriate work location, as required.
•Willingness and the availability to work the core hours required by the specific project and per company policy.

Preferred:
•Experience with US Federal Government projects, contracts, policies and procedures.

Travel:
•Up to 5% annually

Security Clearance
Candidate must be United States citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S DOD Government Security Clearance if required at a later date. 



You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $69,400.00 - $124,900.00 annually with a target incentive of 7.5% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Switchgear Products Site Installation
jobs.description_html:
Site Installation Project Manager - 100% Travel

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrive is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? 

Transform the everyday with us!

About Siemens’ Electrification & Automation

The Electrification and Automation (EA) Business Unit offers the full range of energy distribution systems and solutions for all markets and through all sales channels. We provide reliable power distribution grids of today while investing into our Future Grids portfolio and applications to create the power distribution grid of the future. Our comprehensive portfolio meets the growing technical requirements of todays and tomorrow’s power grid!

We are seeking a Site Installation Project Manager to plan and oversee turn-key service projects from beginning to end. This position will be based remotely.

You’ll make an impact by:

You will be leading our on-site team, working directly with the customer/customer representatives, our internal commissioning team, warranty case managers, service PMs and solutions PMs. The Site Installation Project Manager should have previous experience in managing projects and be knowledgeable of electrical equipment and its installation. The ideal applicant will be highly organized, with the ability to plan and multi-task to meet deadlines and keep projects under budget. If this sounds like you, get in touch with us.

  • Lead all phases of the project lifecycle from contract award through completion, including client and internal meetings, site coordination, and active presence throughout execution.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive commissioning plans, clearly defining responsibilities and ensuring alignment with project timelines and objectives.
  • Supervise and execute site activities in accordance with commissioning plans and industry standards, maintaining a high level of quality and safety.
  • Collaborate with clients, trades, and stakeholders to negotiate schedules, address concerns, and drive project progress through respectful and effective communication.
  • Prioritize and organize tasks efficiently, proactively identifying and addressing potential risks or issues before they impact the schedule.
  • Generate and review daily and weekly reports to communicate on-site activities and progress in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Identify out-of-scope work, prepare estimates, and assist in change order and claims processing to support project controls.
  • Coordinate and manage construction personnel and subcontractors, ensuring resource availability, tracking headcount, and optimizing productivity.
  • Maintain compliance with all project requirements, codes, and construction standards across on-site and off-site activities.
  • Foster strong working relationships with team members, supervisors, and leadership to resolve issues, coach team performance, and support a productive work environment.
  • Analyze and mitigate project risks while maintaining adaptability to handle emerging challenges.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with all project personnel, including engineers, construction teams, and management.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Successful completion of Project Management SkillBridge Program hosted by Siemens SI EA
  • HS Diploma with equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of Site Management or Project Management experience
  • Demonstrated leadership ability and a proven track record of managing multi-disciplinary teams, including sub-contractors, field services, engineering, operations, and logistics
  • Ability to interpret and report results to senior management as well as customer
  • 100% Travel to customer construction site
  • Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the USA without the need of company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or construction management or equivalent experience.
  • A commitment to develop, drive, and manage projects in a highly competitive environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, to present complex issues to multi-level audiences and effectively communicate progress, status, and issues to internal and external Customers

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here. 

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce: 

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us. 


You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $86,485 - $148,261 annually with a target incentive of 5% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Head of Flexible Production - Zone Americas
jobs.description_html:
Head of Flexible Production - Zone Americas

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us! 

The Head of Horizontal Flexible Production plays a pivotal role in driving order intake, business growth, and market development within Zone Americas. By leveraging deep expertise in Flexible Production solutions, planning software, technical architecture knowledge, and sales expertise, the role accelerates opportunity creation, supports regional sales organizations, and aligns customer requirements with the global Horizontal Flexible Production strategy.

We are seeking a business development professional to drive growth of Siemens Automation solutions within the Advanced Manufacturing ecosystem across the Americas. This role will focus on machine builders, AMR/AGV & robotics providers, integrators, and manufacturing technology partners, helping expand adoption of Siemens automation technologies and strengthen Siemens' position in the next generation of manufacturing equipment. This aligns with the ecosystem, machine builder, and automation focus identified in the Americas Advanced Manufacturing strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute business development strategy focused on Flexible Production working with machine builders, AMR/AGV & robotics providers, integrators, manufacturing technology partners and end customers.
  • Drive adoption of Siemens Automation solutions including Automation, Motion Control, Drives, Visualization, Industrial Edge, AI, and Robotics technologies.
  • Build and maintain relationships with OEMs, integrators, research organizations, and industry partners.
  • Support development of advanced manufacturing solutions including flexible manufacturing, hybrid manufacturing, robotics, and factory automation applications.
  • Identify and develop new automation-focused opportunities across strategic OEM accounts.
  • Work closely with Siemens account teams, business units, and technical resources to develop customer opportunities.
  • Represent Siemens at industry events including IMTS, Automate and other manufacturing conferences.

jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role is a U.S. based remote role. The ideal candidate lives near a major airport.


Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We're improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation. We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? 


Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives. 

Transform the everyday with us!


The National Business Development Manager – Advanced Detection plays a pivotal role in accelerating growth for the Siemens Buildings Solution Partner team. This position is responsible for expanding market share and driving new revenue within the ASD+ product line.

You will analyze market opportunities, develop and execute high-impact growth strategies, and fully own the end-to-end sales pipeline for new ASD+ opportunities. With a strong focus on verticalization, you will create personalized business plans to identify, develop, and close new business by delivering tailored Siemens fire solutions to target industries. This role reports to the Director of Fire Partner Programs.


As a National Business Development Manager, you will:

  • Drive sustainable revenue growth by acquiring new clients and increasing market presence of ASD+ air sampling systems
  • Build and manage a robust sales pipeline from initial prospecting through contract execution
  • Collaborate closely with the Technical Operations team and Fire Territory Managers (TMs) to deliver compelling solutions and accelerate deal closures
  • Partner with the Product Management team on product demonstrations, roadshows, and industry events
  • Lead strategic business initiatives and provide valuable insight into leadership planning and decision-making
  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of customers’ businesses and identify where Siemens technology and solutions can deliver significant value
  • Penetrate new markets and accounts, build relationships with C-level decision makers, uncover opportunities, recommend differentiated solutions, negotiate, and win new customers
  • Identify and convert competitive installations to Siemens solutions by qualifying opportunities, advancing them through the sales cycle, and driving them to closure.
  • Effectively leverage internal Siemens resources to maximize win rates
  • Represent Siemens with customers in a responsive, professional, proactive, and ethical manner that reflects company values
  • Coordinate customer-facing and internal efforts to develop winning value propositions and proposals
  • Apply best-in-class sales methodologies and maintain disciplined use of CRM, accurate forecasting, pipeline reviews, and quarterly planning
  • Maintain a strong funnel of vertical market prospects and assist in developing programs for the partner channel
  • Engage at multiple levels within target customer organizations
  • Optimize current market conditions to expand Siemens fire solutions and products

You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of industry experience within the Air Sampling market
  • Proven track record of successfully penetrating new accounts at senior management levels and building a healthy sales pipeline
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills at all organizational levels
  • Demonstrated success identifying market trends and customer needs
  • Valid driver’s license in good standing
  • Willingness to travel up to 60%
  • Legally authorized to work permanently in the United States without sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field
  • 10+ years of experience in the fire industry
  • Proven success in a highly matrixed, complex sales environment
  • Strong organizational, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
  • Familiarity with the Siemens Buildings portfolio and Advanced Detection solutions
  • Thorough knowledge of market penetration and market development strategies
  • Track record of executing tactical and strategic initiatives that deliver measurable business impact

You will ensure service execution aligns with Siemens SI B standards and partner closely with central Operations teams, including PMO and Operations Excellence, to drive consistency, quality, and scalable service performance.


As an Area Operations Manager, Service, you will:

  • Drive service and operational growth by meeting and/or exceeding quarterly and annual service revenue, gross margin, and operating margin commitments
  • Lead end-to-end service execution, including project services and Service Agreements, ensuring delivery within scope, schedule, cost, and quality expectations
  • Plan, direct, and oversee service operations to support sustainable growth and long-term customer retention
  • Monitor service and project performance to control costs, manage risk, and improve margin performance
  • Partner with central Operations teams (PMO and Operations Excellence) to leverage standard tools, best practices, and shared capabilities
  • Provide operational and technical support to Sales teams, including pricing guidance, scope definition, renewals, and lifecycle service strategy
  • Lead workforce planning by hiring, developing, allocating, and performance-managing service resources to support current and future business needs
  • Ensure balance sheet, cash flow, and working capital performance align with Siemens and SI B North Star expectations
  • Maintain close alignment with Area General Management on service strategy, execution priorities, and market growth initiatives

  • 5-8+ years of experience leading service or operations organizations in a project-based, solutions, or service environment
  • Financial acumen, including responsibility for service revenue, margin, cost control, and cash flow performance
  • Experience partnering effectively with Sales, Project Management, and operations organizations
  • High School diploma or state-recognized GED
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens’ fleet vehicle program
