jobs.title: Portfolio Consulting Manager
jobs.description_html:
Who are we?

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world!

Siemens Grid Software's consulting business Power Technologies International (PTI) is seeking a Portfolio Consulting Manager to lead a team focused on transmission planning and interconnection consulting services across the ERCOT and SPP regions. This leadership role combines people management, business development, customer engagement, and project execution. The successful candidate will lead a team of power system consultants while partnering with utilities, developers, and large energy users to address evolving grid reliability, electrification, and interconnection challenges.

Location: This is a remote role within the contiguous U.S.

What You Will do:

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of power system consultants.
  • Grow Siemens PTI's transmission planning and interconnection consulting business in ERCOT and SPP.
  • Build and maintain relationships with utilities, developers, RTOs, and other industry stakeholders.
  • Lead customer engagements, proposal development, project planning, and contract execution.
  • Oversee the execution of transmission planning and interconnection studies, including steady-state, short-circuit, transient stability, and related reliability assessments.
  • Ensure successful project delivery with respect to scope, schedule, budget, quality, and customer satisfaction.
  • Manage portfolio performance, including revenue growth, profitability, utilization, forecasting, and resource planning.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering.
  • 10+ years of experience in transmission planning, operations, generator interconnection, load interconnection, or power system studies.
  • 2+ years of experience leading technical teams or managing consulting organizations.
  • Working knowledge of power system analysis tools such as PSS®E, TARA, PSLF™, PowerWorld, TSAT™, or PSCAD™.
  • Strong understanding of NERC Reliability Standards and regional planning criteria.
  • Excellent communication, customer engagement, and technical report writing skills.
  • Ability to travel up to 10%.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering with a specialization in Power and Energy Systems.
  • Prior consulting experience in the electric utility industry.
  • Experience with utility-scale generation, renewable energy, or large load interconnection studies.
  • Experience with ERCOT and/or SPP planning and interconnection processes.
  • PE license preferred.

Success in this Role:

The successful candidate will balance three key areas of responsibility:

  • People Leadership - Build, mentor, and retain a high-performing consulting team.
  • Business Growth - Expand Siemens PTI's market presence and consulting portfolio across ERCOT and SPP through strong customer relationships and strategic business development.
  • Project Delivery - Ensure high-quality, profitable execution of complex customer engagements while maintaining customer satisfaction and long-term client relationships.

jobs.title: Experience Manager-Data Centers & AI Factories
jobs.description_html:
Experience Manager-Data Centers & AI Factories

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us!

We are looking for an Experience Manager. This role is a U.S. based remote position who has access to a major U.S. Airport.

The Experience Manager for Data Centers and AI Factories is responsible for developing and orchestrating high-impact customer and stakeholder experiences that bring the Siemens portfolio, expertise, and value proposition to life. This role creates a consistent, connected experience across industry events, customer experience centers, executive engagements, and product demonstrations, helping audiences understand how Siemens enables the next generation of data centers and AI infrastructure.

Working across business units, sales, marketing, communications, portfolio teams, technical experts, partners, and regional and global stakeholders, the Experience Manager will translate strategic priorities into engaging experiences that support reputation, customer engagement, demand generation, and business growth. The role will not manage the day-to-day operations of individual customer experience centers. Instead, it will define the Data Centers and AI Factories experience strategy, establish standards, and coordinate the demonstrations, content, messaging, press announcements and customer journeys needed to create a cohesive experience, in alignment with the Data Center & AI Factory Marketing team and the Heads of the Customer Experience Centers.

The Experience Manager will also establish measurement frameworks for events and customer experiences, including reputation, engagement, demand, lead progression, and business-impact metrics. This person will ensure that leads and customer insights are captured, routed, tracked, and followed through in the CRM.

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Develop the integrated strategy and experience for priority industry events, including tradeshows, conferences, customer forums, executive engagements, and partner events, defining the audience, customer journey, key messages, and desired business outcomes.
  • Bring together marketing, sales, portfolio, technical, and business-unit stakeholders to coordinate announcements, demonstrations, speakers, content, lead capture, and post-event follow-up.
  • Define and standardize the Data Centers and AI Factories experience across Siemens customer experience centers, demonstration labs, executive briefing environments, and partner facilities.
  • Partner with technical and portfolio experts to create compelling customer journeys and product or solution demonstrations that translate complex capabilities into clear customer value.
  • Establish and track KPIs across reputation, engagement, demand generation, target-account activity, lead conversion, influenced pipeline, and overall experience effectiveness.
  • Work with sales and marketing operations to ensure leads are accurately captured, assigned, tracked, and followed up in the CRM, using performance insights to improve future programs.
  • Serve as the central experience-strategy lead, aligning global and regional marketing, sales, business units, technical experts, executives, partners, and experience-center teams around shared priorities and outcomes.
  • Manage multiple concurrent initiatives, stakeholder dependencies, agencies, vendors, timelines, and budgets while maintaining a consistent and high-quality Siemens experience.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • 7-10 years of experience leading complex, high-visibility events or customer experiences from strategy and concept through execution, measurement, and optimization.
  • 7-10 years of experience developing customer journeys, event experiences, executive engagements, demonstrations, or experience-center programming.
  • 7-10 years of experience leading cross-functional initiatives and align stakeholders across sales, marketing, communications, technical, portfolio, executive, and partner organizations.
  • 7-10 years of experience establishing KPIs, measurement frameworks, dashboards, and post-program performance reporting.
  • 7-10 years of experience with a working knowledge of reputation, engagement, demand-generation, lead-management, pipeline, and conversion metrics.
  • 7-10 years of experience using a CRM platform to manage leads, monitor follow-up, and evaluate progression through the sales funnel.
  • 7-10 years of experience in translating complex technical concepts into clear, audience-relevant experiences and business stories.
  • 7-10 years of experience managing multiple priorities, deadlines, agencies, vendors, and stakeholder groups in a global, matrixed organization.
  • Willingness and ability to travel based on business, customer, and event needs-approximately 50% domestic and 10% international.
  • Authorized to work in the US without the need for company sponsorship now or in the future.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Event Management, or Customer Experience Centers.
  • 10+ years successfully performing the planning, directing, and executing communications to both internal and external audiences.
  • Ability and flexibility to adjust to changing requirements, schedules, and priorities
  • Proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite, CRM database and other MarCom technology tools
  • Experience in B2B technology, industrial infrastructure, data centers, artificial intelligence infrastructure, energy, electrification, building technologies, automation, or software.
  • Experience developing executive briefing programs, product demonstrations, innovation centers, customer experience centers, or immersive technology experiences.
  • Understanding of complex B2B buying groups and long, multi-stakeholder customer journeys.
  • Experience coordinating product launches, media announcements, executive presentations, thought leadership, and partner activations around major events.
  • Strong strategic planning, program-management, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working across global and regional organizations.
  • Familiarity with marketing automation, event-management, digital-engagement, business-intelligence, and reporting platforms.
  • Experience managing agencies, production partners, experiential vendors, or demonstration-development partners.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and executive-communication skills.

You’ll benefit from:

  • Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
  • The pay range for this position is $84,206-$144,352 and the annual incentive target will be 10% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications and premium geographic location.

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

In this role you will work remotely from a home office. This role requires extensive travel, and it will be necessary to live near a major airport.

Siemens Industry Inc. is seeking a driven, customer-focused, Entry Level Factory Automation Field Service Engineer to join our Services Execution Division.

This home-office-based position reports to the Operations Manager, Factory Automation Field Service, and requires approximately 50-75% travel.

In this critical role, you will be trained to provide advanced technical support, engineering, troubleshooting, product expertise, and commissioning services for Siemens factory automation equipment and systems. You will support customers both on-site and remotely and serve as a key technical resource, particularly during complex and high-pressure situations.

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Providing support for Siemens factory automation equipment and software, including diagnosing and problem solving to resolve complex issues that may not be covered by standard procedures.
  • Performing the installation, configuration, commissioning, and integration of Siemens automation hardware and software at customer sites.
  • Engaging directly with customers through active listening, clear communication, and structured problem-solving, while remaining composed and effective during demanding situations.
  • Conducting scheduled customer support visits and customer onsite emergency field service needs.
  • Supporting Siemens project teams with startup and commissioning activities or new equipment and retrofits.
  • Following safe job practices, including completing daily safety briefs before work begins, and developing detailed daily field reports that document job activities.
  • Assisting with customer proposal planning by estimating labor hours, materials, travel expenses, and per diem costs.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

·         AS or BS in an Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

·         On-the-job IT experience or formal training

·         Exposure to or desire to learn about programmable logic controllers, advanced control systems, coordinated drive systems, and automation principles and concepts.

·         Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex technical issues and implementing effective resolutions.

·         Proficient in English both written and verbal

·         Authorized to work in the United States without corporate sponsorship now or in the future.

·         Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50-75% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications:

·         Effective communication with customers, listen actively, and remain composed under pressure situations.

·         Previous experience working with Siemens factory automation equipment or software.

·         Experience working in an industrial maintenance environment.

·         Programming languages C,C++, JavaScript,

·         Experience with commissioning or maintaining variable speed drives.

jobs.title: Engagement Manager- Process Vertical Markets
jobs.description_html:
Engagement Manager - CTO in Process Industries

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That's why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Siemens Digital Industries is hiring an Engagement Manager (EM) to lead architect a small portfolio of strategic end-user accounts in the process industries: Chemicals, Glass, Energy, Life Sciences, and Consumer Packaged Goods.

The scope of this role is automation in manufacturing environments — process control systems, batch and continuous production, plant-floor operations technology, predictive maintenance, IT/OT with an emphasis of industrial AI in operations, and the modernization of legacy control system installed base.

The EM spearheads the technical and commercial engagement across the process industries accounts. You will define the multi-year automation "first of's" and modernization roadmaps for each customer, architect the lifecycle program that delivers it, and lead the cross-functional team that sells and executes it. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports; you will lead through influence across sales, product, services, marketing, and customer executive stakeholders.

This position is remote with the flexibility to reside anywhere within the Continental United States.

This position is remote with the flexibility to reside anywhere within the Continental United States.


You'll make an impact by:

  • You architect the automation in manufacturing vision and map the customer from where they are to where they want to be, with the lifecycle program to get them there.
  • Own the multi-year outcome roadmap for a small set of strategic accounts — from C-suite ambition (operational performance, modernization ROI, time-to-value, sustainability targets) to the technical execution that makes it real.
  • Protect scope integrity end-to-end. No surprise scope creep. No "we'll figure it out in execution." You are the integrity check between what was sold and what gets delivered.
  • Compress order closure speed on your accounts — you are the roadblock breaker, the escalation path, the deal architect.
  • Build next-wave pipeline from inside the install base, and the champion for new large labels — every closed deal is a launchpad for the next three. Cross-portfolio thinking is the default, not the upsell.
  • Orchestrate cross-functional account teams — sellers, application engineers, product specialists, service leads, and partners — toward one coherent engagement.
  • Coach by example. No org chart authority required — your influence comes from being the most prepared, most strategic, and most outcome-focused person in the room.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years in the process industries — Chemicals, Energy, Life Sciences, or Consumer Packaged Goods. 
  • Worked as the end-user in any of the process industries
  • As senior Systems Integrator architecting automation solutions in these industries
  • You are an automation-in-manufacturing Subject Matter Expert — practitioner-grade.
  • You have personally designed, production automation systems: control system architectures, batch and continuous process control, IT/OT convergence, predictive maintenance, plant network and infrastructure design, and modernization/migration paths from legacy installed base to current-generation platforms. 
  • Demonstrated ownership of large, strategic end-user accounts — multi-site, multi-stakeholder, multi-year.
  • You have personally architected and sold lifecycle contracts. Multi-year service and lifecycle agreements, performance-based contracts, managed services, outcome-based agreements, and subscription or as-a-service commercial models.
  • The ability to translate technical complexity → executive clarity and back again.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.
  • Travel requirements 30%-35%.

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

jobs.title: Low Voltage Drives Field Service Engineer
jobs.description_html:
Low Voltage Drives Field Service Engineer

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways.

Transform the everyday with us! 

This position will be a remote position with extensive travel required. The employee must live within an hour of a major airport.

You’ll make an impact by:

Siemens is seeking a Low Voltage Drives Field Service Engineer to provide expert onsite and remote support for industrial drive systems across customer facilities. This role supports installation, startup, commissioning, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, upgrades, retrofits, and customer training for Siemens low voltage drive products and related automation systems.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical professional who enjoys solving complex problems in industrial environments, working directly with customers, and helping keep critical manufacturing and process operations running safely and reliably.

Seventy percent travel or more is expected and proximity to a major airport is required.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform field service activities for Siemens low voltage drives, including SINAMICS G120, G130, G150, S120, Masterdrives, DC drives, and related drive platforms.
  • Support installation, startup, commissioning, testing, tuning, troubleshooting, repair, preventive maintenance, and modernization work at customer sites.
  • Diagnose hardware, software, communication, motor, and power-related issues using electrical schematics, drive parameters, diagnostic tools, meters, and test equipment.
  • Provide technical and operational support for low voltage drives, motion control, PLC/HMI interfaces, motor control centers, and related industrial automation equipment.
  • Perform emergency break-fix service and scheduled service work in manufacturing, process, utility, marine, and heavy industrial environments.
  • Create clear service reports, timesheets, test records, recommendations, and follow-up actions after each assignment.
  • Communicate professionally with customers, project managers, technical support, sales, and internal service teams.
  • Train customer maintenance and operations personnel on proper equipment operation, inspection, maintenance, and basic troubleshooting.
  • Identify opportunities for spare parts, service agreements, upgrades, retrofits, training, and reliability improvements.
  • Follow Siemens safety procedures, customer site requirements, lockout/tagout practices, and applicable electrical safety standards.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, electrical engineering technology, automation, mechatronics, or a related technical field; equivalent technical experience may be considered.
  • 8+ years of experience installing, commissioning, troubleshooting, or maintaining low voltage AC drive systems in industrial environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of variable frequency drives, motors, power electronics, control wiring, industrial networks, and electrical troubleshooting.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, control schematics, wiring diagrams, mechanical layouts, and technical manuals.
  • Comfort working independently at customer sites while managing priorities, documentation, and customer communication.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, organization, and customer service skills.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to meet customer site access requirements.
  • Proficient in English both written and verbal
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship
  • Travel: Ability to travel frequently, including short-notice assignments, overnight travel, overtime, weekends, and emergency service support when required up to 70% or more of the time.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Siemens SINAMICS drives, STARTER, Startdrive, TIA Portal, PLCs, HMIs, and industrial communication networks is strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with SINAMICS G120, G130, G150, S120, DCM, SIMOVERT Master drives, and similar industrial drive systems.
  • Experience supporting drive applications such as pumps, fans, compressors, conveyors, cranes, mills, extruders, and process equipment.
  • Knowledge of preventive maintenance practices, insulation testing, parameter backup/restoration, firmware updates, drive replacement, and system recommissioning.
  • Experience with PLC integration, PROFIBUS, PROFINET, Ethernet/IP, Modbus, or other industrial networks.
  • Familiarity with OSHA, NFPA 70E, lockout/tagout, and customer site safety practices.

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.

We value your unique identity and perspective. jobs.title: Consulting Factory Automation Field Service Engineer
jobs.description_html:
Consulting Factory Automation Field Service Engineer

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us!

This role is designed for a remote work environment and requires frequent travel throughout the assigned territory. Candidates must be able to travel extensively and should live within convenient access to a major airport.

Siemens Industry Inc. is seeking an experienced, customer-focused Consulting Factory Automation Field Service Engineer to join our Services Execution Division.

We are looking for a Consulting Factory Automation Field Service Engineer. This home-office-based position reports to the Operations Manager, Factory Automation Field Service, and requires approximately 50-75% travel.

In this critical role, you will provide advanced technical support, engineering, troubleshooting, product expertise, and commissioning services for Siemens factory automation equipment and systems. You will support customers both on-site and remotely and serve as a key technical resource, particularly during complex and high-pressure situations.

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Providing expert second- and third-level technical and operational support for complex Siemens factory automation equipment and systems, including diagnosing and resolving issues that may not be covered by standard procedures.
  • Guiding and performing the installation, configuration, commissioning, and integration of Siemens automation hardware and software at customer sites.
  • Engaging directly with customers through active listening, clear communication, and structured problem-solving, while remaining composed and effective during demanding situations.
  • Conducting scheduled and emergency field service support, completing software version updates, and providing ongoing maintenance and troubleshooting assistance.
  • Integrating computer hardware and software components within automation systems.
  • Supporting project teams with startup and commissioning activities, including managing subcontractors and monitoring delivery when needed.
  • Implementing requested system changes using programming languages and methods that include LAD, FBD, GRAPH, SCL, and STL.
  • Guiding customers in maintaining and adjusting complex equipment and reviewing task plans, drawings, and installation schematics throughout task execution.
  • Following safe job practices, including completing daily safety briefs before work begins, and developing detailed daily field reports that document job activities.
  • Assisting with customer proposal planning by estimating labor hours, materials, travel expenses, and per diem costs.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, OR equivalent experience in industrial controls or another relevant technical discipline.
  • 10-15 years of successful experience in factory automation field service or an engineering/maintenance similar role.
  • At least 10 years of hands-on experience with Siemens factory automation equipment and software, listed below.
  • Proficiency with S7-Classic and TIA Portal software.
  • Experience with Profibus, PROFINET, wireless communication, and OPC UA protocols.
  • Strong knowledge of programmable logic controllers, advanced control systems, coordinated drive systems, and automation principles and concepts.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues, communicate effectively with customers, listen actively, and remain composed under pressure.
  • Proficient in English both written and verbal.
  • Authorized to work in the United States without corporate sponsorship now or in the future.
  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50-75% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with SIMOTION.
  • Knowledge of Siemens S7-1500T technology controllers and technology blocks.
  • Experience providing customer training.
  • Experience with Siemens SINAMICS drives.

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

Protecting the environment, conserving our natural resources, fostering the health and performance of our people as well as safeguarding their working conditions are core to our social and business commitment at Siemens. They are an integral part of our Business Conduct Guidelines and our corporate strategy.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer - Power Control Equipment - Orlando
jobs.description_html:
At Russelectric®️, a Siemens business, we are dedicated to designing and building custom power control systems and equipment that meet the stringent performance and reliability requirements of critical facilities such as Data Centers, Telecommunications, and healthcare. Founded in 1955 by Raymond G. Russell, Russelectric®️ has grown into one of the world's most respected manufacturers of automatic transfer switches and power control systems. 

As part of Siemens, a global leader in technology and innovation, we continue to uphold Raymond Russell's legacy of excellence and reliability. Together, we are committed to advancing the future of power control solutions, ensuring that our customers receive the highest quality products and services.


We are looking for Field Service Engineer to support critical power facilities. This positions will be based out of the Orlando, FL area. 

This position requires a qualified, hands-on, service-oriented technician to be involved with automatic transfer switch startups, modifications, warranty and emergency calls. Applicant should show desire to learn and advance to the Field Service Engineer level.

You will make an impact with the following skills and experience:

  • Applicant must carry a cell phone and be on call 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
  • Focus on work related to automatic transfer switches
  • Provide technical support of field startups (standard and non-standard systems), warranty efforts, remedial repairs, and preventative maintenance contracts
  • Supervising and ensuring compliance with all safety policies, procedures, guidelines and laws
  • Conduct client communication in a highly customer service-oriented manner and potentially expand the scope of project work as well as negotiate any extra charges associated with work performed
  • All work and decisions shall be conducted in strict compliance of all regulatory laws
  • Travel requirements: Up to 80% travel

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma / GED
  • 3+ years experience with the following:
    • Field Service Engineering
    • Electrical power including low voltage through medium voltage switchgear in support of critical power facilities (IE data centers, airports, etc…)
    • Experience with most types of automatic transfer switch testing
    • Reading schematics and blueprints for power control, automation and customer technical support
    • Familiarity with all applicable codes and industry standards
    • Proficient in taking care of client interactions and completing projects on time and within budget guidelines
    • Strong project management skills with excellent decision making, organization and management capabilities
    • Must be self-directed and very committed to customer satisfaction
  • Individuals must possess a valid Driver's license in good standing
  • Must be authorized to work in the US for any employer without sponsorship now or in the future

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of field service within the power distribution/ protection industry
  • Associate or bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering
  • Excellent customer service, time management and follow-up skills
  • Power distribution, DC/AC, Voltage Circuit Theory and practical troubleshooting skills

#LI-CY1 #FieldServiceCareers #OhioJobs

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager - Batteries (TAM)
jobs.description_html:
Technical Account Manager for Batteries

At Siemens Digital Industries, we help battery manufacturers, equipment builders, and energy-storage companies accelerate industrialization through automation, electrification, software, and data-driven innovation.

We are looking for a Technical Account Manager for the Battery Vertical to serve as a trusted technical advisor to strategic customers across the battery value chain. This role combines battery-industry knowledge, technical leadership, strategic customer engagement, and cross-functional orchestration to connect customer priorities with Siemens capabilities.

This remote position can be based anywhere in the eastern or central time zones.

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Serving as the primary strategic technical contact for assigned battery accounts, building trusted relationships with technical, operational, and executive stakeholders.
  • Partnering with Account Managers to develop account-specific technical strategies, roadmaps, and opportunity plans across the battery value chain.
  • Leading technical workshops and executive discussions that translate customer manufacturing priorities into clear Siemens solution directions.
  • Shaping integrated solution approaches using Siemens automation, industrial software, motion, drives, power, data, and digitalization capabilities.
  • Coordinating technical experts and delivery teams so Siemens appears to the customer as one aligned, outcome-focused team.

You’ll win us over by having:

  • A bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Manufacturing, Industrial Technology, or a related technical discipline.
  • 8+ years experience in industrial automation, manufacturing, digitalization, industrial software, battery, energy storage, or a related industry.
  • Experience engaging customers at technical and executive levels and translating business challenges into technical strategies.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, presentation, stakeholder-management, and matrix leadership skills.
  • Knowledge of battery-cell manufacturing, battery materials, module and pack assembly, recycling, equipment builders, or battery energy storage systems.
  • Familiarity with automation systems, industrial networks, motion and drives, MES, digital twins, simulation, data analytics, AI, or industrial cybersecurity.

At Siemens, you will help shape the future of battery manufacturing and energy storage in a collaborative environment that values technical expertise, customer impact, inclusion, innovation, and professional growth.

jobs.title: Building Automation Service Sales Intern
jobs.description_html:
Smart Buildings Automation Service Sales Internship 

Location:  Hiring TWO Interns 

(1) Miami area office, located in Miramar, FL

(1) Orlando area office, located in Winter Park, FL

Undergraduate: Rising Sophomore or Junior


Duration: 10 weeks
Start Dates: May 17, May 24, June 7, or June 14, 2027
Hours: Full-time, 40 hours/week

 

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?  

Who designs your future?  You do. 

Are you looking for an internship where you can showcase your technical aptitude and passion for problem solving to ensure customers can work in a comfortable, safe, and energy-efficient environment? Does gaining hands-on experience, real-world skills and valuable knowledge while developing yourself professionally sound exciting to you? 

Join our Siemens Smart Buildings Internship Program as a Building Automation Service Sales Intern in Summer 2027!


How long is the Building Automation Service Sales Internship and when can I start?

This internship is a 10-week program where you will rotate through various departments at your local branch office, focusing all on smart buildings and sustainable infrastructure.  Internship Program Start Dates: May 17, May 24, June 7 or June 14, 2027.

What is Building Automation?

Siemens Building Automation Systems is a building management system (BMS) that automatically manages and controls all systems within a building. These systems include lighting, heating, cooling, ventilation, fire detection and notification, CCTV, door and window controls, water and waste management. It consists of sensors, controllers, software and communication devices. Siemens offers building automation systems for all building types and sizes, and for every use. The system is designed to manage a wide range of building systems, such as HVAC, lighting, security, fire safety, and other critical building functions.

Click HERE to learn more about Siemens’ Building Automation and Control Systems.

What is Building Automation Service Sales?

The Building Automation Service Sales Team is committed to supporting our Service Agreements business within our commercial Smart Buildings Automation Controls Service team.   This Sales Team supports our Building Automation Operations Team whose focus is to perform automation service and maintenance in large commercial buildings such as hospitals, universities, and industrial facilities. Our Sales Executives are ambassadors of quality Siemens technology, products and services. 


What will I do as a Building Automation Service Sales Intern?

  • Work alongside Sales Managers and Sales Executives within the local branch office.
  • Assist the sales team with lead generation, prospecting, and account outreach.
  • Support the preparation of sales presentations, proposals, and reports.
  • Help manage CRM data by tracking leads and maintaining data accuracy.
  • Shadow sales calls and meetings to learn effective sales techniques.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (operations, other business units, departments, etc.) to support customer engagement
  • Analyze sales performance data and provide insights into driving growth.
  • Participate in team meetings and contribute creative ideas for improving sales processes.
  • Participate in sales related activities (learning how to prospect, go-to-market, build B2B relationships, on-the-job training and shadowing, etc.)

·       Rotate through our core business segments, which include Building Automation, Fire/Life Safety, Security and Energy/Sustainability Systems. 

 

What will my responsibilities be as a Building Automation Service Sales Intern?

  • Position Siemens as an industry leader among service providers, leveraging Siemens world-class digital service delivery as a key differentiator. 
  • Collaborate with operations and internal teams to deliver excellent customer outcomes. 
  • Help prospect for new customers and engage with existing customers on new offerings. 
  • Visit customer sites with both Solutions and Services Sales Teams. 
  • Develop value-based proposals, estimates, specifications, and presentations.
  • Work with operations, finance, legal and other inside and outside resources to obtain the sale. 
  • Attend job take-offs and turnover meetings. 
  • Actively participate in sales department meetings, workshops, and seminars to stay knowledgeable on current market, business, and product trends. 

The goal of this internship program is to develop future talent for the Siemens organization and help you identify where you may be interested in pursuing a career at Siemens post-graduation. 

To apply for the Building Automation Service Sales Internship, candidates must meet the following requirements:

  • Education: Must be current enrollment as an undergraduate at an accredited 4-year U.S. college or university.
  • Majors: Pursing a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Energy/Sustainability, Built Environment, Construction Management or Business Administration, Sales/Marketing with a strong technical engineering aptitude. 
  • Preferred: Participation in a school sponsored sales engineering club/organization, pursuing a professional sales certificate or similar.
  • Availability:  Ability to work 40-hours per week for the 10-week program (May - July or June - August).
  • Relocation: No relocation assistance or housing stipend is provided.  Must be willing and able to work at the branch office location and surrounding local area. 
  • Work Authorization:  Must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company or school sponsorship.  This program does not support students on a Visa such as F1, J1, M1 and H1B as well as OPT/CPT.

Benefits:

The hourly pay range for this position is $24 - $28 per hour, based off of your projected graduation year.  The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.  Additionally, interns for Siemens are eligible to contribute into our 401K program. 

 #LI-ARS #NSSE26 #URDP



You’ll Benefit From
The hourly pay range for this position is 24 per hour for first time Interns or 28 per hour for returning Interns. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location. Additionally, interns for Siemens are eligible to contribute into our 401K program.

jobs.title: Technical Marketing Engineer Advanced IC Packaging
jobs.description_html:
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

Position Summary

The Technical Marketing Engineer is responsible for driving technical marketing and solution development for EBS-centered offerings in the area of Advanced IC Packaging, with particular focus on 2.5D and 3DIC design flows.

This role requires the ability to understand customer challenges and use cases, and to translate them into solution-oriented workflows by connecting planning, layout, and verification tools using scripting technologies such as Tcl and Python. The ideal candidate will be able to engage customers in technical discussions, articulate solution value, and help shape future workflow directions, including emerging approaches that may involve agent-based technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and deliver technical marketing materials such as videos, presentations, and lab/demo content for Advanced IC Packaging solutions.
  • Build and demonstrate solution workflows for 2.5D and 3DIC design by connecting multiple tools, including planning, layout, and verification tools, using Tcl and Python.
  • Engage customers in technical discussions to understand design challenges, workflow gaps, and use-case requirements.
  • Translate customer technical requirements and related business needs into actionable input for development teams.
  • Understand newly developed products and enhancement features, and communicate their technical value and applicability to customers.
  • Support the definition and evolution of solution concepts that address current and future customer workflows.
  • Collaborate with internal teams across product, development, and field organizations to align solutions with market needs.

Accountability / Expected Contributions

  • Understand the goals of each assigned project and the role expected within that project.
  • Proactively drive assigned responsibilities to support successful project execution and achievement of business objectives.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and contribute effectively in project-based activities.
  • Help identify and shape future solution opportunities based on customer engagement and market direction.

Required Qualifications

  • Native or near-native proficiency in English.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in 2.5D / 3DIC design, Advanced IC Packaging, or technically supporting such flows from an EDA perspective.
  • Strong understanding of design workflows spanning planning, layout, and verification.
  • Practical scripting experience using Tcl and Python to automate or integrate workflows across multiple tools.
  • Ability to engage directly with customers in technical discussions and help define solution use cases.
  • Ability to use Linux as an end user in a business or technical environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office products for business use.
  • Formal academic background in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related technical field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in technical marketing, application engineering, solution engineering, or other customer-facing technical roles.
  • Experience creating technical demonstrations, proof-of-concept workflows, or presentation materials.
  • Familiarity with EDA solution positioning for semiconductor or packaging design customers.
  • Interest in emerging workflow technologies, including AI- or agent-assisted solution approaches.

Travel Requirements

  • Customer visits are required.
  • Domestic travel will be the primary travel requirement.
  • International travel may also be required occasionally.

Work Environment / Additional Considerations

  • This role requires collaboration with teams in Asia and Europe.
  • As a result, work may occasionally take place during early morning or evening hours to accommodate global collaboration.

This position will be subject to U.S. export control requirements under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or Export Administration Regulations (EAR).  Employment is contingent on either verifying the U.S. Person status or obtaining any necessary export license.  

Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday with Us

#LI-HYBRID

jobs.title: Customer Solution Architect, Semiconductor, Data Center, and Electronics, Sales Acceleration
jobs.description_html:
Customer Solution Architect, Semiconductor, Data Center, and Electronics, Sales Acceleration

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people ﬁrst. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? 

As a Customer Solution Architect within Sales Acceleration, you will be closely integrated and instrumental to the Semiconductor, Data Center, and Electronics vertical sales team. Reporting to the Manager of Sales Acceleration for these industries, you will serve as a key individual contributor and strategic partner to the sales organization.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with account managers across a select set of industries to drive adoption of the Siemens Digital Industries (DI) portfolio, with a strong focus on automation and digitalization solutions. By applying the Digital Thread methodology and leveraging the Challenger Sales Approach, you will help differentiate Siemens’ offerings, accelerate the sales cycle, and maximize solution and product revenue.

You will translate customer challenges and business insights into effective, cost-efficient solutions aligned with the Siemens Sales Engagement Model. Acting as a trusted advisor to both customers and vertical sales teams, you will deliver measurable outcomes that support customer success while advancing Siemens’ strategic objectives.

This position is remote and can be located anywhere in the continental US.

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Opportunity Advancement: Facilitate customer vision, discovery, and solution scoping activities to align stakeholders around business outcomes, define technical and commercial requirements, and shape solutions to meet customer needs. Translate complex challenges into actionable requirements and deliver innovative automation and digitalization solutions that support scalable, future‑ready operations.
  • Trusted Advisory: Serve as the primary technical and strategic advisor to customers and aligned salespeople, guiding them through the adoption of Siemens’ advanced Digital Industries technologies and solutions.
  • Driving Sales Engagement: Independently apply and drive the Siemens Sales Engagement Model, engaging with the appropriate resources across active opportunities to accelerate deal progression and achieve sales acceleration objectives.
  • Strategic Implementation: Execute sales acceleration strategies, policies, and guidelines, ensuring alignment with overall Sales Acceleration organization objectives.
  • Industry & Customer Expertise: Monitor emerging trends and evolving customer priorities within assigned focus industries to proactively shape solution strategies and identify opportunities to apply the Siemens Digital Industries Automation portfolio to customer challenges.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Foster strong collaboration with Sales teams, Marketing & Communication, Product Management, and other internal stakeholders to ensure seamless value delivery and maximize market opportunities.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualiﬁcations:

Basic Qualiﬁcations:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
  • 8+ years of proven experience in a technical sales, solution consulting, application engineering, or similar individual contributor role within industrial automation or digitalization
  • Proven ability to engage customers effectively through strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with a demonstrated customer‑centric approach.
  • Understanding of Siemens Industrial Automation and Digitalization Portfolio, with a proven track record of applying these technologies (or similar) to solve complex customer problems
  • Knowledge of key market drivers, trends, and evolving customer needs, particularly in the context of digital transformation
  • Experience operating within structured sales processes and diverse project collaboration models 
  • Excellent verbal, written and time management skills
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50%
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States permanently, without company sponsorship now or in the future

Preferred Qualiﬁcations:

  • 10+ years of proven experience in a technical sales, solution consulting, application engineering, or similar individual contributor role within industrial automation or digitalization
  • Experience working directly with end customers in the Semiconductor, Data Center, and Electronics industries
  • Technical expertise within Siemens Industrial Automation and Digitalization Portfolio 
  • Prior experience in developing and deploying customer-facing solutions across multiple channels to market
  • Strategic Agility: Ability to foresee future trends in focus markets related to industrial automation and digitalization, contributing to competitive and breakthrough strategies and plans, and influencing outcomes without direct authority
  • Business Acumen: Deep understanding of business operations and market dynamics, with knowledge of current and future practices, trends, and information impacting the industrial business landscape
  • High Degree of Professional Ownership: Demonstrate strong personal accountability and take initiative to drive projects to completion, even in large, complex working groups
  • Organizational Agility: Knows how to get things done through formal and informal networks. Works effectively in a matrix structure to exploit opportunities. Rallies the team behind the right opportunities and initiatives
  • Exceptional Customer Focus: A dedication to understanding and meeting customer needs, leveraging insights to drive continuous improvement in products, solutions, and services
  • Proven ability to work autonomously and thrive in a remote, virtual work environment

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs

jobs.title: Traveling Building Automation Systems Specialist
jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role supports our Pittsburgh, PA branch which primarily serves customers throughout the greater Pittsburgh area and surrounding locations within multi-state territory.

Up to 75% overnight travel (business expenses during travel covered by employer). 

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?   

 

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives. 

Transform the everyday with us!

  
The Building Automation Systems Specialist handles the centralized control of a building's heating, ventilation, air conditioning, lighting, and other systems through a building management system or building automation system (BAS).The objectives of building automation are improved occupant comfort, efficient operation of building systems, reduction in energy consumption and operating costs, and improved life cycle of utilities. 


As a Building Automation Systems Specialist, you will: 

  • Assist with building automation system startup, ensuring that all systems and components are designed, installed, tested, operated, and maintained according to the operational requirements of the customer. 
  • Work well with others, take ownership, be a team player, and act with integrity. This position reports to the local Supervisor and takes direction from a mentor and Lead Technician. 
  • Assist with commissioning new Distributed Digital Control System on construction sites. Commissioning is ensuring all systems and components are functioning as required.
  • Document commissioning details; communicate deficiencies and progress.
  • Plan work with mentor, Lead Technician, and Team Leader.
  • Complete commissioning within planned timelines.
  • Submit accurate time-keeping daily and expenses weekly.
  • Work overtime when needed.
  • Able to accommodate in an out of state overnight travel

 

You will make in impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Electro-mechanical experience (wither from a previous role or through education) and user PC/software skills
  • 1+ year of experience with Building Automation systems
  • Must be able to demonstrate the ability to read and understand design and construction documents
  • Must be willing and able to work in a variety of circumstances, including climbing ladders, scaffolds, and high lift equipment, working in ducts, crawl spaces, roofs, basements, above ceilings, and in outside/inside/heat/cold/day/night conditions
  • Must be able to demonstrate the ability and willingness to differentiate types/colors of wire, use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet and the ability to carry and move equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
  • Must be willing and able to work in a team environment providing dedicated support to our customers
  • Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and Outlook)
  • Verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED; Associate degree in electronics or related field

The Security Systems Senior Sales Executive is committed to supporting our new construction business within our commercial Security Systems team.  Our Service/Solutions Security Sales team will achieve booking and profit goals by developing and implementing plans to grow, develop, and manage contractor, consultant, developer, and end-user relationships; capitalize on sales opportunities within the territory; and effectively execute sophisticated deals independently within our established guidelines.  Our Sales Executives are ambassadors of quality Siemens technology, products and services, and your expertise and regular interaction with the customers will help them optimize and facilitate a safe, emergency-ready workplace.

As a Security Systems Senior Sales Executive, you will:

  • Achieve new order/booking and profit goals based on your assigned quota. 
  • Develop and maintain a qualified funnel of opportunities including forecasting expected order intake. Deliver on forecasted results consistently. 
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of the marketplace, competitor offerings, customers, and decision influencers across the region, segments, and verticals within the region. Keep current on security market business and product trends. 
  • Develop a vertical market and account management plan that focuses on strategic growth. Identify new business opportunities to grow in new markets or adjacent segments and develop “go to market” strategies to drive business to the end user and the standard construction channel. 
  • Act as a consultant to multiple levels of the customer’s organization by understanding their challenges and recommending services to ensure their building systems perform as required to achieve business goals. 
  • Attend industry-specific networking events; actively participate in professional organizations such as ASHRAE, AEE or USGBC to build a network of contacts and to represent Siemens in the market. 
  • Consult with the customer and determine budgeting and investment requirements. 
  • Position Siemens as an industry leader among service providers, leveraging Siemens world-class digital service delivery as a key differentiator. 
  • Collaborate with operations and internal teams to deliver excellent customer outcomes. 
  • Work with your internal sales support to enable you to spend more time with your customers. 
  • Collaborate with sales estimators to prepare cost estimates and customer bid packages. 
  • Partner with other sales business teams to plan, target, and acquire new projects and accounts. 
  • Set pricing based on identified value of the services offered to the customer. 
  • Work with operations, finance, legal and other inside and outside resources to obtain the sale. 
  • Actively participate in sales department meetings, workshops, and seminars to stay knowledgeable on current market, business, and product trends. 
  • Expected to spend minimum 50% of time in customer facing activities, performed in person and on customer site.  
  • Work with existing customer base supporting their needs as well as act as a hunter to bring in new customers to the business.  
  • Travel overnight ~10% for training and business development as required based on your assigned territory.  

 

You will make an impact with these qualifications: 

Basic Qualifications:  


  • High School Diploma or state-recognized GED 
  • 3+ years of sales experience in commercial security systems OR 2+ years of sales experience plus 3+ years of hands-on technical experience with commercial security systems, including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, or related low-voltage technologies
  • Must be able to demonstrate financial expertise; estimating and selling technical solutions and service offerings effectively and independently
  • On-the-job experience in account development and strategic sales skills  
  • Verbal and written communication skills in English 
  • Must be able to demonstrate organizational, presentation, and negotiation skills  
  • Experience with Microsoft Office suite   
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business or Engineering 
  • Salesforce CRM  
  • Software, IoT, and networking experience 
  • Demonstrable understanding of how to market, position, and sell cloud-based, data-driven service programs to existing and new customers

jobs.title: 3D-IC Application Engineer
jobs.description_html:
As an Applications engineer with Siemens EDA Technology Solutions Sales, you will support consultative sales efforts at the world’s leading semiconductor and electronic equipment manufacturers.


As an Applications Engineer at Siemens EDA, your primary responsibility is to secure technical design wins for Siemens EDA's product and service offerings. Specifically, you will be responsible for technical wins with the industry leading solutions Innovator 3D IC Layout,  Innovator3D IC Integrator, Xpedition, Calibre, HyperLynx, and other product families. Responsible activities will include delivery of technical presentations, conducting product demonstrations and benchmarks, and participation in development of solutions and account strategies leading to market share gains for Siemens.  This position is also expected to help architect and prototype Siemens EDA’s emerging 3DIC solution through the development of flows and integration scripts to link tools into a solution.


Your territory coverage consists of Key Accounts located throughout the US.  You will be responsible for integrating with peers located all over the world, communicating essential status to a variety of stakeholders and influential customers.  International travel may be required.

Job Qualifications

MSEE/BSEE with 4+ years design experience. Significant experience in advanced IC Package layout design and/or interposer layout design. Experience with IC design is a plus.  Necessary technical skills include satisfying many of these areas:

  • Knowledge of IC Package Design (Cadence APD/SiP, Siemens Xpedition/i3DL) is required.
  • Practical experience with Package design tools from design setup (stackup/constraints/etc), to implementation (routing/outgassing/re-use/etc), through generation of manufacturing documents is required.
  • Familiarity with Package / Interposer planning solutions (Siemens XSI/i3DI, Cadence OrbitIO/ISP, Synopsys 3DIC Compiler, Excel) is preferred.
  • Familiarity with 2.5D and 3D chiplet-based design solutions (TSMC InFO, CoWoS, Intel EMIB, Foveros, ASE FoCUS, Amkor SWIFT, Samsung I/H/X-Cube, etc.) is preferred.
  • Knowledge of IC data formats (Verilog, LEF/DEF, GDS, OASIS, etc.) is desired.
  • Familiarity with signal/power integrity tools (HyperLynx, Sigrity, SIWave, ADS, etc) and analysis flows is preferred
  • Experience with Siemens Calibre DRC, LVS, and/or 3DSTACK solutions is highly desirable.
  • Above average competency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Scripting/Programming: VBS, Python, Tcl, Perl, or similar languages.
  • Working OS knowledge of Windows and Linux.
  • Prior experience as an Applications Engineer is preferred.

The ideal candidate will:

  • Possess a passion to learn and perform at the cutting edge of technology.
  • Have a desire to broaden exposure to the business aspects of the technical design world.
  • Enjoy contributing to the success of a great team.
  • Be able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Effectively influence people at any level.
  • Enjoy helping and motivating others to be successful.
  • Demonstrated ability to build strong rapport and credibility with customer organizations while maintaining a company internal network of contacts.
  • Be willing to travel domestically and internationally.

Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday with Us

#LI-HYBRID

The pay range for this position is 125,300 - 250,600 annually with a target incentive of 20 of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role supports our Miramar, FL branch location, which serves customers throughout the greater Miami, FL area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We're improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation. We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That's why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn't just about improving buildings; it's about creating perfect places that improve people's lives.

Transform the everyday with us!


The Senior Project Manager position requires the coordination and delivery of multiple, simultaneous projects considered small to medium in complexity with financial impact between $250K and $7M. The Project Manager has fiscal responsibility for all project facets, including project billing, job cost reporting, and overall customer satisfaction.


As a Senior Project Manager, you will:

  • Facilitate the execution of project/program solution plan for clearly defined sub-projects or sub-programs.
  • Be responsible for delivery of results for the respective process steps. 
  • Guide technical or administrative staff.
  • Act as a functional process resource on projects or programs.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement plan. 
  • Perform active role in maintaining functionally focused client relationships.
  • Be responsible for several projects of varying size. 
  • Obtain PM@Siemens certification for C Projects ($2.5M).
  • Review project specifications, drawings and project-specific documents to establish project intent.
  • Develop and maintain a project schedule and coordinates needs with the project team. Identify time-sensitive installation needs.
  • Manage the requisition of supplies and materials to complete projects. 
  • Review plans and specifications and participate in project cost reviews.
  • Assist Operations Manager in the solicitation and contracting of subcontractors.
  • Conduct an orientation for project technicians and provide project documentation, including scope of work, drawings, applicable specifications, application-engineered drawings, project contacts, etc. 
  • Track resources and project progress. 
  • Document project events that impact the schedule, scope of work, and project efficiency.
  • Pursue project-specific change-order opportunities. 
  • Coordinate and pursue project-specific billing; coordinate with Accounting team and Operations Manager. 
  • Schedule project-specific commissioning resources and provide commissioning documentation. 
  • Expedite the return of project-specific mark-ups for as-built development. 
  • Complete project-specific close-out documentation.
  • Effectively manage and coordinate subcontractors to meet scope, scheduling, and financial requirements.
  • Adhere to local, corporate, and OSHA safety policies and procedures; report unsafe conditions and actions.


You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Must be able to demonstrate ability to work in a team environment providing dedicated support to our customers
  • Experience with Microsoft Office and Microsoft Project 
  • Verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Technical experience in the HVAC controls industry
  • 3+ years of experience managing projects
  • Knowledge and understanding of HVAC industry applications; ability to read and understand MEP drawings and specifications, and electrical, network, and control wiring diagrams
  • Knowledge of industry-standard communication protocols such as Ethernet, Modbus, and BACnet
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate or Bachelor of Mechanical or Electrical Engineering degree 
  • 5 + years of technical experience in the HVAC controls industry

jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role supports our Winter Park, FL branch location, which serves customers throughout the greater Orlando, FL area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?  

 

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.  

Transform the everyday with us!


Our Lead Systems Specialists perform complex installation, startup, and commissioning of building automation system equipment that has been newly installed. Completes verification of complex system database and programming operations, ensuring consistency with the scope of work and sequence of operations. Diagnoses and repairs complex control system malfunctions and acts as a mentor to lower-level positions. Our Lead Systems Specialists are the face of Siemens, and your expertise and regular interaction with the customer will help them save energy and money, as well as create a more sustainable future for our environment.     


As a Lead Systems Specialist, you will:  

  • Commission new distributed digital control systems on construction sites within planned timelines Documents commissioning details; communicate deficiencies and progress
  • Act as the Lead Technician and plans work with Team Leader 
  • Support the Project Manager by attending job site coordination meetings and verifying installation progress
  • Network technologies: Perform data back-up from data servers and create automated back-up procedures. Troubleshoot and resolve inconsistencies in the functions or sequence of operations. Configure PC workstations and user interfaces. Confirm proper network performance
  • Operational testing, verification, and acceptance: Run routine reports to review system operation Perform final inspection, testing and customer acceptance. Provide customer training on system operations. Complete and submit routine written reports. Provide plans and control system documents to engineering for as-built drawings
  • Project site communication and coordination: Coordinate trade contractors to perform startup services
