jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role is a hybrid position and supports anywhere in the US.  Candidate must live one hour away from a major airport and will be required to travel periodically to a project site.

 

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfectplaces that improve people’s lives.   

Transform the everyday with us!


Senior Building Automation Design Engineers – PLC & Industrial Controls create advanced design solutions for complex building automation, HVAC controls, and PLC-based control systems in new and existing facilities. This role supports data centers, pharmaceutical facilities, laboratories, central utility plants, and other mission-critical environments by developing reliable control strategies, integration architectures, controls drawings, design documentation, and technical solutions that meet customer requirements, improve operational performance, and support successful project execution.

As a Senior Building Automation Design Engineer – PLC & Industrial Controls, you will:

· Controls Design & Engineering Leadership

Lead the design of building automation and PLC-based control solutions for data centers, pharmaceutical facilities, laboratories, central utility plants, and other critical environments. Translate project requirements, contract documents, and customer standards into complete control system design packages, including drawings, panel layouts, I/O lists, network architecture, bills of materials, sequences of operation, and commissioning documentation.

· Building Automation & PLC Control Strategies

Demonstrate expertise in engineering, contracting processes, and design-build project execution by designing PLC and DDC control strategies for HVAC systems, central plants, critical environments, and process systems, while ensuring compliance with submittal requirements, documentation standards, equipment safeties, alarms, interlocks, and fail-safe operational requirements.

 · System Integration & Network Architecture

Develop automation network architectures and integration solutions utilizing platforms and protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, Proﬁnet, EtherNet/IP, Siemens APOGEE, Desigo, and other enterprise-level systems.

· Technical Coordination & Project Execution

Collaborate with programmers, project managers, commissioning specialists, ﬁeld technicians, contractors, consultants, and customers to ensure designs are executable, technical issues are resolved, and project objectives are achieved.

· Engineering Review & Quality Assurance

Review plans, speciﬁcations, codes, and customer requirements while performing design reviews, quality assurance checks, technical evaluations, and risk assessments to ensure compliance and project success.

· Technical Leadership & Continuous Improvement

Serve as a senior technical resource by mentoring engineers, supporting standards development, managing design changes and re-estimates, and driving consistency and best practices across complex automation and industrial controls projects.

You will make an impact with these qualiﬁcations:

Basic Qualifications

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED.
  • 5+ years of experience in building automation, HVAC controls, industrial controls, or PLC-based control system design.
  • Proven ability to lead the design of complex automation and controls projects with minimal supervision.
  • Strong knowledge of building automation systems, HVAC controls, PLC/DDC architecture, electrical controls, and engineering best practices.
  • Proﬁciency with design and drafting tools such as AutoCAD, Visio, or similar platforms.
  • Experience developing and reviewing controls documentation, including control narratives, I/O lists, panel layouts, network diagrams, and sequences of operation. 
  • Familiarity with industrial communication protocols and system integration, including BACnet, Modbus, Proﬁnet, and EtherNet/IP.
  • Experience collaborating with programmers and automation specialists to support implementation, commissioning, and ﬁeld execution of control systems.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without sponsorship.

 


Preferred Qualifications: 


  • Associate or bachelor’s degree in engineering, engineering technology, or a related ﬁeld.
  •  7+ years of experience designing Siemens or third-party PLC-based building automation, HVAC, industrial controls, or mission-critical facility systems.
  • Knowledge of PLC programming, troubleshooting, commissioning, or design using platforms such as Siemens TIA Portal, Siemens PLCs, Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, or similar technologies.
  • Experience designing control systems for data centers, pharmaceutical facilities, laboratories, cleanrooms, central utility plants, or other critical environments.  Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, lead technical reviews, support engineering standards, and coordinate multi-discipline design teams.

    • Advocating for technology and service adoption at executive levels, supporting long-term business transformation initiatives
    • Rolling-out focus initiatives

jobs.title: Security Systems Senior Sales Executive
jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role supports our Tampa, FL branch location, which serves customers throughout the greater Tampa, FL area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives. 

Transform the everyday with us! 

 

The Security Systems Senior Sales Executive is committed to supporting our new construction business within our commercial Security Systems team.  Our Solutions Security Sales team will achieve booking and profit goals by developing and implementing plans to grow, develop, and manage contractor, consultant, developer, and end-user relationships; capitalize on sales opportunities within the territory; and effectively execute sophisticated deals independently within our established guidelines.  Our Sales Executives are ambassadors of quality Siemens technology, products and services, and your expertise and regular interaction with the customers will help them optimize and facilitate a safe, emergency-ready workplace. 

 

As a Security Systems Senior Sales Executive, you will: 

  • Achieve new order/booking and profit goals based on your assigned quota. 
  • Develop and maintain a qualified funnel of opportunities including forecasting expected order intake. Deliver on forecasted results consistently. 
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of the marketplace, competitor offerings, customers, and decision influencers across the region, segments, and verticals within the region. Keep current on security market business and product trends. 
  • Develop a vertical market and account management plan that focuses on strategic growth. Identify new business opportunities to grow in new markets or adjacent segments and develop “go to market” strategies to drive business to the end user and the standard construction channel.
  • Act as a consultant to multiple levels of the customer’s organization by understanding their challenges and recommending services to ensure their building systems perform as required to achieve business goals. 
  • Attend industry-specific networking events; actively participate in professional organizations such as ASHRAE, AEE or USGBC to build a network of contacts and to represent Siemens in the market. 
  • Consult with the customer and determine budgeting and investment requirements. 
  • Position Siemens as an industry leader among service providers, leveraging Siemens world-class digital service delivery as a key differentiator. 
  • Collaborate with operations and internal teams to deliver excellent customer outcomes. 
  • Work with your internal sales support to enable you to spend more time with your customers. 
  • Collaborate with sales estimators to prepare cost estimates and customer bid packages. 
  • Partner with other sales business teams to plan, target, and acquire new projects and accounts. 
  • Set pricing based on identified value of the services offered to the customer. 
  • Work with operations, finance, legal and other inside and outside resources to obtain the sale. 
  • Actively participate in sales department meetings, workshops, and seminars to stay knowledgeable on current market, business, and product trends. 
  • Expected to spend minimum 50% of time in customer facing activities, performed in person and on customer site.  
  • Work with existing customer base supporting their needs as well as act as a hunter to bring in new customers to the business.  
  • Travel overnight ~10% for training and business development as required based on your assigned territory.  

 

You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:  

  • High School Diploma or state-recognized GED 
  • 3+ years of sales experience in commercial security systems OR 2+ years of sales experience plus 3+ years of hands-on technical experience with commercial security systems, including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, or related low-voltage technologies
  • Must be able to demonstrate financial expertise; estimating and selling technical solutions and service offerings effectively and independently
  • On-the-job experience in account development and strategic sales skills  
  • Verbal and written communication skills in English 
  • Must be able to demonstrate organizational, presentation, and negotiation skills  
  • Experience with Microsoft Office suite   
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business or Engineering 
  • Salesforce CRM  
  • Software, IoT, and networking experience 
  • Demonstrable understanding of how to market, position, and sell cloud-based, data-driven service programs to existing and new customers  

 

 #LI-SW1 #VeteranCareers #TransitioningServiceMember #MilitarySpouse

 

Ready to create your own journey? Join us today!

 

About Siemens

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.   

 

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce 

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.  


You’ll Benefit From

Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html

The pay range for this position is $61,547 - $105,509 annually plus an uncapped sales incentive structure. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Traveling Building Automation Systems Specialist
jobs.description_html:
THIS IS A REMOTE POSITION THAT REQUIRES 75% TRAVEL THROUGHOUT THE UNITED STATES.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.  

Transform the everyday with us!


Our Systems Specialists participate in the installation, startup, and commissioning of building automation system equipment that has been newly installed and supports the verification of the system database and programming, ensuring consistency with the scope of work and sequence of operations. Our Systems Specialists are the face of Siemens, and your expertise and regular interaction with the customer will help them save energy and money, as well as create a more sustainable future for our environment.  THIS POSITION REQUIRES 75% TRAVEL.

As a Systems Specialist, you will:  

  • Commission new distributed digital control systems on construction sites within planned timelines. Documents commissioning details; communicates deficiencies and progress
  • Plan work with Lead Technician, and Team Leader
  • Network technologies: Assists with data back-up from data servers and the creation of automated back-up procedures. Supports troubleshooting and resolution of inconsistencies in the functions or sequence of operations. Assists with the set-up and configuration of PC workstations and user interfaces
  • Support the confirmation of proper network performance
  • Operational testing, verification, and acceptance: Runs routine reports to review system operation. Participates in final inspection and testing. Supports customer acceptance. Assists with customer training on system operations
  • Complete and submit routine written reports. Provides plans and control system documents to engineering for as-built drawings
  • Project site communication and coordination: May support others in the scheduling of trade contractors to coordinate startup services. Submits accurate time and expense reports
  • Work overtime when needed (Compressed schedule performance can be a factor and will require extended hours to meet commitments)
  • Work rotational on-call and/or minimal overnight travel
  • Adhere to local, corporate, and OSHA safety policies and procedures. Ability to work in a team environment providing dedicated support to our customers


You will make an impact with these qualifications:  

Basic Qualifications:  

  • 1+ years of experience installing and servicing electronic control or HVAC equipment 
  • DDC (Direct Digital Controls) experience (either in a previous role or through education) and user PC/software skill 
  • On-the-job experience reading, understanding, and interpreting design and construction documents 
  • Ability and willingness to work in a variety of circumstances including climbing ladders, scaffolds, and high lift equipment, working in ducts, crawl spaces, roofs, basements, above ceilings, and in various conditions
  • Must be able and willing to use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet as well as carrying and moving equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
  • Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) 
  • Ability and willingness to work overtime as needed
  • Ability to travel 75% of the time
  • Must be 18 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED; Associate or Bachelor’s degree in electronics, mechanical engineering, or related

Pioneering in America, from the first mile to the last. This is what drives us.

We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® certified—a reflection of our commitment to creating an environment where innovation thrives, and every voice matters. Apply today and be part of shaping the future with us!

Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html

Position Overview:

The HVAC Service Rail Technician is a skilled field-based role responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing HVAC systems on passenger rail coaches and locomotives to ensure reliable performance and passenger comfort. Working both independently and collaboratively with engineering and maintenance teams, this position supports fleet availability, equipment reliability, and safe rail operations. As a key member of the maintenance organization, this role offers the opportunity to work on specialized rail equipment, solving complex technical challenges, and make a visible impact on customer experience

What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Troubleshoot HVAC system issues on a daily basis using diagnostic tools and equipment, including HVAC software, temperature sensors, and leak detectors.
  • Replace defective components and perform brazing of copper piping as needed
  • Vacuum and pressurize HVAC units using Nitrogen in accordance with established procedures and safety standards
  • Recover and handle refrigerants in compliance with environmental regulations

This posting outlines the primary responsibilities of the role but is not all-inclusive; additional duties may be assigned in alignment with business needs.

To thrive in this role, you have:

  • Technical education in HVAC / Refrigeration
  • EPA Universal certification
  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience performing HVAC work, including service, preventative maintenance, diagnostics, repairs, and system installations
  • Electrical troubleshooting experience
  • Flexibility to work varying shifts, including nights and weekends, based on operational needs.

Physical Demands:

  • Ability to lift at least 50 pounds
  • Ability to stand for multiple hours at a time

Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States without needing current or future employer-sponsored work authorization.

Candidates should be willing to work in non-climate-controlled environments and inclement weather if required or if applicable.

Purpose is the reason a company exists. It's not about making money or selling products - it's the deeper "why" behind everything we do. It answers the question: What problem are we solving? What positive change are we creating?

For Siemens, our purpose has been clear for over 175 years: We create technology to transform the everyday, for everyone.

The world needs technologies that work. Technologies that matter. Technologies that solve today's challenges and help shape a better tomorrow. And that's exactly what we build. By bringing together the real world (factories, buildings, power grids, trains) with the digital world (software, data, AI, digital twins), we help our customers become more competitive, resilient, and sustainable.

Our technology is everywhere - in trains and transportation, we help move people faster, safer, and more sustainably.


You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $63,771.00 - $86,149.00 annually. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Service Operations Supervisor - Building Automation Systems
jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role supports our Miramar, FL branch location, which serves customers throughout the greater Miami, FL area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrive is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?  

 

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.  

Transform the everyday with us!

 

The Building Automation Systems Service Operations Supervisor leads a team responsible for performing service work for building automation systems. The right candidate will coordinate specialist and technician activities for all installed projects, technical support programs, and time-and-materials (T&M) work to provide on-time delivery and ensure customer expectations and commitments are met.   

As a Building Automation Systems Service Operations Supervisor, you will:

  • Supervise, train, and mentor the service team; set goals, monitor performance, conduct employee review meetings, and schedule formal training. 
  • Schedule and assign tasks to the team and drive business growth by enabling and leading a highly effective team. Periodically assist the team with maintenance activities and submittal of required paperwork. 
  • Identify additional chargeable opportunities, including T&M, system upgrades, and service contract expansions and complete and submit written service orders and reports covering all aspects of each assignment and activity. 
  • Participate in sales-to-service and projects-to-service turnover process, including final project walkthroughs, service agreement scope reviews, and final information turnover to the inspection team. 
  • Support contract profitability through cost containment procedures and processes. 
  • Ensure contract requirements are met and performed to a high standard and develop customer relationships and maintain high levels of customer satisfaction while ensuring effective and timely communications. 
  • Determine technical labor loading and appropriate balance of talent to ensure proper resource coverage to meet customer needs. 
  • Champion safety compliance by ensuring employees meet or exceed organization and customer safety requirements. Ensure employees are properly trained on all safety requirements and enforce adherence to organizational processes, tools, and workflow standards.   
  • Maintain excellent organizational and interpersonal skills.


You will make an impact with these qualifications:  

Basic Qualifications:   

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED
  • 1+ years of experience as a HVAC or Building Automation specialist or technician in related industry
  • On-the-job or educational experience with HVAC or Building Automation systems 
  • Experience with Microsoft Office 
  • Verbal and written communication skills in English 
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:   

  • Associate degree from a two-year college or technical school
  • 5+ years of experience as a specialist or technician in related industry
  • Experience supervising teams 
  • Familiarity with Bluebeam or equivalent software 


Ready to create your own journey? Join us today!


About Siemens

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.  


Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us. #LI-TAG #Southeast-EREF #VeteranCareers #TransitioningServiceMember #MilitarySpouse Hvac controls, building controls, building automation, programming, field technician, heating, ventilation, air conditioning, direct digital control, apogee, desigo, modbus, tridium, Niagara, alerton, controls, commissioning, lonworks, bacnet, ddc, bau, bms, building management, mechanical systems, system integration


You’ll Benefit From

Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html

The pay range for this position is $68,830 - $117,994 annually with a target incentive of 5% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Application Sales Engineer, Power Systems & Controls
jobs.description_html:
Position Title: Application Sales Engineer

Location: TX, OK, LA, AR, GA, AL, FL (Remote)

Are you looking for a company that empowers talent?

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation!

From Day 1, you are empowered to create an impact with your full potential and creativity to make a difference for tomorrow.

We truly have an inclusive and diverse team culture where you can be yourself. Our extensive global presence offers a diverse range of career opportunities across various industries, nations, and job domains, empowering our workforce to continuously enhance their skills and stay competitive.

Create a better tomorrow with us!

The Sales Lead position at Russelectric, A Siemens Business, reports to the Head of Sales and Business Development and is responsible for developing specifications with end-users, engineers, and contractors to achieve order volume targets. The ideal candidate should be an experienced team-builder and motivator with a strong background in electrical equipment solutions and data-driven sales operations.

This role focuses on driving top-line and EBITDA growth through the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of direct sales strategies. The position requires consistent support from accounts to deliver profitable growth while maintaining high customer satisfaction levels. Working closely with product management, quotations, and project management teams, the Sales Lead will facilitate effective communication of product solutions and value propositions to ensure successful execution.

You will make an impact with the following responsibilities:

  • Lead system & product specification and solution sales activities in the territory to meet the order intake budget and other financial goals
  • Demonstrate successful execution of all customer-facing business strategies for products and services
  • Review and interpret customer needs on plans and specifications
  • Collect, analyze and utilize market intelligence regarding competitive products, customer needs, preferences and buying habits
  • Direct short-term and long-range planning and budget development to support strategic goals
  • Provides information via CRM for forecasts and planning
  • Prepares / coordinates and negotiates proposals in collaboration with other team members.
  • Coordinates the realization of assignments, may coordinate and contribute to setting up respective product developments, projects or services programs
  • Act as a point of contact with customers in commercial matters and influences collaboration within the organization to secure customer support

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in technical field.
  • 3 plus years of experience with the following:
    • Channel sales, service or client support within the electrical, critical power, data center, generator, or power distribution/protection industries.
    • Strong leadership abilities with a results-driven approach, including the skill to influence, empower, and collaborate with cross-functional teams at all organizational levels
    • Ability to read electrical schematics
    • Proficiency with Salesforce 
    • Exceptional communication skills, encompassing written, verbal, and presentation abilities, with a persuasive and credible style
    • Advanced analytical and critical thinking capabilities to drive strategic decision-making
    • Comprehensive functional and technical expertise, particularly in sales budgeting and Customer Relationship Management
    • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain effective relationships across management levels while advising and guiding interdisciplinary teams
  • Must be able to travel up to 50% within the assigned territory.
  • Must be eligible to work in the US with no sponsorship now or in the future. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior engineering experience


You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $91,463 - $156,794 annually with a target incentive of 30% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Electrical Switchgear Project Manager
jobs.description_html:
Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We empower customers by combining the real and digital worlds to improve how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation. We know a business thrives when its people are thriving, which is why we put our people first. Our global, diverse team will support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us!

The Siemens Electrification and Automation business provides power distribution systems and service solutions that help customers improve the reliability, safety, and performance of their electrical infrastructure.

We are looking for a Project Manager, Customer Services to join our Project Management Office. In this customer-facing role, you will lead service projects from initiation through final closeout while managing safety, scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, and customer expectations.

You will work across a matrixed organization and coordinate with engineering, field service, commercial, finance, vendors, contractors, and customers. This position may be performed remotely or based in Wendell, North Carolina, with travel required approximately 10% to 25% annually.

You’ll make a difference by:

  • Directing all phases of assigned service projects from initiation through completion, including project planning, execution, monitoring, closeout, and lessons learned.
  • Managing project scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety, resources, revenue forecasting, and overall performance while developing recovery plans when projects are not meeting expectations.
  • Identifying project risks, including potential safety risks, and developing mitigation strategies that support the safe and successful completion of service activities.
  • Communicating project milestones, field activities, financial status, risks, changes, and performance updates to customers, project teams, leadership, finance partners, and other stakeholders.
  • Coordinating internal and external resources, including engineering teams, field service personnel, vendors, suppliers, consultants, and contractors, to support project requirements and site schedules.
  • Managing contractual requirements, change orders, claims processes, supplier agreements, requests for quotation, and customer expectations throughout the project lifecycle.

Project and system experience may include:

  • Installation, commissioning, maintenance outage testing, electrical retrofits, and electrical system emergency response or disaster recovery.
  • Turnkey, design-build, and engineer-procure-construct projects.
  • Power system studies and field service projects involving internal teams and third-party suppliers, consultants, and contractors.
  • Low-voltage and medium-voltage air-insulated switchgear, medium-voltage gas-insulated switchgear, switches, panelboards, and automatic transfer switches.
  • Transformers, motor control centers, medium-voltage contactors, integrated electrical house systems, cable systems, busways, connectors, and supporting systems.
  • Solar photovoltaic systems, inverters, battery systems, and related electrical infrastructure.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 5+ years direct project management experience supporting service projects involving low-voltage and medium-voltage switchgear.
  • 3+ years experience working in field service operations or a field service environment, such as a field service technician, engineer, project manager, or project specialist.
  • Demonstrated experience with low-voltage and medium-voltage switchgear.
  • Ability to travel approximately 10% to 25% annually.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, construction management, or a related field.
  • Project Management Professional certification. If not currently certified, ability to obtain the certification within one year of employment.
  • Project management experience in electrical switchgear field service, engineer-procure-construct projects, construction, energy, manufacturing, or a related industrial environment.
  • Experience leading cross-functional project teams that include engineering, field service, commercial, finance, suppliers, and contractors.
  • Experience interpreting project contracts and managing change orders, claims, liquidated damages, specifications, supplier scope, schedules, and budgets.
  • Experience using Microsoft Project to develop, maintain, and communicate project schedules.

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.


You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $77,219 - $132,375 annually with a target incentive of 5-10% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Transform the everyday with us!


Our Service Specialists perform assigned tasks on building automation systems. Tasks include service agreement maintenance, projects, and on-call (time and material) service. Responds to emergency service calls as directed during regularly scheduled hours and after hours as needed. Our ServiceSpecialists are the face of Siemens, and your expertise and regular interaction with the customer will help them save energy and money, as well as create a more sustainable future for our environment.   

  

As a Service Specialist, you will:  

  • Execute digitalization and standard service operations strategies
  • Work with multiple internal service team members including Service Sales, Client Service Managers, Service Coordinators, and RAM Digital Service Center personnel
  • Follow safety requirements as outlined by Siemens and customers and successfully completes assigned training as outlined in the training path
  • Follow mandatory policies, procedures, and standards, may coordinate with contractors on job sites, maintains tools and test equipment
  • Support after hours during on-call rotation, responds to service calls (emergency and on-site) as assigned. Performs repairs as directed on all automation system types 
  • Be responsible for completing service ticket documentation per the policy, follow and maintain preventive maintenance schedules
  • Maintain complete and accurate documentation of services performed and generates reports within Siemens tools
  • Provide instructions to customer personnel regarding proper system operations and assists with training
  • Identify and reports system discrepancies, suggests system upgrade opportunities, and may assist in pricing of repairs and upgrades to existing agreement and performs system checkout and startup on projects
  • Work overtime when needed (Compressed schedule performance can be a factor and will require extended hours to meet commitments)
  • Work rotational on-call and/or minimal overnight travel
  • Participate in job site final walk and/or final completion for systems-to-service turnover on assigned jobs performs other duties as assigned


You will make an impact with these qualifications:  

Basic Qualifications:  

  • 1+ years of experience servicing electronic control or HVAC equipment 
  • Electro-mechanical experience (either in a previous role or through education) and user PC/software skill
  • Ability and willingness to work in a variety of circumstances, including climbing ladders, scaffolds, and high lift equipment, working in ducts, crawl spaces, roofs, basements, above ceilings, and in various conditions
  • Must be able and willing to use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet as well as carrying and moving equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
  • Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) 
  • Ability and willingness to work overtime when needed
  • Must be 18 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • High, school diploma or state-recognized GED 
  • Specialized skill training/certification 
  • 1+ years of experience installing and servicing electronic control or HVAC equipment
  • Knowledge of building automation systems, PLCs, HVAC, electrical concepts, and building operations 
  • Engineering and programming (PLC or BMS) background 
  • Knowledge of building system communication protocols (BACnet, Modbus, TCP/IP)

jobs.title: PLC & Industrial Controls - Sr. Programmer
jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role is remote.

 

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by 

combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.   

Transform the everyday with us!


As a Senior Building Automation Programmer – PLC & Industrial Controls create advanced programming solutions for complex building automation, HVAC controls, and PLC-based control systems in new and existing facilities. This role supports data centers, pharmaceutical facilities, laboratories, central utility plants, and other mission-critical environments by developing reliable control logic, PLC programs, system integration programming, point mapping, functional testing documentation, and technical solutions that meet customer requirements, improve operational performance, and support successful project execution.

 

As a Building Automation Programmer, you will:

  • Program large, complex, and custom projects using PLC-based programming platforms and control logic.
  • Develop and implement PLC programs using Siemens TIA Portal, including structured control logic for mission-critical building automation and industrial control applications. 
  • Design, conﬁgure, and support visualization solutions, including HMI and SCADA interfaces, to provide operators with clear system status, alarms, trends, and control information.
  • Provide post-sale assistance for programming labor estimating.
  • Test PLC programs prior to initial release for quality assurance and functional performance.
  • Create functional testing and commissioning documents utilized to validate PLC logic, system integration, and ﬁeld performance.
  • Support commissioning, start-up, optimization, error analysis, and troubleshooting of PLC-based automation systems in coordination with project teams and ﬁeld resources.
  • Document PLC software solutions, system conﬁguration, testing results, revisions, and integration requirements to support quality control and long-term maintainability.
  • Assist the Graphics Design team by coordinating dynamic point information, alarms, trends, and PLC-integrated system data into graphics.
  • Collaborate with the Design Team to identify speciﬁcation discrepancies, coordinate PLC integration requirements, and request clariﬁcation as needed.
  • Work both independently and in team dynamics in a remote environment.
  • Mentor, train, and provide technical assistance to other team members.
  • Travel as needed up to 25%

 

You will make an impact with these qualifications:

jobs.title: Sales and Use Tax Accountant
jobs.description_html:
Sales and Use Tax Accountant

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation. We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways.

You will be an integral part of the sales and use tax team. Major areas of responsibility include but are not limited to completing the monthly compliance cycle in a complex multi-jurisdiction environment; participating in sales and use tax audit defense, reverse audits, tax consulting, tax planning, tax accounting and special projects to achieve. You will be responsible for ensuring Siemens Operating Companies follow transactional tax and business license (taxes) requirements while achieving assigned objectives and targets.

You will report to the Indirect Tax Manager of Global Business Services (GBS) of Siemens Corp. The mission of the department is to provide comprehensive support to all represented Siemens Operating Companies for transactional taxes including Sales and Use taxes, Property taxes, Business Licenses; 1042 compliance, and annual reports. You will be an individual contributor who demonstrates leadership skills, a comprehensive knowledge and principles of sales and use taxes. This position will interface with both internal and external contacts. External contacts will include taxing authorities, vendors, and partners. 

Transform the Everyday.

In this role you will work remotely from a home office. You must be willing to work the Eastern or Central US time zones.  

Responsibilities:

  • Sales tax and other related indirect tax compliance activities
  • Timely submission of sales tax compliance data to partners to meet filing requirements.
  • Complete sales tax compliance activities to ensure Global Business Services complies with SOC service level agreements.
  • Complete the filing of refund claims identified in the account reconciliation process.
  • Follow up on all refund claims filed and receive funds within 365 days. Provide registration and license recommendations and requirements to team members for processing to keep SOC's in compliance.
  • Participate in partner calls, partner sales tax compliance activities, complete the monthly and yearly nexus reviews.

 Tax Consulting/Strategic Planning

  • Provide the business contacts with complex multi-state and local tax advice through tax law research that will increase tax compliance with the laws and regulations of state and local taxing authorities.
  • Provide tax analysis, planning, control and reporting for the business consistent with the Siemens guidelines and requirements for contract negotiations.
  • Research, analyze and prepare multi-state business and affiliate state and local tax refund opportunities.
  • Document, comply, monitor, evaluate and update internal state and local tax policies and procedures and recommend alternatives to ensure compliance and reduce tax overspending.
  • Recommends and implement process changes that reduce potential exposure

 Tax Auditing/Reverse Audits

  • Complete the day-to-day work activities of the audit and consulting team to ensure the audit cycle is completed in a cost effective, accurate, and timely manner.
  • Identify, communicate, and conduct strategic audits/refunds to recover sales/use tax exposure amounts and overpayments
  • File and pursue refund opportunities identified in external/ internal audits and identified overpayments.

 Tax Processes and Accounting

  • Document, monitor, evaluate, and update internal desktop procedures and process maps for compliance activities
  • Recommend, drive, and follow through on compliance process improvements to increase efficiencies and reduce tax exposure
  • Execute GBS SOX's review and reporting requirements
  • Timely and accurately prepare account reconciliations for assigned sales and use tax accounts
  • Timely complete monthly compliance metrics

 Projects

  • Actively contribute and participate in assigned departmental goals and objectives to meet Siemen’s balance scorecard for assigned targets for financial, customer, process and employee targets.
  • Participate in sales and business licenses tax compliance segment of migrations for new SOC migrations by following established project plans. Sample task can include: Establishing tax filing calendars, verifying data sources, reviewing parallel tax returns, verifying and ICC payment methods and vendors. 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance. Equivalent experience with other education will be considered
  • 2+ years of sales & use tax compliance and audit experience
  • Ability to perform sales & use tax analysis, and provide consulting around practices and procedures with internal and external customers
  • Experience with multi-state sales & use tax compliance activities
  • Ability to operate in multiple ERP systems (i.e. SAP)
  • Advanced knowledge in Excel, Word, Outlook, and Power Point
  • Proficient in English both written and verbal
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ability to engage in open, honest collaboration with team members
  • Assumes ownership and execution of individual responsibilities and strict deadlines
  • Ability to multi-task multiple projects and have strong attention to detail

jobs.description_html:
Customer Solution Architecture – Consulting Engineer

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

We are seeking an experienced engineering contributor for a team of talented technology architects and supported sales teams focused on the deployment and support of full stack Siemens hardware and software technologies in complex machine building applications, including CNC lathes, mills, presses, robotics, 3D Printing, and novel multi-axis systems. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background, exceptional teaming skills, a passion for innovation in the industrial and manufacturing fields as well as empathy for the customer.

Transform the everyday with us!

We are looking for Consulting Engineer This position will be remote based serving the continental US.

  • Technology Deployment and Support
  • Ensure the successful implementation and integration of Sinumerik and Siemens PLC technology in customer operations.
  • Develop and deliver hands-on training programs and workshops to educate customers on the effective use of Sinumerik technology.
  • Provide ongoing mentoring and support to adjacent engineering teams, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Collaborate with customers to understand their specific use cases and offer tailored solutions that enhance operational efficiency.
  • Stay updated on the latest advancements in Sinumerik and adjacent Siemens technology and its components, including motors, drives, numeric controllers, power management devices, and software for CAD, CAM, PLM, and MES.
  • Enablement Functions
  • Work in mixed compute environments to work on multiple VMs for technology demonstrators
  • Provide expertise in API integration for RESTFUL APIs and MQTT messaging integrating onto 802.11 defined network objects
  • Create and curate a comprehensive library of knowledge base articles to empower customers and reduce the need for direct support.
  • Provide use case and training data input to AI development teams to assist in relevant AI enabled technology roll outs
  • Leverage internal support products (e.g., XCare, Machine Care) to streamline support efforts, enabling the team to focus more on customer enablement and less on reactive support.
  • Team Leadership and Development
  • Contribute to, mentor, and inspire a diverse team of engineers, ensuring you and they are equipped with the skills and knowledge to excel in their roles as leading edge implementation in robotics and industrial automation.
  • Foster an inclusive and collaborative team environment that encourages innovation and problem-solving.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and conduct regular performance reviews, providing constructive feedback and support for career development.
  • Coordinate cross-functional collaboration to enhance project delivery and technical excellence.
  • Strategic Planning and Execution
  • Develop and implement strategic initiatives to drive the adoption of Sinumerik and related technology across various industries.
  • Collaborate with product management and sales teams to align engineering efforts with business goals and customer needs.
  • Analyze industry trends and competitor offerings to identify opportunities for improvement and differentiation.

jobs.title: Remote Services Portfolio Program Manager
jobs.description_html:
Siemens Government Technologies (SGT) is a dynamic and rapidly growing organization, and we are seeking a self-driven individual to complement our growing team.

As part of the SGT Services organization, the Services Portfolio Program Manager (Services Program Manager) leads a services program consisting of related services projects driving customer value realization and business outcomes. 

The Services Program Manager will lead the Services strategy, opportunity development and delivery of the program through realization of customer value.  The Services Program Manager is responsible for managing the dependencies between projects, establishing and publishing clear priorities among projects and program activities, coordinating the projects effectively and establishing the required program governance model.

The Services Program Manager acts as the primary point of contact for the program and aligns Sales, Presales, Services Management and the customer to drive successful outcomes.

The Services Program Manager works under self-initiative to lead a portfolio of large size projects and complexity.

Responsibilities:
As part of the Services team, the Services Program Manager 
•Develops the SGT Services strategy, plan and pricing to deliver customers and SGT value realization 
•Leads the portfolio of deliveries to achieve the program vision and to realize business outcomes
•Together with Sales Account Management and SGT Management, sets and manages stakeholder expectations
•Together with Services Management, builds, inspires and motivate an effective team
•Ensures the team members have the resources and support to complete their tasks in a timely and high-quality manner
•Oversees the adoption of Digital Enterprise and Digital Manufacturing Solutions
•Identifies and create additional customer value opportunities within the portfolio
•Conducts stakeholder management through systematic identification, analysis and planning of actions and risk mitigations to positively influence success outcomes
•Enforce change management policies at the project level to ensure the dependencies of the change is reflected and understood on the program level
•Orchestrate program and project schedules to ensure on time delivery
•Agree to targets with the program staff and delegate defined responsibilities and authority
•Actively seek and provide feedback to and from program and project team members, managers, and customers
•Work with Services Management and Procurement to manage business partners and subcontractors
•Ensure the projects in the program deliver to the approved budget and agreed bid margin
•Measure program performance and provide the regular program forecast
•Work with Services administration and Finance to ensure accurate billing and revenue recognition for the entire program

Qualifications:
•Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical and/or Manufacturing Engineering, Computer Science, Technology, Project Management or equivalent years of experience in the Digital Industry or related field. 
•Minimum of eight (8) years in a project / program leadership position
•Experience with US Federal Government projects, contracts, policies, and procedures
•Working knowledge of the administrative functions of the Services business including project setup, contract structure, progress reporting, revenue recognition and billing

Preferred :
•Experience in implementing or familiarity with Digital Twin software, Manufacturing software, Manufacturing control systems or similar products is highly desired

Travel:
•Willing and able to travel to appropriate work locations, as required by SGT or specified by the customer program up to 50%
 
Security Clearance:
•Candidate must be a United States citizen, possess no dual citizenship or foreign ties (including foreign passports or visas), and be able to obtain a U.S. Department of Defense security clearance.



You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $167,200.00 - $188,000.00 annually with a target incentive of 10% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Services Consultant - REMOTE
jobs.description_html:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided develop, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers compose better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating an elite software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Product Architect – Customer Outcomes

Are you a highly motivated individual with a passion for the latest engineering and manufacturing software trends including Edge Computing, IOT, and cloud-based solutions? Do you have the ability to guide customers through complex digital transformations? Are you looking for a fast-paced high growth career? If so, please apply for this outstanding opportunity at Siemens Digital Industry Software!

Our Customers:

Many companies are partnering with Siemens to build their Comprehensive Digital Twin; the virtual representation that give them the capability of linking develop and virtual simulations, to physical engineering and manufacturing. These companies are in the Aerospace, Automotive, Consumer Products & Packaging, Electronics, Medical Device, and Semiconductor industries where this technology gives them a competitive advantage. These companies are selecting Siemens because we have a Comprehensive Digital Twin, available today – from concept through manufacturing into field maintenance.

Your Challenge:

Can you be a creative and independent domain specialist?

Become a member of our Customer Outcomes team as a Product Architect. As a Product Architect you will work closely with customers to provide software solutions to help them realize their Comprehensive Digital Twin. Helping our customers blur the boundaries between industry domains by integrating the virtual and physical, hardware and software, design, and manufacturing worlds.

Who we are looking for:

A strong technical contributor that will implement our software solutions for our customers. As part of our team, you will work efficiently with Consultants, Solution Architects, Project Managers, and other internal and external interfaces such as Industry and Product Development teams to ensure that the customer succeeds in their objectives. Be responsible for providing specialist product expertise by consulting, advising, recommending, designing, and where appropriate deploying, specific technical solutions for the Siemens Digital industries Software solution to be delivered optimally and provide value to the customer. Support project/program management activities to control scope, cost, schedule, and quality and in line with program and project processes and messaging, interact with the customer to support the management of customer expectations and support customer adoption.

We need you to already have:

  • Graduated collage with a degree in engineering, computer science, etc.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Teamcenter ITK development, including custom handlers, exits, and BMIDE deployments is REQUIRED
  • Previous experience with implementing enterprise PLM, ERP or MES systems
  • Minimum five years of experience implementing moderately sophisticated Teamcenter solutions or similar products, such as Enovia, ePMD, Windchill, Aras Innovator or Agile
  • Minimum five years Teamcenter experience with specific PLM solution elements such as: Authoring Functional Specifications; Defining Work Streams, Work Breakdown Structures, Scenarios and Use Cases; Data Modeling; Management of CAD Data, Documents and Change Processes; Workflow creation, testing and solving.
  • Minimum five years of experience with Software Development Lifecycles (SDLC) tools, procedures, and standards.
  • Experience using programming languages and tools such as JAVA, C++, C#, SQL, VB, XML
  • General knowledge with Microsoft Windows administration
  • Experience with Windows and/or Linux operating system, Amazon Web Services and/or Microsoft Azure, server/client communications, VPN and reverse proxies and TLS (HTTP vs HTTPS), Docker or Kubernetes, Web Servers (IIS, JBOSS, Tomcat, WebLogic), databases (Oracle, SQL, Aurora, RDS)
  • Preferred experience with Technical Publications and knowledge of S1000D or DITA standards
  • Travel: up to 25%
  • Position can be based anywhere within the continental USA
Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified Applicants will not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States. his would include H1B, TN, OPT, F1, etc

Our Benefits & Rewards

The total cash compensation range for this position is $110,900 – $221,800 with 10% of this being comprised of an annual incentive target. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/

Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

jobs.title: Customer Solution Architect - Metals Forming, Plastics, Packaging
jobs.description_html:
Customer Solution Architect - Metals, Forming, Plastics, Packaging


Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrive is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us! 

As a Customer Solution Architect, you will be a key individual contributor reporting to the Manager of Customer Solution Architects. You will play a crucial role in empowering our MACHINE BUILDER customers by driving the adoption and integration of Siemens' Digital Industries (DI) portfolio, with a strong emphasis on automation and digitalization solutions. This role focuses on maximizing sales across products and solutions for assigned MACHINE BUILDER markets nationwide. You will leverage deep insights into customer needs and sales strategies, transforming them into effective, cost-efficient solutions that align with the Siemens Sales Engagement Model. You will serve as a trusted advisor to both DI MACHINE BUILDER Sales teams and our valued MACHINE BUILDER customers, covering Metal forming, Plastics and Packaging industry

We believe our MACHINE BUILDER partners are the true architects of a better future, constantly striving to build a world that is safer, smarter, and more efficient. We are driven by the profound belief that ingenuity transforms challenges into opportunities, applying the precise solutions needed at every scale, from the smallest component to the largest system. 

Our purpose is to be their trusted advisor, fueled by our collective passion for our work and the deep partnerships we cultivate with our sales teams and customers. We empower them with comprehensive digital expertise, engaging in a continuous, collaborative challenge to envision and achieve what's next, enabling them to innovate boldly, expand their market reach, and ultimately enrich lives across every industry. 

This position will be Remote, but candidate will need to be located in the Eastern or Central time zones of the United States. 

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Driving Sales Engagement: Independently drive and apply the Siemens Sales Engagement Process within your assigned MACHINE BUILDER verticals/accounts to achieve sales acceleration targets. 
  • Strategic Implementation: Actively implement sales acceleration strategies, policies, and guidelines, ensuring alignment with overall Sales Acceleration management objectives. 
  • Market & Customer Identification: Identify key and emerging markets, and support the definition and identification of target MACHINE BUILDER customers across the Digital Industries Automation portfolio nationwide. 
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Foster strong collaboration with MACHINE BUILDER Sales teams, Marketing & Communication, Product Management in the Zone, and other internal stakeholders to ensure seamless value delivery and maximize market opportunities. 
  • Solution Development & Delivery: Translate complex customer challenges into clear, actionable requirements and work to deliver innovative automation and digitalization solutions that meet their evolving needs. 
  • Trusted Advisory: Serve as a primary technical and strategic advisor to MACHINE BUILDER customers and internal sales teams, guiding them through the adoption of Siemens' cutting-edge technologies. 

 You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:  

 Basic Qualifications: 

  • 5+ years of proven experience in a technical sales, solution consulting, application engineering, or similar individual contributor role within industrial automation or digitalization. 
  • High school diploma or equivalent GED 
  • Strong background and understanding of the MACHINE BUILDER machine builder's marketplace. 
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with end users, distributors, system integrators, solution partners, and internal sales representatives. 
  • Deep technical expertise in Siemens Industrial Automation and Digitalization Portfolio, with a proven track record of applying these technologies to solve complex customer problems. 
  • Comprehensive knowledge of industrial automation market drivers, trends, and evolving customer needs, particularly in the context of digital transformation. 
  • Exceptional customer interaction, presentation, and negotiation skills, with a strong customer-centric approach. 
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically up to 50% to support assigned nationwide verticals.

 Preferred Qualifications:  

  • Prior experience in developing and deploying customer-facing solutions across multiple channels especially in machine building industry
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. 
  • Strategic Agility: Ability to foresee future trends in industrial automation and digitalization, contributing to competitive and breakthrough strategies and plans, and influencing outcomes without direct authority. 
  • Business Acumen: Deep understanding of business operations and market dynamics, with knowledge of current and future practices, trends, and information impacting the industrial business landscape. 
  • Exceptional Customer Focus: A dedication to understanding and meeting customer needs, leveraging insights to drive continuous improvement in products, solutions, and services. 
  • High Degree of Professional Ownership: Demonstrate strong personal accountability and take initiative to drive projects to completion, even in large, complex working groups. 
  • Proven ability to work autonomously and thrive in a remote, virtual work environment. 

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

jobs.description_html:
Customer Service Project Manager – Data Centers

At Siemens, we live and foster an ownership culture, in which every employee takes personal responsibility for our company's success. We strive to transform the everyday for our customers, employees, and society by:

  • Trusting and empowering our leaders to act as owners, directing their teams, and innovating to succeed.
  • Communicating openly and honestly to learn from our failures and celebrate our successes.
  • Recognizing individual and team achievements frequently
  • Our focus on investment in our team members, offering a wide variety of internal and external development opportunities.
  • Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion

Transform the everyday with us!

About Smart Infrastructure – Electrification and Automation:

The Electrification and Automation (EA) Business Unit offers the full range of energy distribution systems and solutions for all markets and through all sales channels. We provide reliable power distribution grids of today while investing into our Future Grids portfolio and applications to create the power distribution grid of the future. Our comprehensive portfolio meets the growing technical requirements of todays and tomorrow’s power grid!

Siemens Project Management Office (PMO) is looking for a Customer Services (CS) Project Manager to join our Data Centers team. This position is remote.

Role Description:

As a CS Project Manager, you will be responsible for the successful execution of projects, from project initiation through final closeout. You will work in a matrix style organization requiring excellent coordination skills and the ability to manage competing priorities. Headquartered in Wendell, NC, the EA PMO executes a diverse portfolio of projects, and this position will be focused on service solutions within our Customer Services business. This role comes with ample opportunities for growth, reflective of Siemens mission to empower people with a growth mindset. As a customer facing team, we keep customer satisfaction at the forefront as we manage large projects in a fast-paced environment.

  • Project Management: Manage projects from inception to completion, ensuring safety, budget, schedule, quality, and performance objectives are met.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Communicate effectively with team members, stakeholders, and management, providing regular updates and managing customer expectations throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Resource Management: Identify, assign, and manage project resources, including engineering, field personnel, vendors, and 3rd-party services.
  • Risk Management: Proactively identify project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and monitor/control 3rd-party vendors to ensure contract adherence.
  • Financial Leadership: Track project budget, schedule completion, and perform monthly revenue forecasting.
  • Contract Management: Review and understand contractual obligations, manage change orders, and participate in vendor negotiations.
  • Quality & Process Improvement: Develop project execution plans like quality & testing plans, schedules, and risk registers. Implement recovery plans to address performance issues.
  • Collaboration & Relationship Building: Collaborate with internal/external teams and clients to develop site schedules, maintain client relationships, and provide "Lessons Learned" feedback to improve project offerings.

 You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 7+ years of direct service project management experience.
  • 7+ years of written and verbal communication skills, to present complex issues to multi-level audiences and effectively communicate progress, status and issues to internal and external Customers.
  • Applicants must be authorized for employment in the U.S. without the need for employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • PMP certification – while not required immediately for this role, for those who do not have it already, obtaining PMP certification is required within 1 year of employment
  • A degree in engineering or construction management
  • Experience in specific industry related to service project e.g., field service, EPC projects, construction, energy, manufacturing
  • An understanding of medium and/or high voltage electrical equipment
  • An understanding of datacenter construction projects
  • Experience with MS Project or other relevant scheduling software
  • Strong leadership skills with experience in leading cross-functional project teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, to present complex issues to multi-level audiences and effectively communicate progress, status, and issues to internal and external Customers.

About Smart Infrastructure – Electrification and Automation: 

The Electrification and Automation (EA) Business Unit offers the full range of energy distribution systems and solutions for all markets and through all sales channels. We provide reliable power distribution grids of today while investing into our Future Grids portfolio and applications to create the power distribution grid of the future. Our comprehensive portfolio meets the growing technical requirements of today’s and tomorrow’s power grid! 

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us. Learn more about our commitment to DEI here.

Protecting the environment, conserving our natural resources, fostering the health and performance of our people as well as safeguarding their working conditions are core to our social and business commitment at Siemens. They are an integral part of our Business Conduct Guidelines and our corporate strategy.
