jobs.title: Senior Energy Consultant - Power Market Modeling
jobs.description_html:
Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step. 

 Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Grid Software’s Power Technologies International (PTI) Energy Business Advisory team is helping businesses navigate complexity, drive growth, and steer strategic direction in an evolving landscape. Our wide range of services offer solutions in planning, managing risk, improving operations, conducting custom market studies, supporting M&A activities, and developing infrastructure.

We are looking for a Senior Energy Consultant to deliver valuable solutions to utilities, investors, and project developers. We seek someone with deep expertise in power market modeling to support asset valuation, curtailment and congestion analysis, strategic market outlooks, and project siting decisions. Transform the everyday with us!

This is a remote position based in the Contiguous U.S. 

You’ll make an impact as you: 

  • Develop and run production cost and market models to support Integrated Resource Planning (IRP) and broader integrated system planning studies.
  • Build power price forecasts and long-term market outlooks to inform utility, developer, and investor decisions.
  • Analyze system operations, resource adequacy, and portfolio performance under different planning scenarios and policy pathways.
  • Support clients in evaluating generation, storage, and transmission investments within integrated planning frameworks.
  • Deliver insights that help clients optimize portfolios, manage risks, and align with evolving market and regulatory conditions.
  • Prepare clear, data-driven reports and presentations that communicate technical results and strategic implications.
  • Mentor junior consultants in modeling, analytics, and interpretation of results.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications: 

Basic qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, economics, operations research, finance, statistics, physics, or mathematics.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in production cost modeling and power market analytics (using  Aurora, PLEXOS, PROMOD, or other production cost modeling tools).
  • Strong understanding of U.S. power markets, renewable integration, and transmission constraints.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% of the time, primarily within the U.S.

Preferred qualifications: 

  • Prior consulting experience with utilities, developers, or investors.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical analyses in clear, client-ready deliverables.
  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks, interconnection processes, and decarbonization policies.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Architect
jobs.description_html:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.

Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a Server Architect to join the Technology & Innovation (T&I) organization as part of the Architecture & Standards team. This role will work closely with, and under the direction of, the Senior Server Architect to define server standards and recommend compute technologies that best enable DI SW’s global software development organizations.

The Server Architect will bring deep expertise in compute platforms and server hardware, with a strong focus on supporting scientific and engineering software development workloads. The role partners closely with software engineering organizations, service delivery teams, data center operations, facilities, and procurement to ensure scalable, efficient, and future-ready compute solutions.

Success in this role is measured by technical impact, operational efficiency, and the ability to become a trusted partner to engineering teams and infrastructure peers.


Key Responsibilities:

Architecture & Strategy

  • Partner with the Senior Server Architect to define and maintain enterprise server architecture standards, reference designs, and best practices for DI SW development environments
  • Evaluate and recommend compute technologies optimized for engineering, simulation, build, CI/CD, and high-performance development workloads
  • Align server architecture decisions with broader T&I infrastructure and services strategies

Engineering & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work closely with software development organizations to understand strategic initiatives, performance requirements, and future compute needs
  • Act as a technical advisor and trusted partner to engineering teams, translating workload requirements into scalable server architectures
  • Collaborate with service delivery teams to align architecture with operational realities and consumption models

Data Center, Power & Efficiency

  • Partner with data center operations and facilities teams to maximize efficiency across power, cooling, and rack density
  • Influence server platform choices and configurations to support sustainability, energy efficiency, and long-term capacity planning

Technology Evaluation & Vendor Management

  • Maintain deep awareness of server market trends, CPU/GPU roadmaps, accelerator technologies, memory, interconnects, and platform innovations
  • Manage relationships with server and component vendors, influencing roadmaps where possible to align with DI SW requirements
  • Lead or support proofs of concept (POCs), technology evaluations, and platform validations

Lab, Logistics & Procurement Support

  • Manage logistics for loaner systems, seed units, and evaluation hardware, including lab reservations, tracking, and lifecycle coordination
  • Partner with Procurement to support deep-dive quote requests, technical comparisons, and vendor evaluations
  • Provide architectural input to sourcing decisions and long-term supplier strategies

Capacity & Utilization Insight

  • Support capacity planning efforts by contributing to compute capacity and utilization reporting
  • Consult with service delivery teams on reporting requirements, trends, and opportunities for optimization

Required Qualifications:

  • Deep hands-on expertise in server and compute hardware architectures (CPU, memory, storage, accelerators, interconnects)
  • Strong understanding of compute platforms supporting scientific, engineering, and software development workloads
  • Experience working with enterprise data center environments, including power and cooling considerations
  • Proven ability to evaluate emerging technologies and translate them into practical architectural recommendations
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to engage engineering teams, operations, and vendors

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting large-scale software development or HPC-adjacent environments
  • Familiarity with virtualization, containerized workloads, and hybrid deployment models
  • Experience leading or coordinating hardware POCs and technology evaluations
  • Prior involvement in vendor roadmap discussions or strategic sourcing initiatives

What Success Looks Like:

  • Well-adopted, forward-looking server standards that meet current and future engineering needs
  • Strong partnerships with software development organizations built on trust and technical credibility
  • Efficient, scalable compute platforms that optimize cost, power, and performance
  • Clear influence on vendor technology direction and internal infrastructure strategy

Compensation & Benefits:

The salary range for this position is $129,600 to 233,300 and this role is eligible to earn incentive compensation (5-10%). The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/



This position will be subject to U.S. export control requirements under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or Export Administration Regulations (EAR).  Employment is contingent on either verifying the U.S. Person status or obtaining any necessary export license.  


Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday with Us

#LI-REMOTE

#SWSaaS

The pay range for this position is $129,600 - $233,300 annually with a target incentive of 5-10% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Senior Power Systems Consultant - PSCAD
jobs.description_html:
Who are we?

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

 Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world! Transform the everyday with us!

We are looking for a Senior Power Systems Consultant to join Grid Software’s Power Technologies International (PTI) team. PTI is our trusted advisor that takes a holistic approach, providing business advisory, technical consulting, and simulation software solutions. This role is essential to the planning and integration of renewables, storage, and FACTS to the electrical grid. The Senior Power Systems Consultant will perform large-scale simulations of electrical transmission systems for Utilities, Regional Transmission Organizations, and energy asset owners to develop solutions for safe and reliable power system operations.

This is a remote position based in the contiguous U.S.

What you will be working on:

  • Leading and performing advanced power system studies, including system dynamics, electromagnetic transients, interconnection analysis, and grid code compliance using industry-standard tools.
  • Performing and reviewing detailed modeling and simulation work for synchronous machines, inverter-based resources, and control systems.
  • Managing and supporting technical project execution by tracking milestones, validating study assumptions, and ensuring work meets defined technical scope, schedule, budget, and quality requirements.
  • Developing, validating, and documenting study methodologies and assumptions, and producing detailed technical reports and client-ready presentations.
  • Collaborating with multi-disciplinary engineering teams to interpret study results and resolve complex system performance issues.
  • Providing technical mentorship to junior consultants on modeling approaches, simulation techniques, and established guidelines.
  • Designing and implementing automation scripts and workflows to enhance model development, study execution, post-processing, and quality control.
  • Supporting on-site technical consulting engagements and delivering specialized training on power system modeling, simulation tools, and study methodologies.

Minimum requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in electrical engineering with a focus in Power Systems Engineering.
  • 5+ years of experience in power system studies, with strong hands-on expertise in PSCAD and electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulations.
  • Proven experience developing, validating, and troubleshooting detailed PSCAD models for inverter-based resources, renewable generation, energy storage systems, and grid-connected power electronics.
  • Experience performing EMT studies for grid compliance, including fault ride-through, control interactions, harmonic and subsynchronous interaction analysis.
  • Experience analyzing power flow and dynamic stability using PSS®E required
  • Familiarity with utility and regional transmission organization requirements and standards (for example: ERCOT, SPP, WECC, PJM, Southern Company, or similar).
  • Experience supporting interconnection studies, system impact studies, or facility studies.
  • Ability to lead technical workstreams and review technical deliverables
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting technical findings to clients, utilities, and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and listening skills with demonstrated ability to write effective technical reports.
  • Ability to travel 10% domestically and internationally.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in electrical engineering with a focus in Power Systems Engineering
  • Additional experience with platforms like TSAT™, TARA, PSLF™, or PowerWorld preferred.
  • Good knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards with understanding of RTO and other regional planning criteria, procedures, and practices.
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or developing others professionally.

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

#GSWUS

#GSWPTI

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in the electric power industry as outlined below. Advanced degree MAY be substituted for professional experience if academic work included required studies and tools listed below.

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

 Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world! Transform the everyday with us!

We are seeking a Power Systems Consultant to develop models for power systems elements (such as conventional and renewable generating plants, voltage support devices, etc.), perform model validation, perform large-scale simulations of electrical transmission systems for clients such as power producers, independent system operators, and transmission providers to develop solutions for safe and reliable power system operations. Job responsibilities will include the application of power systems planning principles, simulation and analysis of power system steady state, dynamic, and transient behaviors, development of mathematical models for reliability assessment of electrical networks, and delivery of on-site technical consulting/training services.

This is a remote position based in the Contiguous U.S.

You’ll make an impact as you:

  • Drive execution of your assignments, deliver quality results on time and within budget through regular status reporting to satisfy the needs of our customers. The assignments can include steady-state, dynamic and transient analyses of electrical power transmission systems, modeling of renewable and conventional generation facilities and other elements of power systems, relay protection modeling, microgrid studies etc.
  • Create draft reports and presentations with study results for review by senior staff and managers.
  • Demonstrate strong analytical and critical thinking skills with a growth mindset as you participate in training and mentoring opportunities.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering with a focus in Power and Energy Systems and practical experience in using advanced power system analysis tools.
  • We will consider candidates with at least one year of relevant professional experience including engineering internships.
  • Knowledge of transmission system planning or operations with experience analyzing power flow, transient stability, and/or electromagnetic transients.
  • Advanced degree MAY be substituted for experience.
  • Ability to travel 10%

Preferred qualifications:

  • Knowledge of PSSE, PSLF, PowerWorld, TARA, PSCAD and/or Python is a plus.

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

 

#LI-PC1

#LI-REMOTE

#GSWUS

#GSWPTI


You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $68,830 - $117,994 annually with a target incentive of 10% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Emulation Hardware Project Manager
jobs.description_html:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Position Overview:

The Emulation Hardware Support Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering emulation hardware support projects across engineering, IT, facilities, and vendor teams. This role ensures emulation platforms are deployed, maintained, upgraded, and supported on schedule, within scope, and with minimal disruption to engineering users. 

The ideal candidate combines strong project management skills with hands-on understanding of hardware labs, data center operations, overall Technology and Infrastructure knowledge, and semiconductor emulation environments. 


Key Responsibilities:
  • Project & Program Management 
    • Own end-to-end project execution for emulation hardware deployments, upgrades, migrations, and decommissions 
    • Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, and risk registers 
    • Coordinate cross-functional teams including Emulation, IT, Facilities, Network, Security, and Vendors 
    • Track dependencies, manage change requests, and communicate project status to stakeholders 
  • Emulation Hardware & Lab Support 
    • Manage support activities for emulation platforms (e.g., Strato product family, Primo-CS product family, ProFPGA-CS product family)
    • Coordinate hardware installs, rack/stack, power, cooling, cabling, and network connectivity
    • Oversee hardware break/fix, RMA processes, and vendor escalations 
    • Ensure lab readiness, access control, and compliance with safety and security requirements 
  • Infrastructure & Operations 
    • Partner with IT teams on OS provisioning, firmware updates, storage, and network integration 
    • Support data center and lab migrations (on-prem, colocation, or hybrid environments) 
    • Ensure systems meet performance, availability, and reliability expectations 
    • Drive standardization and documentation of emulation infrastructure processes 
  • Stakeholder & Vendor Management 
    • Act as the primary point of contact for emulation hardware support projects 
    • Manage relationships with EDA vendors and hardware suppliers 
    • Lead regular syncs, issue reviews, and post-mortems 
    • Communicate clearly with engineering leadership and end users 
  • Process Improvement & Reporting 
    • Define KPIs for project delivery, system availability, and support responsiveness 
    • Identify gaps and drive continuous improvement initiatives 
    • Maintain accurate documentation, runbooks, and asset tracking 

You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $129,600 - $233,300 annually with a target incentive of 5-10% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Manager, Emulation Field Support Engineer
jobs.description_html:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Position Overview:

The Emulation Hardware Support Manager will lead a global team of engineers responsible for deploying, maintaining, and optimizing emulation hardware systems (e.g., FPGA-based platforms) across hybrid environments, including on-premises data centers, cloud infrastructure, and customer sites. This role requires a strategic leader who combines technical expertise in hardware systems with operational excellence, team development, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure 99.9%+ uptime, rapid incident resolution, and scalable infrastructure growth.   

The ideal candidate will drive continuous improvement in hardware reliability, automation, and support processes while managing a 24/7 operational environment. This position serves as a critical bridge between R&D, IT, facilities, and customer success teams, ensuring alignment between product design, infrastructure capabilities, and customer needs.   

Key Responsibilities: 

Team Leadership & Development 

  • Manage, mentor, and grow a team of 19+ Emulation Hardware Support Engineers across multiple regions.   
  • Design and oversee on-call rotations, training programs, and career development plans to build expertise in FPGA-based systems, Linux administration, and network diagnostics.   
  • Implement performance metrics (e.g., MTTR < 2 hours, <5% escalations) and conduct quarterly reviews to align team goals with organizational objectives.   

Infrastructure Operations & Reliability 

  • Own end-to-end lifecycle management of emulation hardware, including capacity planning, deployment, firmware updates, and decommissioning.   
  • Develop and support SOPs for hardware diagnostics, failure analysis, and preventive maintenance to minimize downtime.   
  • Partner with IT and facilities teams to optimize data center layouts, power/cooling efficiency, and hardware security protocols.   

Incident Management & Escalation 

  • Lead critical incident response for Severity 1 issues, coordinating with engineering and customer teams to resolve outages within SLA targets.   
  • Conduct post-mortem analyses to identify root causes (e.g., firmware bugs, thermal throttling) and implement corrective actions.   
  • Maintain a knowledge base of resolved cases to accelerate future troubleshooting.   

Cross-Functional Collaboration 

  • Work with R&D to provide field feedback for improving hardware design (e.g., debug interfaces, telemetry capabilities).   
  • Partner with sales/support teams on customer-facing activities, including pre-sales technical reviews and on-site deployment support.   
  • Coordinate with vendors to negotiate SLAs for component replacements and firmware support.   

You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $154,200 - $277,600 annually with a target incentive of 10-15% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.description_html:
Location: Any Siemens location in the world
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.



■業務内容

1. 当社製造業向けDXソリューションの営業活動（提案・交渉・契約）
2. 新規・既存顧客に対する新規ライセンスおよびサービスビジネスの発掘
3. 社内外ステークホルダー（顧客内部での利害関係者、社内関連部署など）との各種調整業務
※ターゲットとする業界は、①自動車、②航空宇宙、防衛、③エレクトロニクス、医療機器、④半導体を想定しています


■応募資格（必須要件）

▼知識・経験

・5年以上のビジネスアプリケーション領域における法人営業経験
・新規開拓営業やアカウント営業（インサイドセールスやSMB営業経験を含む）の経験、また成果に対して高いこだわりが持てること


▼スキル・能力

・大手企業の経営層（Cレベル）を含む意思決定者との信頼関係を構築し、的確に課題・ニーズを引き出すコミュニケーション力
・高い論理的思考能力と課題解決力
顧客の課題を的確に捉え、解決策を提案し、顧客に対し戦略的アプローチができること

・成長意欲と学習行動
自身だけでなく、チームや会社全体の成長にも貢献するために、新たな知識・スキル習得に主体的・継続的に取り組める方。

・目標達成に対する強い意欲・セルフマネジメント力
高い目標に対して主体的に行動し、達成に向けて自ら計画・実行・改善に取り組める方。


■応募資格（歓迎要件）

▼知識・経験

・DX提案経験があれば尚可（業界は不問）
・SaaSプロダクト、クラウドサービスの営業経験
企業の業務課題やニーズを的確に把握し、SaaSやクラウド型ITサービスの価値を顧客へ分かりやすく提案・導入までリードした経験のある方。

・即戦力性
製造業の営業経験があれば尚可
PLM、CAD、CAE、MESなど製造業向けのソフトウェア営業経験があれば尚可


▼スキル・能力

・担当顧客ごとの状況分析にもとづき、中長期的な関係構築や売上拡大に向けた戦略的なアカウントプランを立案・提案できる方
・提案力・プレゼンテーション力
　ソリューションの価値や導入メリットを分かりやすく、魅力的に伝える力。


■学歴

・大学卒業以上が望ましい。
（短期大学・高等専門学校卒業は可。専修学校、高等学校卒業は不可）


■言語力

▼英語：英文メールの読み書きに支障がない

▼日本語：ネイティブレベル


■勤務地

下記オフィスロケーションのいずれか（採用部署による）
・新横浜オフィス：神奈川県横浜市港北区新横浜 3-1-9　アリーナタワー 14階
・新宿オフィス：東京都渋谷区代々木2-2-1 小田急サザンタワー 9階
・大阪オフィス：大阪府 大阪市淀川区 宮原1-6-1　新大阪ブリックビル9階　大阪オフィス
・名古屋オフィス：愛知県名古屋市中区丸の内3-17-13　いちご丸の内ビル8F　名古屋オフィス
*その他：愛知県内（豊田、三河安城）オフィスの可能性有

※屋内の受動喫煙対策：有（禁煙）

※顧客先（日本全国）訪問はございます


■待遇

・想定年収（OTE）：1,200万円 ～ 2,400万円
・OTE構成：基本給：50%、ターゲットインセンティブ：50%
・支払方法：月額給与は年収の12分の1を毎月25日に支給。ターゲットインセンティブは当月分を翌月計算、翌々月支払い。
・深夜勤務手当
・賞与は（雇用契約書）に準ずる
・通勤手当：特急料金を除き全額支給（ただし、新幹線料金には別途定めあり）。
・退職金：企業型確定拠出年金


■就業時間

・事業場外みなし（9:00～17:30を標準労働時間帯とする）
・時間外労働：概念なし



■休日
年間休日：124日
完全週休二日制（毎週土曜日・日曜日）、国民の祝日、年末年始


■休暇

年次有給休暇、傷病休暇、慶弔休暇、特別休暇（事由による）
産前産後休暇、生理休暇、介護休暇・子の看護休暇、育児及び介護休業


■加入保険

健康保険、厚生年金、雇用保険、労災保険、


■福利厚生

・通勤手当：特急料金を除き全額支給（ただし、新幹線料金には別途定めあり）。
*ただし在宅勤務手当の支給が開始された場合には、通勤手当は適用されないものとする。

・雇用保険料補助手当（個人負担分を会社が補助）
・総合福祉団体定期保険
・団体長期障害所得補償保険
・福利厚生倶楽部（リロクラブ）
・労働災害総合保険（法定外補償保険）


■選考プロセス

・書類選考
・適性検査あり
・面接(Interview)：数回
・外国人面接官との面接：なし
※面接形式：対面またはWeb（Teams使用）


■応募書類

・履歴書（和文必須、写真添付が望ましい）
・職務経歴書（和文もしくは英文）

A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

We offer a comprehensive reward package which includes a competitive basic salary, bonus scheme, generous holiday allowance, pension, and private healthcare.

jobs.title: Lead / Senior Lead Power Systems Consultant
jobs.description_html:
Who are we?

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

 Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world! Transform the everyday with us!

We are looking for a Lead or Senior Lead Power Systems Consultant to join Grid Software’s Power Technologies International (PTI) team. This role is critical to the planning and integration of renewables, storage, and FACTS to the electrical grid and to perform large-scale simulations of electrical transmission systems for clients such as power producers, independent system operators, and transmission providers to develop solutions for safe and reliable power system operations.

This is a remote position based in the Contiguous U.S.

You’ll make an impact as you:

  • Perform transmission planning through the application of power systems planning principles to simulate and analyze the power system steady state and dynamic behavior.
  • Prepare detailed written reports describing analyses performed, conclusions, and recommendations.
  • Work in small project teams, ensuring deliverables are of high quality and projects are completed within budget and schedule.
  • Develop automation scripts to improve the speed and accuracy of simulations and analysis.
  • Support proposal preparation by developing project plans, budgets, and timelines.
  • Deliver on-site technical consulting/training services.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering with a minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the electric power industry (beyond academia: professional power systems work at a consulting firm, utility, national lab, ISO, RTO, etc.)
  • Candidate must have knowledge of transmission system planning or operations with experience analyzing power flow and dynamic stability using PSS®E, TARA, or TSAT in Transmission system planning and/or operations experience in MISO or SPP footprints—or PSCAD analysis experience in these or other regions (system-wide analysis preferred)
  • Ability to travel 10% domestically

Preferred qualifications:

  • Prior experience in Power System Consulting
  • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering with a specialization in Power and Energy Systems

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

#LI-PC1

#LI-REMOTE

#GSWUS

#GSWPTI


You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $102,459 - $210,773 annually with a target incentive of 10-15% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.description_html:
Who are we?

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world!

We are looking for a Portfolio Consulting Manager to lead a Power Technologies International (PTI) team developing and providing innovative technical consulting services to Utilities, Regional Transmission Organizations, and energy asset owners. This opportunity focuses on managing people—not merely providing technical mentorship.

This is a remote position located in the contiguous U.S.

You will make an impact as you work on:

  • Expanding Siemens PTI’s consulting business in power grid analysis and design, system dynamics and transients, system interconnection, and grid code compliance.
  • Maintaining relationships with clients to ensure satisfaction while finding opportunities to provide further solutions and increase business.
  • Leading proposal development in response to requests for proposal or other client inquiries.
  • Leading and growing a team of consultants with varying levels of experience. Set clear expectations and provide regular feedback..
  • Mentoring people and helping them develop individual skills and career paths while promoting learning from successes and failures.
  • Managing project execution, tracking project progress, and making necessary adjustments to maintain scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
  • Collaborating with other Siemens Industry Business Units for a more comprehensive customer engagement.

Minimum requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or postgraduate degree in Electrical Engineering with a specialization in Power and Energy Systems.
  • Proven experience performing power systems analysis for electric utilities, RTOs, and developers.
  • Proven experience leading and developing teams.
  • Power systems analysis experience with PSS/E required; experience with other grid analysis software such as TSAT™, TARA, PSLF™, PowerWorld, PSCAD™, etc. highly desired.
  • Good knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards with understanding of RTO and other regional planning criteria, procedures, and practices.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and listening skills with demonstrated ability to write effective technical reports.
  • Ability to travel 10% domestically and internationally.

Preferred qualifications:

  • At least 10 years of experience related to power systems analysis as described above.
  • At least 2 years of proven experience managing or developing teams.
  • Prior consulting experience desired.
  • Experience working in the PJM, NYISO, and/or SPP regions.

Who are we?

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world! Transform the everyday with us!

We are looking for a Lead Power Systems Consultant to join Grid Software’s Power Technologies International (PTI) team. PTI is our trusted advisor that takes a holistic approach, providing business advisory, technical consulting, and simulation software solutions. This role is critical to the planning and integration of renewables, storage, and FACTS to the electrical grid. The Senior Power Systems Lead will perform large-scale simulations of electrical transmission systems for Utilities, Regional Transmission Organizations, and energy asset owners to develop solutions for safe and reliable power system operations, while mentoring others on the team.

This is a remote position based in the contiguous U.S.

What you will be working on:

  • Performing/leading consulting engagements related to power grid analysis and design, system dynamics and transients, system interconnection, and grid code compliance.
  • Managing/supporting project execution, tracking project progress, and making necessary adjustments to maintain scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
  • Producing reports and presentations with study results in collaboration with team members.
  • Maintaining relationships with clients to ensure satisfaction, analyzing clients’ business requirements and identifying opportunities for further business.
  • Supporting proposal preparation by developing project plans, budgets, and timelines.
  • Providing mentoring and technical development to junior consultants.
  • Developing automation scripts to streamline repetitive tasks, reduce errors, and boost overall efficiency.
  • Delivering on-site consulting and training services.

Minimum requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or postgraduate degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • Minimum of 3 years of professional experience performing power systems analysis for electric utilities, ISOs, RTOs, developers, or national labs; 5+ years preferred.
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or developing others professionally.
  • Experience analyzing power flow and dynamic stability using PSS®E required; additional experience with TSAT™, TARA, PSLF™, or PowerWorld. preferred.
  • Good knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards with understanding of RTO and other regional planning criteria, procedures, and practices.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and listening skills with demonstrated ability to write effective technical reports.
  • Ability to travel 10% domestically and internationally.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Prior relevant consulting experience.
  • Experience working in the ISO-NE, PJM, and/or SPP regions
  • Experience in distribution planning.
  • Industry experience performing power system transient analysis using PSCAD™ or EMTP-RV

jobs.title: Integrated Medical Services LPN
jobs.description_html:
Integrated Medical Services LPN

Pay: $27.00 - $30.00 per hour

Summary

As an Integrated Medical Services LPN at Aspire Health Partners, your job purpose will be to provide direct patient care, medication administration, clinical monitoring, and documentation within the scope of Florida nursing practice and under appropriate supervision.

This role supports clients receiving behavioral health, crisis stabilization, detoxification, and substance-use treatment services while promoting safety, recovery, and continuity of care.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver safe, compassionate nursing care, including assessments, vital signs, clinical monitoring, treatments, and activities of daily living.
  • Administer medications accurately, monitor therapeutic effects and adverse reactions, maintain medication security, and report medication-related concerns.
  • Observe and report changes in physical, behavioral, psychiatric, or withdrawal-related conditions and respond appropriately to emergencies.
  • Support admissions, transfers, discharges, referrals, and interdisciplinary treatment planning.
  • Implement provider orders and perform authorized nursing procedures, including wound care, specimen collection, injections, and point-of-care testing.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and compliant documentation in the electronic health record.
  • Promote client safety through infection control practices, risk prevention measures, crisis intervention support, and adherence to safety protocols.
  • Provide client education regarding medications, treatments, wellness, discharge planning, and recovery support.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives, audits, regulatory compliance activities, and ongoing professional development.
  • Collaborate effectively with nurses, providers, clients, families, and interdisciplinary teams to ensure high-quality patient care.

Work Environment

This position may involve working in behavioral health and substance-use treatment settings and requires flexibility to work evenings, nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime as needed.

The LPN is responsible for maintaining professional standards, protecting patient rights and confidentiality, and providing safe, recovery-oriented care within the legal scope of practice.

Qualifications

  • Level II Background Clearance - All Aspire Health Partners Internships and Careers require Level 2 clearance, with Aspire covering fingerprinting costs. Visit info.flclearinghouse.com to learn more.
  • Acceptable Motor Vehicle Registration driver’s license record in accordance with the underwriting guidelines set by Aspire’s insurance company.
  • Current Florida LPN License
  • Some Psychiatric Nursing experience

Aspire Health Partners is a drug-free workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants are treated without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, or veteran status. For more information, see Aspire’s Equal Employment Opportunity Policy.

jobs.title: Integrated Medical Services NURSING SUPERVISOR/Manager
jobs.description_html:
Integrated Medical Services Nurse Manager/Supervisor

Pay: $37.00 - $43.00 per hour

As Integrated Medical Services Nurse Manager at Aspire Health Partners, your job purpose will be to provide leadership, supervision, and clinical support to nursing staff while ensuring safe, efficient, and compliant patient care.

This role collaborates with nursing leadership, medical and psychiatric providers, and program leaders to support daily operations, staffing needs, quality improvement, and continuity of care in our mental health and substance use disorder programs including Detox and MAT.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead, supervise, coach, and evaluate nursing staff, including RNs, LPNs, and support personnel.
  • Ensure delivery of high-quality, evidence-based nursing care in compliance with organizational policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee daily nursing operations, including admissions, transfers, discharges, staffing, scheduling, and patient care needs.
  • Monitor staffing levels, address coverage issues, and support recruitment, onboarding, training, and retention efforts.
  • Serve as a clinical resource for patient care issues, medical emergencies, medication concerns, and changes in patient condition.
  • Ensure accurate medication management practices, including audits, error review, controlled substance oversight, and collaboration with providers and pharmacy services.
  • Monitor clinical documentation for accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and compliance through chart reviews and audits.
  • Support quality improvement initiatives, survey readiness, accreditation standards, and compliance with state, federal, and organizational regulations.
  • Investigate incidents, participate in root cause analyses, implement corrective actions, and promote strategies that enhance patient and staff safety.
  • Collaborate across disciplines to support continuity of care, operational effectiveness, and positive patient outcomes.

This position combines clinical oversight, staff leadership, operational management, regulatory compliance, and quality improvement to ensure safe and effective nursing services.

Qualifications

  • Current RN Florida License
  • BSN preferred
  • Five Years or equivalent previous background in areas of Nursing Supervision
  • Level II Background clearance- All Aspire Health Partners Internships and Careers require Level 2 clearance, with Aspire covering fingerprinting costs. Visit info.flclearinghouse.c.om to learn more.
  • Acceptable Motor Vehicle Registration driver’s license record in accordance with the underwriting guidelines set by Aspire Insurance Company, as described in the AHP Corporate Transportation Policy 3.9.1

Aspire Health Partners is a drug-free workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants are treated without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, or veteran status. For more information, see Aspire’s Equal Employment Opportunity Policy.

jobs.title: Patient Care Tech
jobs.description_html:
Patient Care Tech (PCT) 

Pay Rate: $17

What will you do? As a PCT at Aspire Health Partners, your job purpose will be to provide a variety of essential functions to ensure effective operations of assigned programs.  These functions include;

  • Perform routine intake procedures relating to medical issues and initiate and maintain client medical charts.
  • Administer or observe medications and document prescription medications, blood pressure, behavior and other related issues.
  • Take client vital signs as appropriate, change wound dressings and perform other routine supervised nursing activities.
  • Order, inventory and maintain stock of prescription medications, over-the-counter drugs and first aid supplies. Assist nurse or medical provider as required during sick call.
  • May monitor clients during daily activities including work, meals and recreation to ensure compliance with program commitments and regulations.
  • Monitor client telephone conversations, assist clients in accessing program resources, complete discharge plans.
  • Transport clients to offsite activities as directed and periodically assist other staff with searches of rooms and personal belongings.
  • Communicate unusual issues or circumstances to supervisory personnel and communicate with night personnel at change of shift to provide complete information regarding current client and facility conditions.
  • May perform some administrative functions including client room assignments.
  • May facilitate group recovery meetings and house meetings, note critical issues to review with others and collect fees for services.
  • May obtain insurance benefits, authorization and continues reviews.
  • May monitor clients issuing urine samples for laboratory testing and prepare and maintain required documentation for chain of custody.
  • Document client behavior and other related data. Prepare periodic and special reports relating to work activities and project progress. 
  • Perform crisis interventions as required.
  • Ensure the proper disposal of bio-hazardous material.
  • Maintain high standards of ethical and professional conduct and adheres to agency policies and procedures.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • CNA, CMA, EMT or PCT experience
  • Level II Background clearance- All Aspire Health Partners Internships and Careers require Level 2 clearance, with Aspire covering fingerprinting costs. Click https://info.flclearinghouse.com to learn more. 
  • Acceptable Motor Vehicle Registration driver’s license record in accordance with the underwriting guidelines set by Aspire’s insurance company as described in the AHP Corporate Transportation Policy 3.9.1.

Aspire Health Partners is a drug-free workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants are treated without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, or veteran status. For more information, see Aspire’s Equal Employment Opportunity Policy.

jobs.title: Bed Management & Staffing Specialist
jobs.description_html:
Bed Management and Staffing Specialist

This is NOT a recruiter position

Schedule: 24 hours a week, 3 8-hour days

Weekends Rotate

Pay Rate: $16.80

Job Purpose: As a Bed Management / Staffing Specialist at Aspire Health Partners, your job purpose is to provide bed availability based on the staff coordination per the guidelines/acuity and safety.

Job Functions

  • Coordinate unit staff to ensure unit coverage on a 24/7 basis for all acute care programs.
  • Maintain an accurate daily staffing schedule for all inpatient units.
  • Monitor time and attendance regularly, and refers to the appropriate Nurse Manager.
  • Maintain a master schedule for each acute care unit through on-Shift, assisting with filling daily staffing needs due to call outs, census fluctuations and other variables.
  • Monitoring employees in number and availability for each position to assure that designated casual staff is able to meet staffing needs without overtime.
  • Maintain an accurate contact information for all staff.
  • Collaborates in a professional manner with each department to ensure patients are placed in the correct bed the first time, based on their funding source/ gender and legal status.
  • Manages census for all inpatient acute care, substance abuse units and residentials.
  • Completes routine census reports and sends to necessary AHP management as indicated.
  • Assist Centralized Navigation Manager in collecting and reviewing data analysis.
  • Most importantly, all functions must be completed while maintaining high standards of ethical and professional conduct while adhering to agency policies and procedures.

Position qualifications: Ability to receive and maintain a(n)

  • Level II Background clearance
  • Acceptable Motor Vehicle Registration driver’s license record in accordance with the underwriting guidelines set by Aspire insurance company as described in the AHP Corporate Transportation Policy 3.9.1
  • High School Diploma
  • College degree preferred
  • Must be competent in using Microsoft Office suite
  • Good communication skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Care Manager
jobs.description_html:
Care Manager

Pay Rate: $19.95

What will you do? As a Care Manager at Aspire Health Partners, your job purpose is to provide exceptional customer service, assist the client with psychosocial barriers, ensure continuity of care between programs or providers, and assist them with navigation through Aspire’s system of care or services provided by the community.

Job Functions:

  • Respond to and provide short-term intervention services for individuals experiencing mental health-related crises in the community.
  • Connect individuals in crisis to appropriate behavioral health, substance use, and community-based services and supports.
  • Conduct care management services for individuals who meet substance use diagnostic criteria, DLA-20, and ASAM assessment requirements.
  • Receive and manage referrals primarily from the Access Department, Mobile Response Teams, and Crisis Receiving Center (CRC).
  • Deliver services using a trauma-informed, person-centered approach while ensuring a high-quality customer experience.
  • Maintain compliance with all program requirements, regulatory standards, policies, and procedures.
  • Participate in regular staff meetings, case consultations, and interdepartmental communication to support coordinated care.
  • Collaborate with community stakeholders, service providers, and external resources to enhance service delivery and client outcomes.
  • Complete required documentation, assessments, data collection, and reporting in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Assist with diagnostic and evaluation processes as needed to support treatment planning and program objectives.
  • Support outcome measurement and quality improvement initiatives through data reporting and program evaluation activities.
  • Perform additional operational, administrative, and clinical support duties as assigned by the supervisor.
  • Most importantly, all functions must be completed while maintaining high standards of ethical and professional conduct while adhering to agency policies and procedures. 

Position qualifications: Ability to receive and maintain a(n)

  • Level II Background clearance- All Aspire Health Partners Internships and Careers require Level 2 clearance, with Aspire covering fingerprinting costs. Click https://info.flclearinghouse.com to learn more.
  • Acceptable Motor Vehicle Registration driver’s license record in accordance with the underwriting guidelines set by Aspire’s insurance company as described in the AHP Corporate Transportation Policy 3.9.1.
  • Bachelor Degree in Psychology or other Human Services field

Pay: $31.00 - $34.00 per hour

As an Integrated Medical Services Charge Nurse at Aspire Health Partners, your job purpose will be to provide a multitude of essential functions to assess, implement and evaluate the nursing care of psychiatric and substance abuse clients in the Inpatient Program. The Charge RN will be responsible for managing all aspects of nursing responsibilities during each shift, from processing patients in and out to delegating nursing rounds and drug administration. Charge RN will also focus on providing the best care possible while ensuring patient satisfaction in every interaction.

Job Functions:

  • Coordinates patient admissions/discharges. Transfer arrangements. Coordinating continuing services and maintaining a therapeutic milieu.
  • Participates in direct patient care and works as an interdisciplinary team in order to promote the highest standard care.
  • Participates fully in-patient rounds and triages patient conditions as necessary and maintains patient condition amongst nursing and support staff.
  • Complete and exchange of information between the oncoming and off-going staff by communicating patient care needs and concerns.
  • Direct support staff as appropriate in the provision of care of the patient providing supervision as necessary.
  • Assign and coordinates patient care and related duties, including following unit schedule.
  • Maintain patient records accurately and promptly in accordance with documentation Policy and Procedures.
  • Facilitates the orientation to the program for new nursing staff and students. Acts as preceptor/mentor/trainer in order to support and development of new nursing staff and students. Coordinate and co-operate with colleagues of the unit and other related programs for smooth transition operations.
  • Assist in developing protocol, identifying and reporting accidents and incidents in accordance to Policy and Procedures.
  • Ensures Treatment Plan are complete and coordinated insurance documentation for concurrent reviews and continued authorization.
  • Conducts/assist with Peer Reviews and quality improvement plans (QIP’s)
  • Delegate the shift’s tasks to all of the nurses on the unit and coordinate with physicians who might need assistance
  • Supervise and guide other nurses in their work
  • Supervise Behavioral Heath Tech as they complete their assigned tasks and point out any changes or improvements that need to be made
  • Encouraging a culture that promotes staff productivity
  • Detect any issues that could result in injuries or other difficulties for patients or staff members
  • Inform physicians of any changes in patients’ progress, condition or medicinal needs
  • Ensuring that the unit runs efficiently and as per standards and regulations
  • Demonstrating leadership while performing nursing care to potentially agitated or combative clients, identifying and assessing client psychosocial, cultural, ethnic and religious needs, administering client medications and providing knowledge of medications and side effects, documenting client treatment details, assisting physicians with transcriptions and implementation of orders and maintaining compliance by completing necessary training.

jobs.title: Integrate Medical Services Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN)
jobs.description_html:
Integrate Medical Services Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN)

Aspire Health Partners is a leading Integrated behavioral health, addiction medicine, and primary care organization committed to providing comprehensive healthcare services to individuals and families. We strive to deliver high-quality, compassionate, comprehensive, and cost-effective care within an integrated, patient-centered, and supportive environment.

As a Integrated Medical Services APRN, you will play a vital role in our integrated care continuum, providing exceptional medical services to patients with a focus on behavioral health, addiction medicine, and primary care. This is an exciting opportunity to work with our multidisciplinary team to deliver exceptional care and ensure our patients receive comprehensive treatment for their mental health, addiction, and primary care needs.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct comprehensive psychiatric and medical assessments, including health histories, physical examinations, mental status evaluations, and risk assessments.
  • Evaluate and diagnose mental health, substance use, and medical conditions, including acute and chronic illnesses, withdrawal, intoxication, and psychiatric crises.
  • Develop and implement individualized, recovery-oriented treatment plans in collaboration with clients and interdisciplinary care teams.
  • Prescribe, monitor, adjust, and discontinue medications in accordance with clinical guidelines, organizational policies, and applicable state regulations.
  • Order, interpret, and review laboratory tests, diagnostic studies, and other clinical assessments to support treatment decisions.
  • Monitor treatment effectiveness, medication adherence, side effects, safety concerns, and barriers to care.
  • Provide education regarding diagnoses, medications, treatment options, wellness strategies, and recovery goals.
  • Coordinate care with physicians, psychiatrists, therapists, nurses, pharmacists, case managers, and other healthcare professionals.
  • Identify patients requiring specialty referrals, emergency intervention, hospitalization, or higher levels of care.
  • Participate in treatment team meetings, discharge planning, case reviews, and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and compliant clinical documentation in accordance with organizational, professional, and regulatory standards.

Qualifications

  • Current Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) license in the State of Florida.
  • Certification as a Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP), Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP), or other applicable APRN specialty.
  • DEA registration and prescriptive authority as required.
  • Experience in behavioral health, psychiatry, primary care, substance use treatment, crisis stabilization, or integrated healthcare settings preferred.
  • Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, treatment planning, communication, and interdisciplinary collaboration skills.

Qualifications:

  • Valid APRN license in Florida.
  • Level II Background clearance- All Aspire Health Partners Internships and Careers require Level 2 clearance, with Aspire covering fingerprinting costs. Visit https://info.flclearinghouse.c.om to learn more.
  • Master's degree in Nursing or Post MS Certificate from an accredited University/College.
  • Board Certification as a Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP), Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP), or Adult Gerontological Primary Care Nurse Practitioner (AGPC).
  • 2 years of experience as a Nurse Practitioner (preferred). Willing to work with motivated new graduates.
  • Excellent clinical assessment, diagnostic, and treatment skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team environment.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with a patient-centered approach.
  • Proficient in using electronic medical record (EMR) systems and other relevant healthcare software.

Benefits: We offer a competitive salary package and are an approved employer for Federal loan forgiveness programs. In addition, we provide a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, professional development opportunities, and more. We value work-life balance and prioritize the well-being of our employees.

If you are a passionate and dedicated Nurse Practitioner who thrives in an integrated care environment and is committed to making a positive impact in the lives of others, we encourage you to apply.

Aspire Health Partners is a drug-free workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants are treated without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, or veteran status. For more information, see Aspire’s Equal Employment Opportunity Policy.

jobs.title: Quality Data Analyst (On-Site Only – Orlando, FL)
jobs.description_html:
Quality Data Analyst (On-Site Only – Orlando, FL)

Pay Rate: $22.00 per hour
Location: Orlando, FL 32804
Work Arrangement: 100% On-Site

Important Information for Applicants

->This position is NOT remote.
->Hybrid work is not available.
->Relocation assistance is not offered.

Applicants should be local to the Orlando area or able to reliably commute to our Orlando office. Candidates requiring relocation support or a remote work arrangement will not be considered.

Join Aspire Health Partners as a Quality Data Analyst

Are you passionate about using data to improve healthcare outcomes? Aspire Health Partners is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Quality Data Analyst to support our mission of delivering high-quality behavioral health services. This role is ideal for a professional who enjoys uncovering insights, improving processes, ensuring compliance, and leveraging technology to drive organizational excellence.

As a Quality Data Analyst, you will work closely with clinical, administrative, and leadership teams to evaluate performance, support quality initiatives, and ensure data integrity across the organization.

What You'll Do

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze healthcare and quality performance data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, and analytics tools.
  • Provide actionable insights that support informed decision-making and operational excellence.
  • Utilize data analytics to measure outcomes and track organizational performance.

Internal Auditing & Compliance

  • Conduct internal audits across clinical and administrative departments.
  • Monitor compliance with healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, and organizational policies.
  • Identify process gaps and recommend data-driven corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to implement and monitor audit findings and resolutions.

Quality Improvement

  • Assist in designing and executing quality improvement initiatives.
  • Conduct root cause analyses and help develop sustainable corrective action plans.
  • Monitor progress, measure results, and report findings to leadership.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and excellence.

Technology & Systems Support

  • Support the integration, optimization, and ongoing use of quality and compliance-related IT systems.
  • Ensure data accuracy, integrity, confidentiality, and security.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource for data systems, reporting tools, and quality processes.
  • Train staff on audit procedures, data reporting practices, and compliance requirements.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Data Science, Health Informatics, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in data analysis, IT systems, internal auditing, or quality management within a healthcare environment.
  • Strong proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools.
  • Experience working with Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.
  • Understanding of healthcare regulations, compliance requirements, and quality standards.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Commitment to maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, ethics, and confidentiality.
  • Power BI experience strongly preferred.
  • Certification in Healthcare Quality, Auditing, or related discipline.

Additional Requirements

Successful candidates must be able to obtain and maintain:

  • Level II Background Clearance
    All Aspire Health Partners Internships and Careers require Level 2 clearance, with Aspire covering fingerprinting costs. Click https://info.flclearinghouse.c... to learn more.
  • Acceptable Motor Vehicle Record (MVR)
    In accordance with Aspire Health Partners' transportation and insurance requirements.

jobs.description_html:
DAYTONA INTERNATIONAL SPEEDWAY

Daytona International Speedway is a state-of-the-art motorsports facility and was awarded the SportsBusiness Journal’s prestigious Sports Business Award for Sports Facility of the Year in 2016. Daytona International Speedway is the home of "The Great American Race” – the DAYTONA 500. Though the prestigious season-opening NASCAR Cup Series event garners most of the attention – as well as the largest audience in motorsports - the approximately 500-acre motorsports complex boasts the most diverse schedule of racing on the globe, thus earning it the title of "World Center of Racing."  Among the nine major weekends of racing activity are the Rolex 24 At DAYTONA, the DAYTONA Supercross, the DAYTONA 200 motorcycle classic and the Coke Zero Sugar 400. Rarely a week goes by that the Speedway grounds are not used for events that include track tours, concerts, civic and social gatherings, car shows, photo shoots, production vehicle testing and police motorcycle training.

At NASCAR, you'll work alongside passionate people creating experiences fans feel and helping shape the future of sports and entertainment.


Daytona International Speedway is seeking a General Maintenance team member to support the day-to-day maintenance and upkeep of the facility. This hands-on role will perform preventive maintenance, general repairs, and facility improvement projects to help ensure the Speedway remains safe, functional, and ready for events throughout the year.


Working across the property, this position will assist with plumbing, electrical, HVAC, painting, cleaning, and other general maintenance needs while responding to work orders and supporting facility operations.


What You’ll Do:

  • Perform preventive building maintenance and complete assigned work orders throughout the facility.
  • Complete routine plumbing repairs, including addressing clogged toilets, sinks and urinals, water leaks, and leaking faucets.
  • Perform basic electrical maintenance, including replacing light bulbs and lamps and assisting with the repair or replacement of ballasts and light fixtures.
  • Assist with HVAC maintenance and repairs as needed.
  • Safely operate aerial lifts, machinery, and other equipment required to complete maintenance projects.
  • Assemble, move, and install furniture and assist with hanging pictures, fixtures, and other facility items.
  • Support general facility upkeep through cleaning, painting, pressure washing, and repair work.
  • Assist with additional maintenance and facility projects as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Bring:

  • High school diploma or GED, six months to one year of related maintenance experience and/or training, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Basic knowledge of general building maintenance and repair practices.
  • Ability to safely use tools, equipment, machinery, and aerial lifts required for assigned work.
  • Ability to read and follow written and verbal instructions, safety procedures, work orders, and other job-related materials.
  • Basic math and problem-solving skills necessary to complete maintenance tasks and respond to routine facility issues.
  • Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with teammates and other departments.
  • Valid Florida driver’s license required.
  • Ability and willingness to travel as required.
  • Willingness to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours as necessary to support events and facility operations.

Why This Role?

The General Maintenance team plays an important role in keeping Daytona International Speedway safe, functional, and event-ready. This position offers the opportunity to work hands-on across one of motorsports' most recognized facilities while supporting the day-to-day operations and events that bring the Speedway to life.


Physical Requirements

This position regularly requires the use of hands to handle or feel objects and reaching with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, climb or balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl, as well as talk and hear.

The employee must regularly be able to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required for this position include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, and depth perception.


Behind every race weekend are talented people helping shape the future of sports and entertainment. If you are ready to make an impact alongside passionate teammates, we encourage you to apply.


Explore this opportunity and apply at www.careers.nascar.com.


Our people are the key to our success. That is why we offer competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package focused on wellness, and opportunities to grow and develop both personally and professionally.

jobs.title: Staff Accountant, Accounts Receivable and Revenue
jobs.description_html:
At NASCAR, you will work alongside passionate people creating experiences fans feel and helping shape the future of sports and entertainment.


NASCAR seeks a detail-oriented and collaborative professional to join our Finance team as a Staff Accountant, Accounts Receivable & Revenue.

This position supports revenue and accounts receivable operations, including billing, invoicing, customer contracts, variable revenue transactions, and month-end accounting. The ideal candidate brings strong accounting knowledge, advanced Excel skills, and a commitment to accuracy while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.


What You’ll Do

  • Support customer contract activities in Workday, including contract setup, maintenance, and appropriate revenue recognition treatment within assigned responsibilities.
  • Prepare recurring and non-recurring month-end journal entries and account reconciliations.
  • Reconcile source systems, settlements, and supporting data to Workday and the general ledger; research and resolve discrepancies promptly.
  • Record and process variable revenue transactions and support related billing and invoicing.
  • Create and maintain customer invoices, follow up on payment status, and initiate invoice adjustments and write-offs with appropriate documentation and coding.
  • Create, update, and monitor billing schedules to ensure billing terms, amounts, and dates are accurately reflected in Workday.
  • Use Workday import files and other approved tools to upload and process billing and revenue transactions.
  • Create and maintain accurate customer records in Workday.
  • Gather supporting information and documentation for internal and external audits.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to improve efficiency in Workday and related accounting processes.
  • Assist with special projects and other accounting or operational responsibilities as assigned.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting and one to three years of related experience and/or training, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong accounting knowledge and the ability to identify issues, research discrepancies, and develop practical solutions.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong working knowledge of other Microsoft Office applications.
  • Workday Financials experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain accounting policies, provide clear instructions, and respond to customers, business partners, and management.
  • Ability to apply mathematical concepts, including discounts, interest, percentages, ratios, and proportions.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • A positive attitude, strong work ethic, and willingness to work occasional overtime to meet department needs.

Why This Role?

Behind every partnership, agreement, and revenue stream is accurate financial reporting that helps keep NASCAR moving forward. In this role, you'll play a key part in ensuring revenue is recorded accurately, customer transactions are managed seamlessly, and financial data supports informed business decisions across one of the most recognized brands in sports and entertainment. Your attention to detail and process improvement mindset will help strengthen the financial foundation that enables NASCAR to grow, innovate, and deliver world-class experiences.


Behind every race weekend are talented people helping shape the future of sports and entertainment. If you are ready to make an impact alongside passionate teammates, we encourage you to apply.


Explore this opportunity and apply at www.careers.nascar.com.

jobs.title: Part Time Coordinator, Medical Liaison
jobs.description_html:
At NASCAR, you will work alongside passionate people creating experiences fans feel and helping shape the future of sports and entertainment.


NASCAR is seeking an experienced Part-Time Coordinator, Medical Liaison to:

  • Help shape a safe and well-supported environment for NASCAR participants and team members.
  • Lead communication and coordination efforts during medical events and critical situations.
  • Drive continuity of care by connecting medical providers, tracks, and NASCAR stakeholders.
  • Create trusted relationships that support timely decision-making and effective medical response.
  • Advance NASCAR's commitment to health, safety, and operational excellence across event operations.

...based in Daytona Beach, Florida.


What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary liaison between NASCAR, tracks, hospitals, and medical providers, ensuring timely and accurate communication during medical events while maintaining HIPAA compliance.
  • Monitor compliance with NASCAR Event Medical Standards and support tracks in meeting medical requirements outlined in sanction agreements.
  • Record, track, and coordinate medical care, follow-up activities, accident reporting, and workers' compensation documentation through resolution.
  • Act as a medical resource and advocate for NASCAR members, identifying and communicating concerns that may impact participant, worker, or driver safety.
  • Maintain accurate reports, databases, and medical records in accordance with applicable policies and procedures.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with NASCAR staff, participants, tracks, medical providers, and other key stakeholders.
  • Support event preparation, office communications, data entry, health fairs, NASCAR Summit activities, and other departmental initiatives.
  • Participate in meetings, conference calls, and operational discussions throughout the season.

What You'll Bring

  • Associate Degree in Nursing required; Bachelor's Degree in Nursing or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of recent experience as a Registered Nurse in Emergency Medicine and/or Critical Care Transport.
  • Current, active, and unencumbered Registered Nurse (RN) license.
  • Leadership experience preferred; case management experience is a plus.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to develop cross-functional partnerships and influence outcomes across multiple stakeholders.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively in sensitive or high-pressure situations.
  • Proven ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and remain calm during emergencies and crisis situations.
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and data management skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and the ability to utilize company-provided technology and systems effectively.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and customer service.
  • Ability to travel up to 90%, including weekends and holidays, as business needs require.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to help protect and support the people who power NASCAR. As a Medical Liaison, you'll serve as a critical link between NASCAR, medical providers, and event operations, helping ensure participants and team members receive timely care, clear communication, and appropriate support when it matters most. Your expertise, judgment, and advocacy will directly contribute to a safe, prepared, and high-performing environment across NASCAR events, helping the sport operate with confidence both on and off the track.
